            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('khach_hang', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('%7B%22id_khach_hang%22%3A%22KHA-QJLM59%22%2C%22phan_loai%22%3A%22Kh%C3%A1ch%20h%C3%A0ng%22%2C%22ten_khach_hang%22%3A%22Khach%20Hang%20Test%20E2E%22%2C%22ten_co_dau%22%3A%22%22%2C%22ten_chu_re%22%3A%22%22%2C%22nhan_khach_hang%22%3A%22%F0%9F%92%8D%20%20-%20%20-%20987654321%22%2C%22dia_chi%22%3A%22123%20Hoang%20Cau%2C%20Dong%20Da%2C%20Ha%20Noi%22%2C%22so_dien_thoai%22%3A987654321%2C%22email%22%3A%22%22%2C%22loai_ngay%22%3A%22%22%2C%22ngay_ky_niem%22%3A%22%22%2C%22chi_nhanh%22%3A%222H%20Studio%20-%20Ho%C3%A0ng%20C%E1%BA%A7u%22%2C%22ngay_tao%22%3A%222026-08-02T07%3A00%3A00.000Z%22%2C%22trang_thai%22%3Atrue%2C%22ghi_chu%22%3A%22%22%2C%22nguoi_tao%22%3A%22%22%2C%22thoi_gian_tao%22%3A%222026-08-02T07%3A57%3A52.000Z%22%2C%22nguoi_cap_nhat%22%3A%22%22%2C%22ngay_cap_nhat%22%3A%22%22%2C%22chi_nhanh_id%22%3A%22HC%22%7D')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pencil text-sm"></i>
            </button>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_CRM.deleteRecord('KHA-QJLM59')" class="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      
        </tr>
      </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    
    <div class="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 flex-wrap gap-3">
      <div id="page-info-kh" class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Hiển thị 1-15 của 23</div>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button id="btn-prev-kh" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5" disabled="" style="opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i> Trước
        </button>
        <span id="page-num-kh" class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 min-w-[50px] text-center">Trang 1 / 2</span>
        <button id="btn-next-kh" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5" style="opacity: 1; cursor: pointer;">
          Sau <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
        <script>
window.MOD_CRM = {
  
  rawCustomers: [],
  filteredCustomers: [],
  
  
  pageSize: 15,
  currentPageKH: 1,

  
  init: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    
    $('#mod-crm-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.handleFilterChange();
    });
    
    $('#mod-crm-filter-branch').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.handleFilterChange();
    });
    
    
    $('#mod-crm-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#btn-prev-kh').off('click').on('click', function() {
      if (self.currentPageKH > 1) {
        self.currentPageKH--;
        self.renderTableCustomers();
      }
    });
    $('#btn-next-kh').off('click').on('click', function() {
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(self.filteredCustomers.length / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPageKH < totalPages) {
        self.currentPageKH++;
        self.renderTableCustomers();
      }
    });

    
    self.fetchData();
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    showLoader(forceSync ? "Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu CRM..." : "Đang tải dữ liệu CRM...");
    
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          self.rawCustomers = data.customers || [];
          self.filteredCustomers = [...self.rawCustomers];
          
          
          self.populateBranchesFilter(data.filters || {});
          
          
          self.currentPageKH = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderTableCustomers();
          
          hideLoader();
          if (forceSync) showSuccess("Đồng bộ dữ liệu CRM thành công!");
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu CRM: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ CRM: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_CRM_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateBranchesFilter: function(filters) {
    const $branch = $('#mod-crm-filter-branch');
    const currVal = $branch.val();
    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    
    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branch.append(new Option(b.name, b.id));
      });
    }
    $branch.val(currVal);
  },

  
  handleFilterChange: function() {
    const self = this;
    const query = $('#mod-crm-search-input').val().toLowerCase().trim();
    const branchId = $('#mod-crm-filter-branch').val();
    
    self.filteredCustomers = self.rawCustomers.filter(c => {
      const matchesBranch = !branchId || String(c.chi_nhanh_id || c.chi_nhanh) === branchId;
      const matchesQuery = !query || 
        String(c.ten_khach_hang || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(c.ten_co_dau || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(c.ten_chu_re || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(c.so_dien_thoai || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(c.id_khach_hang || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        
      return matchesBranch && matchesQuery;
    });
    self.currentPageKH = 1;
    self.renderTableCustomers();
    self.updateKPIs();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    $('#kpi-kh-tong').text(self.filteredCustomers.length.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    const activeCount = self.filteredCustomers.filter(c => String(c.trang_thai).toUpperCase() === 'TRUE' || c.trang_thai === true).length;
    $('#kpi-kh-active').text(activeCount.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    
    
    const currentMonth = new Date().getMonth() + 1;
    const anniversaryCount = self.filteredCustomers.filter(c => {
      if (!c.ngay_ky_niem) return false;
      const parts = c.ngay_ky_niem.split('-');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        return parseInt(parts[1], 10) === currentMonth;
      }
      return false;
    }).length;
    $('#kpi-kh-kyniem').text(anniversaryCount.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
  },

  
  renderTableCustomers: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#table-customers-data tbody');
    $tbody.empty();
    
    const displayData = self.filteredCustomers;
    const total = displayData.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
    
    if (self.currentPageKH > totalPages) self.currentPageKH = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPageKH < 1) self.currentPageKH = 1;
    
    const start = (self.currentPageKH - 1) * self.pageSize;
    const end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    const pageData = displayData.slice(start, end);
    
    $('#table-info-kh').text(`Tổng số: ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} khách hàng`);
    $('#page-info-kh').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : `Hiển thị ${start + 1}-${end} của ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`);
    $('#page-num-kh').text(`Trang ${self.currentPageKH} / ${totalPages}`);
    
    // Toggle buttons
    document.getElementById('btn-prev-kh').disabled = self.currentPageKH === 1;
    document.getElementById('btn-next-kh').disabled = self.currentPageKH === totalPages;
    $('#btn-prev-kh').css({ opacity: self.currentPageKH === 1 ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPageKH === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });
    $('#btn-next-kh').css({ opacity: self.currentPageKH === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPageKH === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });
    
    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="7" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy dữ liệu khách hàng</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }
    
    pageData.forEach((r, idx) => {
      const globalIdx = start + idx + 1;
      const cdName = r.ten_co_dau || '';
      const crName = r.ten_chu_re || '';
      const fullNames = (cdName && crName) ? `CD: ${cdName} <br> CR: ${crName}` : (cdName || crName || 'Chưa cập nhật');
      
      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(r));
      const tdAction = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('khach_hang', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pencil text-sm"></i>
            </button>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_CRM.deleteRecord('${r.id_khach_hang}')" class="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      `;
      
      $tbody.append(`
        <tr onclick="window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('khach_hang', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-slate-400 font-medium">${globalIdx}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
            <div>${r.ten_khach_hang || 'Chưa đặt tên'}</div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">${r.id_khach_hang || ''}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-350">${fullNames}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">${r.so_dien_thoai || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-500">${r.dia_chi || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-800/30">${r.chi_nhanh || 'Khác'}</span></td>
          ${tdAction}
        </tr>
      `);
    });
  },

  // --- DELETE RECORD ---
  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa bản ghi Khách Hàng này không?")) return;
    
    showLoader("Đang xóa dữ liệu...");
    const self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa khách hàng thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('khach_hang', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  },

  // --- CUSTOM DETAIL VIEW TO SHOW ORDER HISTORY ---
  customRenderDetail: function(recordObj) {
    const fieldsContainer = $('#crud-drawer-fields');
    fieldsContainer.empty();
    
    // Vẽ thông tin cơ bản khách hàng trước
    if (window.AppCRUD && typeof window.AppCRUD.renderDetailFields === 'function') {
      const oldActive = window.AppCRUD.activeTable;
      window.AppCRUD.activeTable = 'khach_hang';
      window.AppCRUD.renderDetailFields(recordObj);
      window.AppCRUD.activeTable = oldActive;
    }

    // Lọc lịch sử đơn hàng từ cache
    const custId = recordObj.id_khach_hang || '';
    const custPhone = recordObj.so_dien_thoai || '';
    
    let dhData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"]) || {};
    if (typeof dhData === "string") {
      try { dhData = JSON.parse(dhData); } catch(e) { dhData = {}; }
    }
    const allOrders = dhData.don_hang || [];
    
    const custOrders = allOrders.filter(o => 
      (custId && String(o.id_khach_hang).trim() === String(custId).trim()) ||
      (custPhone && String(o.so_dien_thoai).trim() === String(custPhone).trim())
    );

    let ordersHtml = `
      <div class="mt-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pt-5 space-y-4">
        <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-file-invoice-dollar text-blue-500"></i> Lịch sử đơn hàng (${custOrders.length})
        </h4>
        <div id="crm-customer-orders-container" class="space-y-3">
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    fieldsContainer.append(ordersHtml);

    const container = $('#crm-customer-orders-container');
    if (custOrders.length === 0) {
      container.append(`<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">Khách hàng chưa có lịch sử đơn hàng nào</div>`);
    } else {
      custOrders.forEach((o, oIdx) => {
        const total = parseFloat(o.tong_tien) || 0;
        const paid = parseFloat(o.da_thanh_toan) || 0;
        const remain = parseFloat(o.con_lai) || 0;
        
        const formattedTotal = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(total) + ' đ';
        const formattedPaid = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(paid) + ' đ';
        const formattedRemain = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(remain) + ' đ';
        const dateStr = o.ngay ? dayjs(o.ngay).format("DD/MM/YYYY") : '-';
        
        let statusBadge = `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">${o.trang_thai || 'Mới'}</span>`;
        if (o.trang_thai === "Không ký" || o.trang_thai === "HD07") {
          statusBadge = `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-50 text-red-650 dark:bg-red-950/20 dark:text-red-400">Không ký</span>`;
        } else if (o.trang_thai === "Hoàn thành" || o.trang_thai === "HD04") {
          statusBadge = `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-650 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 dark:text-emerald-400">Hoàn thành</span>`;
        }

        let orderCard = `
          <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/30 flex flex-col space-y-2 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-350">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">${o.id_don_hang}</span>
              ${statusBadge}
            </div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
              <div><span class="text-slate-400">Ngày lập:</span> ${dateStr}</div>
              <div><span class="text-slate-400">Chi nhánh:</span> ${o.chi_nhanh || ''}</div>
              <div class="col-span-2"><span class="text-slate-400">Dịch vụ quan tâm:</span> ${o.loai_dich_vu || ''}</div>
              <div><span class="text-slate-400">Tổng tiền:</span> <span class="font-bold text-slate-850 dark:text-white">${formattedTotal}</span></div>
              <div><span class="text-slate-400">Đã thanh toán:</span> <span class="font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">${formattedPaid}</span></div>
              <div><span class="text-slate-400">Còn lại:</span> <span class="font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-450">${formattedRemain}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        container.append(orderCard);
      });
    }
  }
};
</script>
      </div>

    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      
      <div class="relative">
        <select id="mod-dv-filter-branch" class="appearance-none pr-8 pl-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/30">
          <option value="">Tất cả Chi nhánh</option>

          <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass text-xs"></i>

        <input type="text" id="mod-dv-search-input" placeholder="Tìm kiếm dịch vụ..." class="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm placeholder-slate-400 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/30">

    <div class="glass-card bento-shadow p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center border-l-4 border-purple-500">
      <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xl flex-shrink-0 mr-4 shadow-inner">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-tags"></i>

    <div class="glass-card bento-shadow p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center border-l-4 border-amber-500">

  <div class="glass-card bento-shadow rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
    <div class="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 flex items-center justify-between">
      <h4 class="font-bold text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-list text-slate-400"></i>
        <span>Danh sách Gói Dịch Vụ</span>
      </h4>
      <span id="table-info-dv" class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Đang tải...</span>
    </div>

    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
      <table id="table-services-data" class="w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse">
        <thead>
          <tr class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <th class="py-3 px-4" style="width: 50px;">Stt</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4">Mã Gói</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4">Tên Dịch Vụ</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4">Phân Loại</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right">Đơn Giá</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-center">ĐVT</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4">Chi Nhánh</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-center" style="width: 100px;">Thao tác</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    
    <div class="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 flex-wrap gap-3">
      <div id="page-info-dv" class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Hiển thị 0-0 của 0</div>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button id="btn-prev-dv" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i> Trước
        </button>
        <span id="page-num-dv" class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 min-w-[50px] text-center">Trang 1 / 1</span>
        <button id="btn-next-dv" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5">
          Sau <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

        <script>
window.MOD_DichVu = {
  
  rawServices: [],
  filteredServices: [],
  
  
  pageSize: 15,
  currentPageDV: 1,

  
  init: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    
    $('#mod-dv-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.handleFilterChange();
    });
    
    $('#mod-dv-filter-branch').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.handleFilterChange();
    });
    
    
    $('#mod-dv-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#btn-prev-dv').off('click').on('click', function() {
      if (self.currentPageDV > 1) {
        self.currentPageDV--;
        self.renderTableServices();
      }
    });
    $('#btn-next-dv').off('click').on('click', function() {
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(self.filteredServices.length / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPageDV < totalPages) {
        self.currentPageDV++;
        self.renderTableServices();
      }
    });

    
    self.fetchData();
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    showLoader(forceSync ? "Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu dịch vụ..." : "Đang tải dữ liệu dịch vụ...");
    
    
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          self.rawServices = data.services || [];
          self.filteredServices = [...self.rawServices];
          
          
          self.populateBranchesFilter(data.filters || {});
          
          
          self.currentPageDV = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderTableServices();
          
          hideLoader();
          if (forceSync) showSuccess("Đồng bộ dữ liệu gói dịch vụ thành công!");
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu dịch vụ: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ dịch vụ: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_CRM_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateBranchesFilter: function(filters) {
    const $branch = $('#mod-dv-filter-branch');
    const currVal = $branch.val();
    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    
    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branch.append(new Option(b.name, b.id));
      });
    }
    $branch.val(currVal);
  },

  
  handleFilterChange: function() {
    const self = this;
    const query = $('#mod-dv-search-input').val().toLowerCase().trim();
    const branchId = $('#mod-dv-filter-branch').val();
    
    self.filteredServices = self.rawServices.filter(s => {
      const matchesBranch = !branchId || String(s.chi_nhanh_id || s.chi_nhanh) === branchId;
      const matchesQuery = !query || 
        String(s.ten_dich_vu || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(s.loai_dich_vu || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(s.hang_muc || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(s.id_dich_vu || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        
      return matchesBranch && matchesQuery;
    });
    self.currentPageDV = 1;
    self.renderTableServices();
    self.updateKPIs();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    $('#kpi-dv-tong').text(self.filteredServices.length.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    
    let sum = 0;
    let maxVal = 0;
    self.filteredServices.forEach(s => {
      const price = s.don_gia || 0;
      sum += price;
      if (price > maxVal) maxVal = price;
    });
    
    const avg = self.filteredServices.length > 0 ? Math.round(sum / self.filteredServices.length) : 0;
    $('#kpi-dv-avg').text(avg.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫');
    $('#kpi-dv-max').text(maxVal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫');
  },

  
  renderTableServices: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#table-services-data tbody');
    $tbody.empty();
    
    const displayData = self.filteredServices;
    const total = displayData.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
    
    if (self.currentPageDV > totalPages) self.currentPageDV = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPageDV < 1) self.currentPageDV = 1;
    
    const start = (self.currentPageDV - 1) * self.pageSize;
    const end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    const pageData = displayData.slice(start, end);
    
    $('#table-info-dv').text(`Tổng số: ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} gói dịch vụ`);
    $('#page-info-dv').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : `Hiển thị ${start + 1}-${end} của ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`);
    $('#page-num-dv').text(`Trang ${self.currentPageDV} / ${totalPages}`);
    
    // Toggle buttons
    document.getElementById('btn-prev-dv').disabled = self.currentPageDV === 1;
    document.getElementById('btn-next-dv').disabled = self.currentPageDV === totalPages;
    $('#btn-prev-dv').css({ opacity: self.currentPageDV === 1 ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPageDV === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });
    $('#btn-next-dv').css({ opacity: self.currentPageDV === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPageDV === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });
    
    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="8" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy gói dịch vụ</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }
    
    pageData.forEach((r, idx) => {
      const globalIdx = start + idx + 1;
      
      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(r));
      const tdAction = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('dich_vu', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pencil text-sm"></i>
            </button>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_DichVu.deleteRecord('${r.id_dich_vu}')" class="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      `;
      
      $tbody.append(`
        <tr onclick="window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('dich_vu', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-slate-400 font-medium">${globalIdx}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-350">${r.id_dich_vu || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">
            <div class="font-semibold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100">${r.ten_dich_vu || ''}</div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate max-w-xs" title="${r.mo_ta_chi_tiet || ''}">${r.mo_ta_chi_tiet || ''}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/30 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 border border-purple-200/40">${r.loai_dich_vu || r.hang_muc || 'Gói'}</span></td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${(r.don_gia || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}₫</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center font-medium text-slate-500">${r.dvt || 'Gói'}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-800/30">${r.chi_nhanh || 'Khác'}</span></td>
          ${tdAction}
        </tr>
      `);
    });
  },

  // --- DELETE RECORD ---
  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa bản ghi Gói Dịch Vụ này không?")) return;
    
    showLoader("Đang xóa dữ liệu...");
    const self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa gói dịch vụ thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('dich_vu', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  }
};
</script>
      </div>

    <div class="glass-card bento-shadow p-5 rounded-2xl">

        <i class="fa-solid fa-wrench"></i> Hỏng / Đang sửa chữa

          <div id="mod-tb-table-info" class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium mt-1">Đang tải...</div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button id="mod-tb-btn-export-excel" class="py-1.5 px-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5">

              <th class="py-3 px-4 text-center" style="width: 100px;">Thao tác</th>

          <button id="mod-tb-btn-next" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5">

        <script>

if (typeof ChartDataLabels !== 'undefined') {
  Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);
}





window.MOD_ThietBi = {
  
  rawThietBi: [],
  filteredThietBi: [],
  activeTableTab: 'ALL', 
  currentPage: 1,
  pageSize: 15,
  expandedCanvasId: null,
  originalParent: null,
  originalNextSibling: null,
  
  
  chartROI: null,
  chartSL: null,
  chartStatus: null,
  chartTop: null,
  chartDepreciation: null,

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {

    if (this.chartROI) { this.chartROI.destroy(); this.chartROI = null; }
    if (this.chartSL) { this.chartSL.destroy(); this.chartSL = null; }
    if (this.chartStatus) { this.chartStatus.destroy(); this.chartStatus = null; }
    if (this.chartTop) { this.chartTop.destroy(); this.chartTop = null; }
    if (this.chartDepreciation) { this.chartDepreciation.destroy(); this.chartDepreciation = null; }
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;

    
    $('#mod-tb-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-tb-btn-export-excel').on('click', '#mod-tb-btn-export-excel', function() {
      self.exportExcel();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-tb-btn-export-pdf').on('click', '#mod-tb-btn-export-pdf', function() {
      self.exportPDF();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-tb-btn-prev').on('click', '#mod-tb-btn-prev', function() {
      if (self.currentPage > 1) {
        self.currentPage--;
        self.renderTable();
      }
    });

    $(document).off('click', '#mod-tb-btn-next').on('click', '#mod-tb-btn-next', function() {
      const total = self.getTableData().length;
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPage < totalPages) {
        self.currentPage++;
        self.renderTable();
      }
    });

    
    $('#mod-tb-filter-branch, #mod-tb-filter-type, #mod-tb-filter-status').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.currentPage = 1; 
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-tb-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.currentPage = 1; 
      self.applyFilters();
    });


    $('#mod-tb-chartModal').off('click').on('click', function(e) {

    });
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu mới...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          self.rawThietBi = data.thietBiData || [];
          self.filteredThietBi = [...self.rawThietBi];

          
          self.populateDropdownFilters(data.filters || {});

          
          self.currentPage = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderCharts();
          self.renderTable();

          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu thiết bị: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ thiết bị: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_ThietBi_fetchData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa thiết bị này không?")) return;
    
    showLoader("Đang xóa thiết bị...");
    const self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa thiết bị thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('thiet_bi', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  },

  
  populateDropdownFilters: function(filters) {
    const $branch = $('#mod-tb-filter-branch');
    const $type = $('#mod-tb-filter-type');

    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    $type.find('option:not(:first)').remove();

    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branch.append(new Option(b.name, b.id));
      });
    }
    if (filters.types) {
      filters.types.forEach(t => {
        $type.append(new Option(t, t));
      });
    }
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    let totalVon = 0;
    let totalConLai = 0;
    let totalKhauHao = 0;
    let totalTon = 0;
    let totalCapPhat = 0;
    let totalHong = 0;

    self.filteredThietBi.forEach(r => {
      totalVon += (r.gia_mua || 0) * (r.so_luong || 0);
      totalConLai += (r.gia_sau_khau_hao || 0);
      totalKhauHao += (r.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0);
      totalTon += (r.so_luong || 0);
      
      let isHong = false;
      if (r.trang_thai && (r.trang_thai.toLowerCase().includes('hỏng') || r.trang_thai.toLowerCase().includes('sửa') || r.trang_thai.toLowerCase().includes('mất'))) {
        isHong = true;
      }
      if (isHong) totalHong++;

      if (r.nguoi_dang_giu && String(r.nguoi_dang_giu).trim() !== '') {
        totalCapPhat++;
      }
    });

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      if(!val) return '0đ';
      return Math.round(Number(val)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };
    const formatNumber = (val) => {
      if(!val) return '0';
      return Number(val).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    };

    $('#mod-tb-kpi-von').text(formatCurrency(totalVon));
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-conlai').text(formatCurrency(totalConLai));
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-khauhao').text(formatCurrency(totalKhauHao));
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-ton').text(formatNumber(totalTon));
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-capphat').text(formatNumber(totalCapPhat));
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-hong').text(formatNumber(totalHong));

    
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-von-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+2.4%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">450Tr</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-conlai-trend').html(`<span class="text-rose-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down text-[9px]"></i> Giảm (-1.8%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">43.7Tr</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-khauhao-trend').html(`<span class="text-amber-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+0.5%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">3Tr</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-ton-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+1.5%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">11 cái</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-capphat-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+1.1%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">8 cái</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-tb-kpi-hong-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down text-[9px]"></i> Giảm (-5.0%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">2 cái</span></span>`);
  },

  
  getTableData: function() {
    const self = this;
    let displayData = self.filteredThietBi;
    if (self.activeTableTab === 'REPAIR') {
      displayData = self.filteredThietBi.filter(r => {
        const st = String(r.trang_thai).toLowerCase();
        return st.includes('hỏng') || st.includes('sửa') || st.includes('mất');
      });
    }
    return displayData;
  },

  
  renderTable: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#mod-tb-table-data tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    const displayData = self.getTableData();
    const total = displayData.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;

    if (self.currentPage > totalPages) self.currentPage = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPage < 1) self.currentPage = 1;

    const start = (self.currentPage - 1) * self.pageSize;
    const end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    const pageData = displayData.slice(start, end);

    
    $('#mod-tb-table-info').text(`Tổng số: ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} thiết bị`);
    $('#mod-tb-page-info').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : `Hiển thị ${start + 1}-${end} của ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`);
    $('#mod-tb-page-num').text(`Trang ${self.currentPage} / ${totalPages}`);

    // Update buttons states
    const btnPrev = document.getElementById('mod-tb-btn-prev');
    const btnNext = document.getElementById('mod-tb-btn-next');
    if (btnPrev && btnNext) {
      btnPrev.disabled = self.currentPage === 1;
      btnNext.disabled = self.currentPage === totalPages;
      btnPrev.style.opacity = self.currentPage === 1 ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnNext.style.opacity = self.currentPage === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnPrev.style.cursor = self.currentPage === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
      btnNext.style.cursor = self.currentPage === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
    }

    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="8" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy dữ liệu</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    const formatNumber = (val) => {
      if(!val) return '0';
      return Number(val).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    };

    pageData.forEach(r => {
      
      const imgHtml = `<td class="py-3 px-4">${r.hinh_anh 
        ? `<img src="${r.hinh_anh.split(',')[0]}" class="w-10 h-10 object-cover rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/40x40?text=TB'"/>`
        : `<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 text-xs font-semibold"><i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i></div>`}</td>`;

      // 2. Mã TB (màu thường nguyên bản)
      const tdCode = `<td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${r.ma_thiet_bi || r.id_thiet_bi || ''}</td>`;

      // 3. Tên thiết bị
      const tdName = `<td class="py-3 px-4"><div class="font-semibold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100">${r.ten_thiet_bi || ''}</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${r.chi_nhanh || ''}</div></td>`;

      // 4. Loại
      const tdType = `<td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200/50 dark:border-blue-800/30">${r.loai_thiet_bi || 'Khác'}</span></td>`;

      
      const tdTon = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-center font-bold">${r.so_luong || 0}</td>`;

      // 6. Giá trị (Mua / Còn lại) - Đổi màu chữ động theo % khấu hao chuẩn gốc
      const giaMua = r.gia_mua || 0;
      const conLai = r.gia_sau_khau_hao || 0;
      const pct = giaMua > 0 ? Math.round(conLai / giaMua * 100) : 0;
      const valColorClass = pct <= 30 ? 'text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold' : (pct <= 60 ? 'text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold');

      const tdProg = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-right">
          <div class="font-semibold ${valColorClass}">${formatNumber(conLai)}đ</div>
          <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Mua: ${formatNumber(giaMua)}đ (${pct}%)</div>
        </td>
      `;

      // 7. Tình trạng & Trạng thái - Badge màu gốc
      let statusTextDisplay = r.trang_thai || '';
      if (statusTextDisplay === true || String(statusTextDisplay).toLowerCase() === 'true') {
        statusTextDisplay = 'Sẵn sàng';
      } else if (statusTextDisplay === false || String(statusTextDisplay).toLowerCase() === 'false') {
        statusTextDisplay = 'Đang sửa chữa';
      }

      const stTxt = String(statusTextDisplay).toLowerCase();
      let badgeClass = 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border border-blue-500/20'; 
      if (stTxt.includes('sẵn sàng') || stTxt.includes('rảnh') || stTxt.includes('hoạt động')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20';
      } else if (stTxt.includes('sửa') || stTxt.includes('hỏng') || stTxt.includes('mất') || stTxt.includes('chữa')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border border-rose-500/20';
      }

      const tdSt = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <span class="badge-status ${badgeClass} block w-max mx-auto mb-1">${statusTextDisplay}</span>
          <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">Tình trạng: ${r.tinh_trang || '0%'}</span>
        </td>
      `;

      // 8. Cấp phát
      const nguoiGiu = r.nguoi_dang_giu || 'Trong kho';
      const tdCapPhat = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-left">
          <div class="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${nguoiGiu}</div>
          <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${r.vi_tri || ''}</div>
        </td>
      `;

      // 9. Thao tác
      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(r));
      const tdAction = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('thiet_bi', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pencil text-sm"></i>
            </button>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_ThietBi.deleteRecord('${r.id_thiet_bi || r.ma_thiet_bi}')" class="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      `;

      $tbody.append(`<tr onclick="window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('thiet_bi', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">${imgHtml + tdCode + tdName + tdType + tdTon + tdProg + tdSt + tdCapPhat + tdAction}</tr>`);
    });
  },

  // --- RENDER VISUAL CHARTS (5 CHARTS) ---
  renderCharts: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    const textColor = isDark ? '#9ca3af' : '#475569';
    const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(156,163,175,0.08)' : 'rgba(71,85,105,0.08)';
    const chartBorder = isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';

    const formatNumber = (num, decimals = 0) => {
      if(!num) return '0';
      return Number(num).toLocaleString('vi-VN', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals });
    };

    const formatShortNumber = (val) => {
      if (!val) return '0';
      if (val >= 1000000) return (val / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'Tr';
      if (val >= 1000) return (val / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
      return val;
    };

    
    const typeSL = {};
    self.filteredThietBi.forEach(r => {
      const type = r.loai_thiet_bi || 'Khác';
      typeSL[type] = (typeSL[type] || 0) + (r.so_luong || 0);
    });

    
    const pieCalloutPlugin = {
      id: 'pieCallout',
      afterDraw(chart) {
        if (chart.config.type !== 'pie' && chart.config.type !== 'doughnut') return;
        const ctx = chart.ctx;
        
        
        const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
        const localTextColor = isDark ? '#9ca3af' : '#475569';
        
        const localFormatShortNumber = (v) => {
          if (!v) return '0';
          if (v >= 1000000) return (v / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'Tr';
          if (v >= 1000) return (v / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
          return v;
        };

        chart.data.datasets.forEach((dataset, i) => {
          chart.getDatasetMeta(i).data.forEach((model, index) => {
            const val = dataset.data[index];
            const total = dataset.data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            if (val / total >= 0.05 || val / total < 0.03) return;

            const midAngle = model.startAngle + (model.endAngle - model.startAngle) / 2;
            const outerRadius = model.outerRadius;
            const x = Math.cos(midAngle);
            const y = Math.sin(midAngle);
            const startX = model.x + x * outerRadius;
            const startY = model.y + y * outerRadius;
            const endX = model.x + x * (outerRadius + 15);
            const endY = model.y + y * (outerRadius + 15);
            const lineEndX = endX + (x >= 0 ? 10 : -10);

            
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
            ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
            ctx.lineTo(lineEndX, endY);
            ctx.strokeStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.stroke();

            
            ctx.fillStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.font = 'bold 10px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = x >= 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(localFormatShortNumber(val), lineEndX + (x >= 0 ? 4 : -4), endY);
          });
        });
      }
    };

    const commOpt = {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { labels: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 11 } } },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)',
          titleFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 12 },
          bodyFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 12 },
          padding: 10,
          cornerRadius: 8
        }
      }
    };

    
    const typeMap = {};
    self.filteredThietBi.forEach(r => {
      const t = r.loai_thiet_bi || 'Khác';
      if(!typeMap[t]) typeMap[t] = { von: 0, thu: 0 };
      typeMap[t].von += (r.gia_mua || 0) * (r.so_luong || 0);
      typeMap[t].thu += (r.gia_sau_khau_hao || 0);
    });
    
    const roiLabels = Object.keys(typeMap).sort();
    const roiVon = roiLabels.map(k => typeMap[k].von);
    const roiThu = roiLabels.map(k => typeMap[k].thu);

    if (self.chartROI) self.chartROI.destroy();
    const ctxROI = document.getElementById('mod-tb-chart-roi').getContext('2d');
    self.chartROI = new Chart(ctxROI, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: roiLabels,
        datasets: [
          { label: 'Vốn đầu tư', data: roiVon, backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4 },
          { label: 'Giá trị còn lại', data: roiThu, backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 4 }
        ]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 10 } } },
          y: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 10 }, callback: v => (v/1000000) + 'Tr' } }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          datalabels: {
            anchor: 'end',
            align: context => {
              const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
              const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
              return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'top' : 'bottom';
            },
            color: context => {
              const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
              const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
              return (val < max * 0.15) ? textColor : '#ffffff';
            },
            font: { size: 9, family: 'Inter', weight: 'bold' },
            clip: false,
            formatter: v => v > 0 ? formatShortNumber(v) : ''
          }
        }
      }
    });

    
    const slLabels = Object.keys(typeSL);
    const slData = slLabels.map(k => typeSL[k]);
    const pieColors = ['#3b82f6', '#8b5cf6', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#64748b', '#0ea5e9', '#ec4899'];

    if (self.chartSL) self.chartSL.destroy();
    const ctxSL = document.getElementById('mod-tb-chart-sl').getContext('2d');
    self.chartSL = new Chart(ctxSL, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: slLabels,
        datasets: [{
          data: slData,
          backgroundColor: pieColors,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderColor: chartBorder
        }]
      },
      plugins: [pieCalloutPlugin],
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        layout: { padding: { top: 30, bottom: 30, left: 40, right: 40 } },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { ...commOpt.plugins.legend, position: 'left' },
          datalabels: {
            color: '#ffffff',
            font: { weight: 'bold', size: 10, family: 'Inter' },
            display: ctx => {
              const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex];
              const total = ctx.dataset.data.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0) || 1;
              return (val/total >= 0.05);
            },
            formatter: v => formatShortNumber(v)
          }
        }
      }
    });

    
    const stMap = { "0% - 30%": 0, "30% - 60%": 0, "60% - 80%": 0, "80% - 100%": 0 };
    self.filteredThietBi.forEach(r => {
      const tt = parseFloat(String(r.tinh_trang || '0').replace('%', '')) || 0;
      if (tt <= 30) stMap["0% - 30%"]++;
      else if (tt <= 60) stMap["30% - 60%"]++;
      else if (tt <= 80) stMap["60% - 80%"]++;
      else stMap["80% - 100%"]++;
    });
    const stLabels = Object.keys(stMap);
    const stData = stLabels.map(k => stMap[k]);
    const stBg = ['#ef4444', '#f59e0b', '#3b82f6', '#10b981'];

    if (self.chartStatus) self.chartStatus.destroy();
    const ctxStatus = document.getElementById('mod-tb-chart-status').getContext('2d');
    self.chartStatus = new Chart(ctxStatus, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: stLabels,
        datasets: [{
          data: stData,
          backgroundColor: stBg,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderColor: chartBorder
        }]
      },
      plugins: [pieCalloutPlugin],
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        layout: { padding: { top: 30, bottom: 30, left: 40, right: 40 } },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { ...commOpt.plugins.legend, position: 'left' },
          datalabels: {
            color: '#ffffff', font: { weight: 'bold', size: 10, family: 'Inter' },
            display: ctx => {
              const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex];
              const total = ctx.dataset.data.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0) || 1;
              return (val/total >= 0.05);
            },
            formatter: v => formatShortNumber(v)
          }
        }
      }
    });

    
    const sortedByVon = [...self.filteredThietBi].sort((a,b) => ((b.gia_mua || 0) * (b.so_luong || 0)) - ((a.gia_mua || 0) * (a.so_luong || 0))).slice(0, 10);
    const sortedByDep = [...self.filteredThietBi].sort((a,b) => (b.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0) - (a.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0)).slice(0, 10).filter(r => (r.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0) > 0);

    
    const topLabels = sortedByVon.map(r => {
      const name = `${r.ten_thiet_bi || 'N/A'}(${r.ma_thiet_bi || ''})`;
      return name.length > 25 ? name.substring(0, 25) + '...' : name;
    });
    const topData = sortedByVon.map(r => (r.gia_mua || 0) * (r.so_luong || 0));

    if (self.chartTop) self.chartTop.destroy();
    const ctxTop = document.getElementById('mod-tb-chart-top').getContext('2d');
    self.chartTop = new Chart(ctxTop, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: topLabels,
        datasets: [{
          label: 'Giá trị (VND)',
          data: topData,
          backgroundColor: '#3b82f6', borderRadius: 4, maxBarThickness: 15
        }]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 50 } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => (v/1000000) + 'Tr' } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { display: false },
          datalabels: {
            anchor: 'end',
            align: ctx => {
              const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex] || 0;
              const max = Math.max(...ctx.dataset.data) || 1;
              return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'right' : 'left';
            },
            color: ctx => {
              const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex] || 0;
              const max = Math.max(...ctx.dataset.data) || 1;
              return (val < max * 0.15) ? textColor : '#ffffff';
            },
            clip: false,
            font: { size: 9, family: 'Inter', weight: 'bold' },
            formatter: v => formatShortNumber(v)
          }
        }
      }
    });

    
    const khLabels = sortedByDep.map(r => {
      const name = `${r.ten_thiet_bi || 'N/A'}(${r.ma_thiet_bi || ''})`;
      return name.length > 25 ? name.substring(0, 25) + '...' : name;
    });
    const khData = sortedByDep.map(r => r.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0);

    if (self.chartDepreciation) self.chartDepreciation.destroy();
    const ctxDep = document.getElementById('mod-tb-chart-depreciation').getContext('2d');
    self.chartDepreciation = new Chart(ctxDep, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: khLabels,
        datasets: [{
          label: 'Khấu hao tháng',
          data: khData,
          backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4, maxBarThickness: 15
        }]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => (v/1000) + 'K' } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { display: false },
          datalabels: {
            anchor: 'end',
            align: 'right',
            color: textColor,
            clip: false,
            font: { size: 9, family: 'Inter', weight: 'bold' },
            formatter: v => formatShortNumber(v)
          }
        }
      }
    });
  },

  
  updateCharts: function() {
    this.renderCharts();
  },

  
  switchTableTab: function(tabId) {
    this.activeTableTab = tabId;
    $('.mod-tb-tab-btn').removeClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').addClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200');
    
    if (tabId === 'ALL') {
      $('#mod-tb-tab-btn-all').addClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    } else {
      $('#mod-tb-tab-btn-repair').addClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    }

    this.renderTable();
  },

  
  applyFilters: function() {
    const self = this;
    const bVal = $('#mod-tb-filter-branch').val().toLowerCase();
    const tVal = $('#mod-tb-filter-type').val().toLowerCase();
    const sVal = $('#mod-tb-filter-status').val();
    const qVal = $('#mod-tb-search-input').val().toLowerCase();

    self.filteredThietBi = self.rawThietBi.filter(r => {
      
      const matchB = !bVal || bVal === 'all' || 
        String(r.chi_nhanh_id || r.chi_nhanh).toLowerCase() === bVal;

      
      const matchT = !tVal || tVal === 'all' || 
        String(r.loai_thiet_bi).toLowerCase() === tVal;

      
      let matchS = true;
      if (sVal && sVal !== 'ALL') {
        const pct = parseFloat(String(r.tinh_trang).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0;
        const parts = sVal.split('-');
        const min = parseFloat(parts[0]), max = parseFloat(parts[1]);
        matchS = pct >= min && pct <= max;
      }

      
      const textMatch = !qVal || 
        String(r.ten_thiet_bi || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(r.ma_thiet_bi || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(r.loai_thiet_bi || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(r.nguoi_dang_giu || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal);

      return matchB && matchT && matchS && textMatch;
    });

    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderCharts();
    self.renderTable();
  },

  
  toggleZoom: function(canvasId, btnElement) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const card = canvas.closest('.glass-card');
    if (!card) return;
    
    const isZoomed = card.classList.contains('panel-zoomed');
    if (isZoomed) {
      
      card.classList.remove('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-expand-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      
      this.renderCharts();
    } else {
      
      card.classList.add('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-compress-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      const chart = Chart.getChart(canvasId);
      if (chart) chart.resize();
    }
  },

  
  exportExcel: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $btn = $('#mod-tb-btn-export-excel');
    const originalText = $btn.html();
    $btn.html('<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin mr-2"></i> Đang xuất...').prop('disabled', true);

    let dataToExport = [];
    dataToExport.push(['Mã TB', 'Tên thiết bị', 'Loại', 'Chi nhánh', 'Số lượng', 'Giá mua', 'Khấu hao tháng', 'Giá trị còn lại', 'Tình trạng', 'Trạng thái', 'Người đang giữ', 'Vị trí']);

    const displayData = self.getTableData();
    displayData.forEach(r => {
      dataToExport.push([
        r.ma_thiet_bi || r.id_thiet_bi || '',
        r.ten_thiet_bi || '',
        r.loai_thiet_bi || '',
        r.chi_nhanh || '',
        r.so_luong || 0,
        r.gia_mua || 0,
        r.gia_khau_hao_thang || 0,
        r.gia_sau_khau_hao || 0,
        r.tinh_trang || '',
        r.trang_thai || '',
        r.nguoi_dang_giu || '',
        r.vi_tri || ''
      ]);
    });

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        if (res.success) {
          window.open(res.url, '_blank');
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi xuất Excel: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        showError("Lỗi kết nối xuất file: " + err.message);
      })
      .exportReport(dataToExport, "Danh_Sach_Thiet_Bi_Master");
  },

  
  exportPDF: function() {
    const self = this;
    const displayData = self.getTableData();
    if (displayData.length === 0) return alert("Không có dữ liệu để xuất PDF!");
    
    let html = `
      <html>
      <head>
        <title>Báo cáo Thiết bị chi tiết</title>
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
        <style>
          body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 20px; color: #1e293b; }
          h2 { margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }
          .meta { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 20px; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; }
          th, td { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; }
          th { background: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold; color: #475569; }
          .text-right { text-align: right; }
          .text-center { text-align: center; }
          .badge { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-block; }
          .bg-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }
          .bg-red { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
          .bg-blue { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <h2>2H Studio - Báo cáo Thiết bị chi tiết</h2>
        <div class="meta">Ngày xuất: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')} | Tổng số: ${displayData.length} thiết bị</div>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Mã TB</th>
              <th>Tên thiết bị</th>
              <th>Loại thiết bị</th>
              <th>Chi nhánh</th>
              <th class="text-center">SL</th>
              <th class="text-right">Giá mua</th>
              <th class="text-right">Giá trị còn lại</th>
              <th class="text-center">Trạng thái</th>
              <th>Người giữ</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
    `;

    displayData.forEach(r => {
      const st = String(r.trang_thai || '').toLowerCase();
      let badgeHtml = `<span class="badge bg-blue">${r.trang_thai || ''}</span>`;
      if (st.includes('sẵn sàng') || st.includes('rảnh')) {
        badgeHtml = `<span class="badge bg-green">${r.trang_thai || ''}</span>`;
      } else if (st.includes('sửa') || st.includes('hỏng') || st.includes('mất')) {
        badgeHtml = `<span class="badge bg-red">${r.trang_thai || ''}</span>`;
      }

      html += `
        <tr>
          <td>${r.ma_thiet_bi || r.id_thiet_bi || ''}</td>
          <td><strong>${r.ten_thiet_bi || ''}</strong></td>
          <td>${r.loai_thiet_bi || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.chi_nhanh || ''}</td>
          <td class="text-center">${r.so_luong || 0}</td>
          <td class="text-right">${Math.round(r.gia_mua || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}đ</td>
          <td class="text-right">${Math.round(r.gia_sau_khau_hao || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}đ</td>
          <td class="text-center">${badgeHtml}</td>
          <td>${r.nguoi_dang_giu || 'Trong kho'}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    });

    html += `
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <script>
          window.onload = function() { window.print(); }
        <\/script>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;

    const printWin = window.open('', '_blank');
    printWin.document.open();
    printWin.document.write(html);
    printWin.document.close();
  },
};

window.MOD_ACTIVE = window.MOD_ThietBi;
</script>

        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>
        <span>Thêm Nhân Viên</span>
      </button>

          <i class="fa-solid fa-file-excel"></i> Xuất Excel
        </button>
        <button id="mod-nv-btn-export-pdf" class="py-1.5 px-3 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Xuất PDF

          <thead>
            <tr class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <th class="py-3 px-4">ID</th>
              <th class="py-3 px-4">Họ Tên</th>

              <th class="py-3 px-4">Chức Vụ</th>

              <th class="py-3 px-4">Trạng Thái</th>

        <div id="mod-nv-assign-page-info" class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Hiển thị 0-0 của 0</div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button id="mod-nv-btn-assign-prev" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5">
