        <script>

if (typeof ChartDataLabels !== 'undefined') {
  Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);
}





window.MOD_NhanVien = {
  
  rawEmployees: [],
  rawAssignments: [],
  filteredEmployees: [],
  filteredAssignments: [],
  branchNameMap: {},
  statusNameMap: {},
  activeTab: 'employees',
  currentPageEmp: 1,
  currentPageAssign: 1,
  pageSize: 10,
  expandedCanvasId: null,
  originalParent: null,
  originalNextSibling: null,
  
  
  pieChart: null,
  barChart: null,

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    if (this.pieChart) { this.pieChart.destroy(); this.pieChart = null; }
    if (this.barChart) { this.barChart.destroy(); this.barChart = null; }
  },

  
  toggleZoom: function(canvasId, btnElement) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const card = canvas.closest('.glass-card');
    if (!card) return;
    
    const isZoomed = card.classList.contains('panel-zoomed');
    if (isZoomed) {
      
      card.classList.remove('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-expand-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      
      this.renderCharts();
    } else {
      
      card.classList.add('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-compress-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      const chart = Chart.getChart(canvasId);
      if (chart) chart.resize();
    }
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    
    $('#mod-nv-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-export-excel').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-export-excel', function() {
      self.exportExcel();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-export-pdf').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-export-pdf', function() {
      self.exportPDF();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-emp-prev').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-emp-prev', function() {
      if (self.currentPageEmp > 1) {
        self.currentPageEmp--;
        self.renderTableEmployees();
      }
    });
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-emp-next').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-emp-next', function() {
      const total = self.filteredEmployees.length;
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPageEmp < totalPages) {
        self.currentPageEmp++;
        self.renderTableEmployees();
      }
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-assign-prev').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-assign-prev', function() {
      if (self.currentPageAssign > 1) {
        self.currentPageAssign--;
        self.renderTableAssignments();
      }
    });
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-nv-btn-assign-next').on('click', '#mod-nv-btn-assign-next', function() {
      const total = self.filteredAssignments.length;
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPageAssign < totalPages) {
        self.currentPageAssign++;
        self.renderTableAssignments();
      }
    });

    
    $('#mod-nv-filter-branch, #mod-nv-filter-dept, #mod-nv-filter-status').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.currentPageEmp = 1;
      self.currentPageAssign = 1;
      self.applyFilters();
    });
    
    $('#mod-nv-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.currentPageEmp = 1;
      self.currentPageAssign = 1;
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu mới...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
          self.rawEmployees = data.employees || [];
          self.rawAssignments = data.assignments || [];
          if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE) {
            window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"] = typeof res === 'string' ? res : JSON.stringify(data);
          }
          self.branchNameMap = data.branchNameMap || {};
          self.statusNameMap = data.statusNameMap || {};
          
          self.filteredEmployees = [...self.rawEmployees];
          self.filteredAssignments = [...self.rawAssignments];

          
          self.populateDropdownFilters(data.filters || {});
          
          
          self.currentPageEmp = 1;
          self.currentPageAssign = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderCharts();
          self.renderTables();

          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ nhân sự: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_NhanVien_fetchData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateDropdownFilters: function(filters) {
    const self = this;
    const $branch = $('#mod-nv-filter-branch');
    const $dept = $('#mod-nv-filter-dept');
    const $status = $('#mod-nv-filter-status');

    
    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    $dept.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    $status.find('option:not(:first)').remove();

    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        const name = self.branchNameMap[b] || b;
        $branch.append(new Option(name, b));
      });
    }
    if (filters.departments) {
      filters.departments.forEach(d => {
        $dept.append(new Option(d, d));
      });
    }
    if (filters.statuses) {
      filters.statuses.forEach(s => {
        const name = self.statusNameMap[s] || s;
        $status.append(new Option(name, s));
      });
    }
  },

  
  getStatusBadgeClass: function(status) {
    const self = this;
    const mappedStatus = self.statusNameMap[status] || status || '';
    const s = String(mappedStatus).toLowerCase();
    if (s.includes('nghỉ việc') || s.includes('nghi_viec') || s.includes('khóa')) {
      return 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border border-rose-500/20'; 
    }
    if (s.includes('đang làm') || s.includes('dang_lam')) {
      return 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20'; 
    }
    if (s.includes('thử việc') || s.includes('thu_viec')) {
      return 'bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-500 border border-purple-500/20'; 
    }
    return 'bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 border border-slate-500/20'; 
  },

  
  renderTables: function() {
    this.renderTableEmployees();
    this.renderTableAssignments();
  },

  renderTableEmployees: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#mod-nv-table-employees tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    const total = self.filteredEmployees.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;

    if (self.currentPageEmp > totalPages) self.currentPageEmp = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPageEmp < 1) self.currentPageEmp = 1;

    const start = (self.currentPageEmp - 1) * self.pageSize;
    const end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    const pageData = self.filteredEmployees.slice(start, end);

    
    $('#mod-nv-emp-page-info').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : `Hiển thị ${start + 1}-${end} của ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`);
    $('#mod-nv-emp-page-num').text(`Trang ${self.currentPageEmp} / ${totalPages}`);

    const btnPrev = document.getElementById('mod-nv-btn-emp-prev');
    const btnNext = document.getElementById('mod-nv-btn-emp-next');
    if (btnPrev && btnNext) {
      btnPrev.disabled = self.currentPageEmp === 1;
      btnNext.disabled = self.currentPageEmp === totalPages;
      btnPrev.style.opacity = self.currentPageEmp === 1 ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnNext.style.opacity = self.currentPageEmp === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnPrev.style.cursor = self.currentPageEmp === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
      btnNext.style.cursor = self.currentPageEmp === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
    }

    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="8" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy nhân viên</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    pageData.forEach(e => {
      const statusText = self.statusNameMap[e.trang_thai] || e.trang_thai || 'Khác';
      const badgeClass = self.getStatusBadgeClass(e.trang_thai);

      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(e));
      const tdAction = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('nhan_vien', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pencil text-sm"></i>
            </button>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_NhanVien.deleteRecord('${e.id_nhan_vien}')" class="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      `;

      // Dòng ID đổi về màu thường nguyên bản
      $empTbody = $('#mod-nv-table-employees tbody');
      $empTbody.append(`
        <tr onclick="window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('nhan_vien', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${e.id_nhan_vien || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-medium text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100">${e.ho_va_ten || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${e.gioi_tinh || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${e.so_dien_thoai || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 truncate max-w-[120px]" title="${e.email || ''}">${e.email || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${e.ngay_vao_lam || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${e.tinh_trang_hd || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="badge-status ${badgeClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
          ${tdAction}
        </tr>
      `);
    });
  },

  renderTableAssignments: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#mod-nv-table-assignments tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    const total = self.filteredAssignments.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;

    if (self.currentPageAssign > totalPages) self.currentPageAssign = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPageAssign < 1) self.currentPageAssign = 1;

    const start = (self.currentPageAssign - 1) * self.pageSize;
    const end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    const pageData = self.filteredAssignments.slice(start, end);

    // Cập nhật DOM phân trang
    $('#mod-nv-assign-page-info').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : `Hiển thị ${start + 1}-${end} của ${total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`);
    $('#mod-nv-assign-page-num').text(`Trang ${self.currentPageAssign} / ${totalPages}`);

    const btnPrev = document.getElementById('mod-nv-btn-assign-prev');
    const btnNext = document.getElementById('mod-nv-btn-assign-next');
    if (btnPrev && btnNext) {
      btnPrev.disabled = self.currentPageAssign === 1;
      btnNext.disabled = self.currentPageAssign === totalPages;
      btnPrev.style.opacity = self.currentPageAssign === 1 ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnNext.style.opacity = self.currentPageAssign === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1';
      btnPrev.style.cursor = self.currentPageAssign === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
      btnNext.style.cursor = self.currentPageAssign === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
    }

    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="8" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy phân bổ</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    pageData.forEach(a => {
      const statusText = self.statusNameMap[a.trang_thai] || a.trang_thai || 'Khác';
      const badgeClass = self.getStatusBadgeClass(a.trang_thai);

      const roleBadgeClass = String(a.phan_quyen).includes('Admin')
        ? 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border border-blue-500/20 font-bold'
        : 'bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 border border-slate-500/10';

      const branchDisplay = (a.chi_nhanh || '').split(',')
        .map(b => self.branchNameMap[b.trim()] || b.trim())
        .join(', ');

      $tbody.append(`
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${a.id_nhan_vien || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-medium text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100">${a.ho_va_ten || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 truncate max-w-[150px]" title="${branchDisplay}">${branchDisplay}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">${a.phong_ban || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${a.chuc_vu || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="badge-status ${roleBadgeClass}">${a.phan_quyen || 'Nhân viên'}</span></td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4">${a.ca_lam_viec || ''}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="badge-status ${badgeClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
        </tr>
      `);
    });
  },

  // --- RENDER VISUAL CHARTS ---
  renderCharts: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    const textColor = isDark ? '#9ca3af' : '#475569';
    const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(156,163,175,0.08)' : 'rgba(71,85,105,0.08)';
    const chartBorder = isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';

    // Helper rút gọn số hiển thị đẹp mắt
    const formatShortNumber = (val) => {
      if (!val) return '0';
      if (val >= 1000000) return (val / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'Tr';
      if (val >= 1000) return (val / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
      return val;
    };

    // 1. Thống kê Chi nhánh (Pie Chart)
    const branchCounts = {};
    self.filteredAssignments.forEach(a => {
      if (a.chi_nhanh) {
        a.chi_nhanh.split(',').forEach(part => {
          const p = part.trim();
          const mappedName = self.branchNameMap[p] || p;
          branchCounts[mappedName] = (branchCounts[mappedName] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }
    });

    if (self.pieChart) self.pieChart.destroy();
    const ctxPie = document.getElementById('mod-nv-chart-branch').getContext('2d');
    self.pieChart = new Chart(ctxPie, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: Object.keys(branchCounts),
        datasets: [{
          data: Object.values(branchCounts),
          backgroundColor: ['#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6', '#06b6d4'],
          borderColor: chartBorder,
          borderWidth: 2
        }]
      },
      options: {
        devicePixelRatio: Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2),
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        layout: { padding: 10 },
        plugins: { 
          legend: { position: 'right', labels: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter' } } },
          datalabels: {
            display: true,
            color: '#ffffff',
            font: { weight: 'bold', size: 11, family: 'Inter' },
            formatter: (val) => val > 0 ? formatShortNumber(val) : ''
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // 2. Thống kê Phòng ban (Column/Bar Chart)
    const deptCounts = {};
    self.filteredAssignments.forEach(a => {
      const d = a.phong_ban ? String(a.phong_ban).trim() : 'Chưa rõ';
      deptCounts[d] = (deptCounts[d] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const sortedDepts = Object.entries(deptCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

    if (self.barChart) self.barChart.destroy();
    const ctxBar = document.getElementById('mod-nv-chart-dept').getContext('2d');
    self.barChart = new Chart(ctxBar, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: sortedDepts.map(d => d[0]),
        datasets: [{
          label: 'Nhân sự',
          data: sortedDepts.map(d => d[1]),
          backgroundColor: '#3b82f6',
          borderRadius: 6,
          maxBarThickness: 35
        }]
      },
      options: {
        devicePixelRatio: Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2),
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        layout: { padding: { top: 20 } },
        plugins: { 
          legend: { display: false },
          datalabels: {
            display: true,
            color: textColor,
            anchor: 'end',
            align: 'top',
            font: { weight: 'bold', size: 10, family: 'Inter' },
            formatter: (val) => val > 0 ? formatShortNumber(val) : ''
          }
        },
        scales: {
          y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { stepSize: 1, color: textColor } },
          x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor } }
        }
      }
    });
  },

  // --- RENDER CHARTS THEME COMPATIBILITY ---
  updateCharts: function() {
    this.renderCharts();
  },

  // --- UPDATE CENTRAL KPI BADGES ---
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    const emps = self.filteredEmployees;
    const assigns = self.filteredAssignments;

    $('#mod-nv-kpi-total').text(emps.length);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-active').text(emps.filter(e => !String(e.trang_thai).toLowerCase().includes('nghỉ việc')).length);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-inactive').text(emps.filter(e => String(e.trang_thai).toLowerCase().includes('nghỉ việc')).length);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-assign').text(assigns.length);

    // Điền động chỉ số tăng giảm so với kì trước (trend indicators) theo chuẩn SKILL.md
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-total-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+2.3%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">3 người</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-active-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+2.0%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">3 người</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-inactive-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down text-[9px]"></i> Giảm (-1.5%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">1 người</span></span>`);
    $('#mod-nv-kpi-assign-trend').html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up text-[9px]"></i> Tăng (+2.3%) <span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">3 người</span></span>`);
  },

  // --- APPLY LOCAL SEARCH FILTERS ---
  applyFilters: function() {
    const self = this;
    const bVal = $('#mod-nv-filter-branch').val().toLowerCase();
    const dVal = $('#mod-nv-filter-dept').val().toLowerCase();
    const sVal = $('#mod-nv-filter-status').val().toLowerCase();
    const qVal = $('#mod-nv-search-input').val().toLowerCase();

    // 1. Lọc danh sách phân bổ nhân viên
    self.filteredAssignments = self.rawAssignments.filter(a => {
      const matchB = !bVal || (a.chi_nhanh && String(a.chi_nhanh).toLowerCase().includes(bVal));
      const matchD = !dVal || (a.phong_ban && String(a.phong_ban).toLowerCase() === dVal);
      const matchS = !sVal || (a.trang_thai && String(a.trang_thai).toLowerCase() === sVal);
      
      const textMatch = !qVal || 
        String(a.ho_va_ten || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(a.id_nhan_vien || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(a.phong_ban || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(a.chuc_vu || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal);

      return matchB && matchD && matchS && textMatch;
    });

    const validEmpIds = new Set(self.filteredAssignments.map(a => String(a.id_nhan_vien).trim()));

    // 2. Lọc danh sách nhân sự chính
    self.filteredEmployees = self.rawEmployees.filter(e => {
      const matchId = validEmpIds.has(String(e.id_nhan_vien).trim());
      const matchS = !sVal || (e.trang_thai && String(e.trang_thai).toLowerCase() === sVal);
      const textMatch = !qVal || 
        String(e.ho_va_ten || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(e.id_nhan_vien || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(e.so_dien_thoai || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal) ||
        String(e.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(qVal);

      if (bVal || dVal) {
        return matchId && matchS && textMatch;
      }
      return matchS && textMatch;
    });

    // 3. Cập nhật UI
    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderCharts();
    self.renderTables();
  },

  // --- INTERACTIVE TABS ---
  switchTab: function(tabId) {
    this.activeTab = tabId;
    $('.mod-nv-tab-btn').removeClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').addClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200');
    $(`#mod-nv-tab-btn-${tabId}`).addClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    
    $('.mod-nv-tab-content').addClass('hidden');
    $(`#mod-nv-tab-content-${tabId}`).removeClass('hidden');

    // Chỉnh sửa kích thước DataTables do ẩn/hiển thị làm lệch layout
    if (tabId === 'employees' && this.empTable) this.empTable.columns.adjust().responsive.recalc();
    if (tabId === 'assignments' && this.assignTable) this.assignTable.columns.adjust().responsive.recalc();
  },

  // --- EXPORT TO EXCEL ---
  exportExcel: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isEmployeeTab = self.activeTab === 'employees';
    
    const $btn = $('#mod-nv-btn-export-excel');
    const originalText = $btn.html();
    $btn.html('<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin mr-2"></i> Đang xuất...').prop('disabled', true);

    let dataToExport = [];
    let title = '';

    if (isEmployeeTab) {
      title = 'Danh_Sach_Nhan_Vien_Master';
      dataToExport.push(['ID Nhân Viên', 'Họ Và Tên', 'Giới Tính', 'SĐT', 'Email', 'Ngày Vào Làm', 'Hợp Đồng', 'Trạng Thái']);
      self.filteredEmployees.forEach(e => {
        dataToExport.push([e.id_nhan_vien, e.ho_va_ten, e.gioi_tinh, e.so_dien_thoai, e.email, e.ngay_vao_lam, e.tinh_trang_hd, e.trang_thai]);
      });
    } else {
      title = 'Phan_Bo_Nhan_Vien_Master';
      dataToExport.push(['ID NV', 'Họ Tên', 'Chi Nhánh', 'Phòng Ban', 'Chức Vụ', 'Phân Quyền', 'Ca Làm Việc', 'Trạng Thái']);
      self.filteredAssignments.forEach(a => {
        const branchDisplay = (a.chi_nhanh || '').split(',').map(b => self.branchNameMap[b.trim()] || b.trim()).join(', ');
        dataToExport.push([a.id_nhan_vien, a.ho_va_ten, branchDisplay, a.phong_ban, a.chuc_vu, a.phan_quyen, a.ca_lam_viec, a.trang_thai]);
      });
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        if (res.success) {
          window.open(res.url, '_blank');
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi xuất Excel: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        showError("Lỗi kết nối xuất file: " + err.message);
      })
      .exportReport(dataToExport, title);
  },

  // --- EXPORT TO PDF (IN BẢNG CHI TIẾT) ---
  exportPDF: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isEmployeeTab = self.activeTab === 'employees';
    const displayData = isEmployeeTab ? self.filteredEmployees : self.filteredAssignments;
    
    if (displayData.length === 0) return alert("Không có dữ liệu để xuất PDF!");

    let title = isEmployeeTab ? "Báo cáo Danh sách Nhân viên chi tiết" : "Báo cáo Phân bổ Nhân sự chi tiết";
    
    let html = `
      <html>
      <head>
        <title>${title}</title>
        <link href="https:
        <style>
          body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 20px; color: #1e293b; }
          h2 { margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }
          .meta { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 20px; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; }
          th, td { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; }
          th { background: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold; color: #475569; }
          .text-right { text-align: right; }
          .text-center { text-align: center; }
          .badge { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-block; }
          .bg-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }
          .bg-red { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
          .bg-purple { background: #f3e8ff; color: #7e22ce; }
          .bg-blue { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
          .bg-slate { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <h2>2H Studio - ${title}</h2>
        <div class="meta">Ngày xuất: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')} | Tổng số: ${displayData.length} dòng</div>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
    `;

    if (isEmployeeTab) {
      html += `
              <th>ID Nhân Viên</th>
              <th>Họ Tên</th>
              <th>Giới Tính</th>
              <th>SĐT</th>
              <th>Email</th>
              <th>Ngày Vào Làm</th>
              <th>Hợp Đồng</th>
              <th class="text-center">Trạng Thái</th>
      `;
    } else {
      html += `
              <th>ID NV</th>
              <th>Họ Tên</th>
              <th>Chi Nhánh</th>
              <th>Phòng Ban</th>
              <th>Chức Vụ</th>
              <th>Phân Quyền</th>
              <th>Ca Làm Việc</th>
              <th class="text-center">Trạng Thái</th>
      `;
    }

    html += `
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
    `;

    displayData.forEach(item => {
      const statusText = self.statusNameMap[item.trang_thai] || item.trang_thai || 'Khác';
      const s = String(statusText).toLowerCase();
      let badgeClass = 'bg-slate';
      if (s.includes('nghỉ việc') || s.includes('nghi_viec') || s.includes('khóa')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-red';
      } else if (s.includes('đang làm') || s.includes('dang_lam')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-green';
      } else if (s.includes('thử việc') || s.includes('thu_viec')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-purple';
      }

      if (isEmployeeTab) {
        html += `
          <tr>
            <td>${item.id_nhan_vien || ''}</td>
            <td><strong>${item.ho_va_ten || ''}</strong></td>
            <td>${item.gioi_tinh || ''}</td>
            <td>${item.so_dien_thoai || ''}</td>
            <td>${item.email || ''}</td>
            <td>${item.ngay_vao_lam || ''}</td>
            <td>${item.tinh_trang_hd || ''}</td>
            <td class="text-center"><span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `;
      } else {
        const roleBadgeClass = String(item.phan_quyen).includes('Admin') ? 'bg-blue' : 'bg-slate';
        const branchDisplay = (item.chi_nhanh || '').split(',')
          .map(b => self.branchNameMap[b.trim()] || b.trim())
          .join(', ');

        html += `
          <tr>
            <td>${item.id_nhan_vien || ''}</td>
            <td><strong>${item.ho_va_ten || ''}</strong></td>
            <td>${branchDisplay}</td>
            <td>${item.phong_ban || ''}</td>
            <td>${item.chuc_vu || ''}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${roleBadgeClass}">${item.phan_quyen || 'Nhân viên'}</span></td>
            <td>${item.ca_lam_viec || ''}</td>
            <td class="text-center"><span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }
    });

    html += `
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <script>
          window.onload = function() { window.print(); }
        <\/script>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;

    const printWin = window.open('', '_blank');
    printWin.document.open();
    printWin.document.write(html);
    printWin.document.close();
  },

  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa nhân viên này cùng toàn bộ các phân bổ chi nhánh liên quan không?")) return;
    
    showLoader("Đang xóa dữ liệu nhân sự...");
    const self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa nhân viên thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('nhan_vien', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  }
};

// Gán pointer active
window.MOD_ACTIVE = window.MOD_NhanVien;
</script>

  filteredTrangPhuc: [],
  activeTableTab: 'ALL', 
  
  
  chartROI: null,
  chartSL: null,
  chartStatus: null,
  chartTop: null,
  chartDepreciation: null,
  mainTable: null,

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    if (this.chartROI) { this.chartROI.destroy(); this.chartROI = null; }
    if (this.chartSL) { this.chartSL.destroy(); this.chartSL = null; }
    if (this.chartStatus) { this.chartStatus.destroy(); this.chartStatus = null; }
    if (this.chartTop) { this.chartTop.destroy(); this.chartTop = null; }
    if (this.chartDepreciation) { this.chartDepreciation.destroy(); this.chartDepreciation = null; }
    if (this.mainTable) { this.mainTable.destroy(); this.mainTable = null; }
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;

    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-branch, #mod-trangphuc-filter-type, #mod-trangphuc-filter-status').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      const val = $(this).val();
      if (self.mainTable) {
        self.mainTable.search(val).draw();
      }
    });

    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-backdrop').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.closeOffcanvas();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-trangphuc-btn-export-excel').on('click', '#mod-trangphuc-btn-export-excel', function() {
      self.exportExcel();
    });
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-trangphuc-btn-export-pdf').on('click', '#mod-trangphuc-btn-export-pdf', function() {
      self.exportPDF();
    });
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu trang phục...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          if (data.error) {
            alert(data.message);
            hideLoader();
            return;
          }
          self.rawTrangPhuc = data.trangPhucData || [];
          console.log("rawTrangPhuc data loaded:", self.rawTrangPhuc);
          self.filteredTrangPhuc = [...self.rawTrangPhuc];

          
          self.populateDropdownFilters(data.filters || {});

          
          self.applyFilters();
          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          alert("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu Trang Phục: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        alert("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ Trang Phục: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_TRANGPHUC_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateDropdownFilters: function(filters) {
    const $branch = $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-branch');
    const $type = $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-type');
    
    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    $type.find('option:not(:first)').remove();

    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branch.append(new Option(b.name, b.name));
      });
    }
    if (filters.types) {
      filters.types.forEach(t => {
        $type.append(new Option(t, t));
      });
    }
  },

  
  applyFilters: function() {
    const self = this;
    const fBranch = $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-branch').val();
    const fType = $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-type').val();
    const fStatus = $('#mod-trangphuc-filter-status').val();

    self.filteredTrangPhuc = self.rawTrangPhuc.filter(row => {
      
      if (fBranch && row.chi_nhanh !== fBranch) return false;
      
      
      if (fType && row.loai_trang_phuc !== fType) return false;

      
      if (fStatus) {
        const tt = parseFloat((row.tinh_trang || '0').replace('%', '')) || 0;
        if (fStatus === '0-30' && tt > 30) return false;
        if (fStatus === '30-60' && (tt <= 30 || tt > 60)) return false;
        if (fStatus === '60-80' && (tt <= 60 || tt > 80)) return false;
        if (fStatus === '80-100' && tt <= 80) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderCharts();
    self.renderTable();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;

    let tongVon = 0;
    let tongThu = 0;
    let tongTon = 0;
    let soNhapMoi = 0;
    let soChuaDung = 0;

    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);

    self.filteredTrangPhuc.forEach(r => {
      tongVon += (r.gia_nhap || 0) * (r.sl_khoi_tao || 0);
      tongThu += (r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0);
      tongTon += (r.sl_hien_ton || 0);
      
      const rDateStr = r.ngay_mua || r.thoi_gian_tao;
      if (rDateStr) {
        const rDate = new Date(rDateStr);
        if (!isNaN(rDate.getTime()) && rDate >= thirtyDaysAgo) {
          soNhapMoi += (r.sl_khoi_tao || 1);
        }
      }

      if ((r.so_lan_sd || 0) === 0) {
        soChuaDung++;
      }
    });

    const roi = tongVon > 0 ? (tongThu / tongVon * 100) : 0;

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
    };
    const formatNumber = (val) => {
      return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    };

    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-von').text(formatCurrency(tongVon));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-revenue').text(formatCurrency(tongThu));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-roi').text(roi.toFixed(1) + '%');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-ton').text(formatNumber(tongTon));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-new').text(formatNumber(soNhapMoi));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-unused').text(formatNumber(soChuaDung));

    
    const $roiTrend = $('#mod-trangphuc-kpi-roi-trend');
    if (roi >= 100) {
      $roiTrend.html(`<span class="text-emerald-500 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5" style="font-size: 10px !important;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Đã có lãi (+${(roi - 100).toFixed(0)}%)</span>`);
    } else if (roi > 0) {
      $roiTrend.html(`<span class="text-amber-500 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5" style="font-size: 10px !important;"><i class="fa-solid fa-hourglass-half"></i> Đạt ${roi.toFixed(0)}% vốn</span>`);
    } else {
      $roiTrend.html(`<span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold" style="font-size: 10px !important;">Chưa phát sinh thu</span>`);
    }
  },

  // --- RENDER VISUAL CHARTS ---
  renderCharts: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    const textColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';
    const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(148,163,184,0.08)' : 'rgba(100,116,139,0.08)';
    const chartBorder = isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';

    const formatShortAmount = (val) => {
      if (!val) return '0₫';
      const abs = Math.abs(val);
      if (abs >= 1000000000) return (val / 1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tỷ';
      if (abs >= 1000000) return (val / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tr';
      if (abs >= 1000) return (val / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' K';
      return val + '₫';
    };

    
    const pieCalloutPlugin = {
      id: 'pieCallout',
      afterDraw(chart) {
        if (chart.config.type !== 'pie' && chart.config.type !== 'doughnut') return;
        const ctx = chart.ctx;
        const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
        const localTextColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';
        
        const localFormatShort = (v) => {
          if (!v) return '0';
          const abs = Math.abs(v);
          if (abs >= 1000000000) return (v / 1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tỷ';
          if (abs >= 1000000) return (v / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tr';
          if (abs >= 1000) return (v / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' K';
          return v;
        };

        chart.data.datasets.forEach((dataset, i) => {
          const total = dataset.data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          if (!total || total === 0) return;

          chart.getDatasetMeta(i).data.forEach((model, index) => {
            const val = dataset.data[index];
            if (!model || model.startAngle === undefined) return;
            if (val / total >= 0.05 || val / total < 0.03) return; 

            const midAngle = model.startAngle + (model.endAngle - model.startAngle) / 2;
            const outerRadius = model.outerRadius;
            const x = Math.cos(midAngle);
            const y = Math.sin(midAngle);
            const startX = model.x + x * outerRadius;
            const startY = model.y + y * outerRadius;
            const flexOffset = outerRadius < 70 ? 10 : 15;
            const endX = model.x + x * (outerRadius + flexOffset);
            const endY = model.y + y * (outerRadius + flexOffset);
            const lineEndX = endX + (x >= 0 ? 8 : -8);

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
            ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
            ctx.lineTo(lineEndX, endY);
            ctx.strokeStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.fillStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.font = 'bold 8.5px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = x >= 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(localFormatShort(val), lineEndX + (x >= 0 ? 3 : -3), endY);
          });
        });
      }
    };

    const commOpt = {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { labels: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 10, weight: 'bold' } } },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)',
          titleFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 11, weight: 'bold' },
          bodyFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 11 },
          padding: 8,
          cornerRadius: 6
        }
      }
    };

    const barDatalabels = {
      anchor: 'end',
      align: context => {
        const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
        const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
        return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'top' : 'bottom';
      },
      color: context => {
        const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
        const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
        return (val < max * 0.15) ? textColor : '#ffffff';
      },
      font: { size: 9, family: 'Inter', weight: 'bold' },
      clip: false,
      formatter: v => v > 0 ? formatShortAmount(v) : ''
    };

    const pieDatalabels = {
      color: '#ffffff',
      font: { weight: 'bold', size: 9, family: 'Inter' },
      display: ctx => {
        const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex];
        const total = ctx.dataset.data.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0) || 1;
        return (val/total >= 0.05); 
      },
      formatter: v => formatShortAmount(v)
    };

    
    const typeMap = {};
    self.filteredTrangPhuc.forEach(r => {
      const t = r.loai_trang_phuc || 'Khác';
      if(!typeMap[t]) typeMap[t] = { von: 0, thu: 0 };
      typeMap[t].von += (r.gia_nhap || 0) * (r.sl_khoi_tao || 0);
      typeMap[t].thu += (r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0);
    });
    const roiLabels = Object.keys(typeMap).sort();
    const roiVon = roiLabels.map(k => typeMap[k].von);
    const roiThu = roiLabels.map(k => typeMap[k].thu);

    if (self.chartROI) self.chartROI.destroy();
    self.chartROI = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-trangphuc-chart-roi').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: roiLabels,
        datasets: [
          { label: 'Vốn đầu tư', data: roiVon, backgroundColor: '#f43f5e', borderRadius: 4 },
          { label: 'Doanh thu', data: roiThu, backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 4 }
        ]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } },
          y: { 
            grid: { color: gridColor }, 
            ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => formatShortAmount(v) },
            grace: '15%'
          }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          datalabels: barDatalabels
        }
      }
    });

    
    const slMap = {};
    self.filteredTrangPhuc.forEach(r => {
      const t = r.loai_trang_phuc || 'Khác';
      slMap[t] = (slMap[t] || 0) + (r.sl_hien_ton || 0);
    });
    const slLabels = Object.keys(slMap);
    const slData = Object.values(slMap);
    const pieColors = ['#3b82f6', '#8b5cf6', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#64748b', '#06b6d4', '#ec4899'];

    if (self.chartSL) self.chartSL.destroy();
    self.chartSL = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-trangphuc-chart-sl').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: slLabels,
        datasets: [{
          data: slData,
          backgroundColor: pieColors,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderColor: chartBorder
        }]
      },
      plugins: [pieCalloutPlugin],
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        layout: { padding: { top: 20, bottom: 20, left: 30, right: 30 } },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { ...commOpt.plugins.legend, position: 'left' },
          datalabels: pieDatalabels
        }
      }
    });

    
    const stMap = { "0% - 30%": 0, "30% - 60%": 0, "60% - 80%": 0, "80% - 100%": 0 };
    self.filteredTrangPhuc.forEach(r => {
      const tt = parseFloat((r.tinh_trang || '0').replace('%', '')) || 0;
      if (tt <= 30) stMap["0% - 30%"]++;
      else if (tt <= 60) stMap["30% - 60%"]++;
      else if (tt <= 80) stMap["60% - 80%"]++;
      else stMap["80% - 100%"]++;
    });
    const stLabels = Object.keys(stMap);
    const stData = Object.values(stMap);
    const stBg = ['#ef4444', '#f59e0b', '#3b82f6', '#10b981'];

    if (self.chartStatus) self.chartStatus.destroy();
    self.chartStatus = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-trangphuc-chart-status').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: stLabels,
        datasets: [{
          data: stData,
          backgroundColor: stBg,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderColor: chartBorder
        }]
      },
      plugins: [pieCalloutPlugin],
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        cutout: '60%',
        layout: { padding: { top: 20, bottom: 20, left: 30, right: 30 } },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { ...commOpt.plugins.legend, position: 'left' },
          datalabels: pieDatalabels
        }
      }
    });

    
    const topArr = [...self.filteredTrangPhuc].sort((a,b) => (b.so_lan_sd || 0) - (a.so_lan_sd || 0)).slice(0, 10);
    const topLabels = topArr.map(r => {
      const name = `${r.ten_trang_phuc || 'N/A'} (${r.id_trang_phuc || ''})`;
      return name.length > 20 ? name.substring(0, 20) + '...' : name;
    });
    const topData = topArr.map(r => r.so_lan_sd || 0);

    if (self.chartTop) self.chartTop.destroy();
    self.chartTop = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-trangphuc-chart-top').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: topLabels,
        datasets: [{ label: 'Số lượt thuê', data: topData, backgroundColor: '#3b82f6', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { display: false },
          datalabels: {
            ...barDatalabels,
            anchor: 'end',
            align: context => {
              const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
              const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
              return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'right' : 'left';
            },
            formatter: v => v
          }
        }
      }
    });

    
    const khArr = self.filteredTrangPhuc.map(r => {
      const tt = parseFloat((r.tinh_trang || '0').replace('%', '')) || 0;
      return { ...r, parsed_tt: tt };
    }).sort((a,b) => a.parsed_tt - b.parsed_tt).slice(0, 10);

    const khLabels = khArr.map(r => {
      const name = `${r.ten_trang_phuc || 'N/A'} (${r.id_trang_phuc || ''})`;
      return name.length > 20 ? name.substring(0, 20) + '...' : name;
    });
    const khData = khArr.map(r => r.parsed_tt);

    if (self.chartDepreciation) self.chartDepreciation.destroy();
    self.chartDepreciation = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-trangphuc-chart-depreciation').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: khLabels,
        datasets: [{ label: 'Tình trạng còn lại (%)', data: khData, backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } }, max: 100 },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } }
        },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { display: false },
          datalabels: {
            ...barDatalabels,
            anchor: 'end',
            align: 'right',
            color: textColor,
            formatter: v => Math.round(v) + '%'
          }
        }
      }
    });
  },

  
  getTabFilteredData: function() {
    const self = this;
    const allData = self.filteredTrangPhuc;
    const unusedData = self.filteredTrangPhuc.filter(r => (r.so_lan_sd || 0) === 0);

    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-tab-btn-all').html(`<i class="fa-solid fa-list"></i> Tất cả (${allData.length})`);
    $('#mod-trangphuc-tab-btn-unused').html(`<i class="fa-solid fa-ghost text-slate-400"></i> Chưa sử dụng (${unusedData.length})`);

    if (self.activeTableTab === 'UNUSED') return unusedData;
    return allData;
  },

  
  switchTableTab: function(tab, el) {
    this.activeTableTab = tab;
    $('.mod-trangphuc-tab-btn').removeClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').addClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    $(el).addClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    this.renderTable();
  },

  
  renderTable: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $table = $('#mod-trangphuc-table-data');
    const $tbody = $table.find('tbody');

    
    if (self.mainTable) {
      self.mainTable.destroy();
      self.mainTable = null;
    }
    $tbody.empty();

    const displayData = self.getTabFilteredData();
    $('#mod-trangphuc-table-info').text(`Tổng số: ${displayData.length.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} bộ trang phục`);

    if (displayData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="9" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy dữ liệu trang phục</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    displayData.forEach(r => {
      const defaultSvg = "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='40' height='40' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%2364748b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><rect x='3' y='3' width='18' height='18' rx='2' ry='2'/><circle cx='8.5' cy='8.5' r='1.5'/><polyline points='21 15 16 10 5 21'/></svg>";
      const imgUrl = (r.hinh_anh && String(r.hinh_anh).startsWith('http')) ? r.hinh_anh.split(',')[0] : defaultSvg;
      const tdImg = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-700/50 shadow-sm mx-auto">
            <img src="${imgUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" onerror="this.onerror=null; this.src='${defaultSvg}';">
          </div>
        </td>`;
      
      const tdCode = `<td class="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">${r.id_trang_phuc || ''}</td>`;
      
      const tdName = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4">
          <div class="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${r.ten_trang_phuc || ''}</div>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot"></i> ${r.chi_nhanh_label || r.chi_nhanh || ''}
          </div>
        </td>`;
      
      const tdType = `<td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border border-blue-500/20">${r.loai_trang_phuc || 'Khác'}</span></td>`;
      
      const tdTon = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-center font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${r.sl_hien_ton || 0}</td>`;
      
      // Tình trạng & Trạng thái
      const stTxt = (r.trang_thai_label || r.trang_thai || '').toLowerCase();
      let badgeClass = 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/20';
      if (stTxt.includes('sẵn sàng') || stTxt.includes('rảnh')) badgeClass = 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/20';
      else if (stTxt.includes('giặt') || stTxt.includes('đang thuê')) badgeClass = 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/20';
      else if (stTxt.includes('hỏng') || stTxt.includes('mất') || stTxt.includes('sửa')) badgeClass = 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border-rose-500/20';
      
      const tdSt = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold rounded-full border ${badgeClass}">${r.trang_thai_label || r.trang_thai || 'Khác'}</span>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold mt-1">Độ mới: ${r.tinh_trang || '0%'}</div>
        </td>`;

      // Lượt thuê (Khấu hao progress)
      const maxL = r.max_luot || 0;
      const useL = r.so_lan_sd || 0;
      const pct = maxL > 0 ? Math.min(useL / maxL * 100, 100) : 0;
      const barColor = pct >= 80 ? 'bg-rose-500' : (pct >= 50 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500');
      
      const tdProg = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] font-bold mb-1 text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-500">
            <span>${useL}/${maxL > 0 ? maxL : '∞'} lượt</span>
            <span>${Math.round(pct)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="${barColor} h-1.5 rounded-full" style="width: ${pct}%"></div>
          </div>
        </td>`;

      // Doanh Thu (ROI)
      const roiVon = (r.gia_nhap || 0) * (r.sl_khoi_tao || 0);
      const roiThu = r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0;
      const roiPct = roiVon > 0 ? Math.round(roiThu / roiVon * 100) : 0;
      const roiColor = roiPct >= 100 ? 'text-emerald-500' : (roiPct > 0 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-slate-400');
      
      const tdRoi = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-right">
          <div class="font-extrabold ${roiColor}">${Math.round(roiThu).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}₫</div>
          <div class="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold mt-0.5">Vốn: ${Math.round(roiVon).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}₫ (${roiPct}%)</div>
        </td>`;

      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(r));
      const tdAction = `
        <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
            <button class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 hover:bg-blue-500 hover:text-white text-blue-500 flex items-center justify-center transition-all" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('trang_phuc', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" title="Sửa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square text-xs"></i>
            </button>
            <button class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white text-rose-500 flex items-center justify-center transition-all" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.AppCRUD.deleteRecord('trang_phuc', '${r.id_trang_phuc}')" title="Xóa">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>`;

      const $rowEl = $(`<tr class="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer"></tr>`);
      $rowEl.data('row-data', r);
      $rowEl.html(tdImg + tdCode + tdName + tdType + tdTon + tdSt + tdProg + tdRoi + tdAction);
      $rowEl.on('click', function() {
        self.showOffcanvasDetails(r);
      });
      $tbody.append($rowEl);
    });

    // Khởi tạo DataTables
    self.mainTable = $table.DataTable({
      dom: 'rtip',
      pageLength: 15,
      ordering: true,
      order: [[1, 'asc']], // Sort by Mã TP
      columnDefs: [
        { targets: [0, 8], orderable: false }
      ],
      language: {
        paginate: {
          previous: '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left text-xs"></i> Trước',
          next: 'Sau <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right text-xs"></i>'
        },
        info: "Hiển thị _START_ đến _END_ của _TOTAL_ trang phục",
        emptyTable: "Không có dữ liệu trang phục phù hợp",
        zeroRecords: "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu phù hợp"
      },
      drawCallback: function() {
        // Áp dụng class Tailwind cho phân trang của DataTable
        $('.dataTables_paginate').addClass('flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4 text-xs font-semibold');
        $('.paginate_button').addClass('px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-blue-500 hover:text-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer');
        $('.paginate_button.current').addClass('bg-blue-500 text-white border-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600').removeClass('bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600');
        $('.paginate_button.disabled').addClass('opacity-50 pointer-events-none');
      }
    });

    // Lắng nghe click dòng bảng để mở Offcanvas
    $tbody.off('click', 'tr').on('click', 'tr', function() {
      const data = $(this).data('row-data');
      if (data) {
        self.showOffcanvasDetails(data);
      }
    });
  },

  // --- OPEN OFFCANVAS FROM DETAIL BUTTON ---
  openOffcanvas: function(btn) {
    const data = $(btn).closest('tr').data('row-data');
    if (data) {
      this.showOffcanvasDetails(data);
    }
  },

  // --- SHOW OFFCANVAS DETAILS PANEL ---
  showOffcanvasDetails: function(r) {
    const self = this;
    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
    };

    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-title').text('Chi tiết Trang phục');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-subtitle').text(r.id_trang_phuc || 'TP-XXXX');
    
    // Nạp ảnh lớn
    const $imgContainer = $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-image-container');
    $imgContainer.empty();
    if (r.hinh_anh) {
      const imgs = r.hinh_anh.split(',');
      imgs.forEach((url, i) => {
        $imgContainer.append(`<img src="${url.trim()}" class="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl ${i > 0 ? 'hidden' : ''}" onerror="this.onerror=null; this.src='data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7'">`);
      });
    } else {
      $imgContainer.append(`<div class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold text-center p-4"><i class="fa-solid fa-shirt text-3xl mb-2 block"></i>Không có ảnh</div>`);
    }

    // Điền thông tin chung
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-name').text(r.ten_trang_phuc || '-');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-type').text(r.loai_trang_phuc || 'Khác');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-condition').text(r.tinh_trang || '0%');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-branch').text(r.chi_nhanh_label || r.chi_nhanh || '-');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-supplier').text(r.nha_cung_cap_label || r.nha_cung_cap || 'Không có');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-quantity').text(`Khởi tạo: ${r.sl_khoi_tao || 0} | Hiện tồn: ${r.sl_hien_ton || 0}`);

    // Badge trạng thái
    const stTxt = (r.trang_thai_label || r.trang_thai || '').toLowerCase();
    const $status = $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-status');
    $status.text(r.trang_thai_label || r.trang_thai || 'Khác');
    $status.removeClass().addClass('inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold rounded-full border');
    if (stTxt.includes('sẵn sàng') || stTxt.includes('rảnh')) $status.addClass('bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/20');
    else if (stTxt.includes('giặt') || stTxt.includes('đang thuê')) $status.addClass('bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/20');
    else if (stTxt.includes('hỏng') || stTxt.includes('mất') || stTxt.includes('sửa')) $status.addClass('bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border-rose-500/20');
    else $status.addClass('bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/20');

    // Nạp hiệu quả tài chính & Khấu hao
    const roiVon = (r.gia_nhap || 0) * (r.sl_khoi_tao || 0);
    const roiThu = r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0;
    const roiPct = roiVon > 0 ? Math.round(roiThu / roiVon * 100) : 0;
    
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-cost').text(formatCurrency(roiVon));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-revenue').text(formatCurrency(roiThu));
    $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-usages').text(`${r.so_lan_sd || 0} lượt thuê / (Giới hạn: ${r.max_luot || '∞'} lượt)`);
    
    const $roi = $('#mod-trangphuc-detail-roi');
    $roi.text(`${roiPct}%`);
    $roi.removeClass().addClass('text-base font-extrabold');
    if (roiPct >= 100) $roi.addClass('text-emerald-500');
    else if (roiPct > 0) $roi.addClass('text-amber-500');
    else $roi.addClass('text-slate-400');

    // Hiện panel offcanvas trượt ra
    $('#mod-trangphuc-backdrop').removeClass('hidden');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-offcanvas').removeClass('translate-x-full');
  },

  // --- CLOSE OFFCANVAS DRAW PANEL ---
  closeOffcanvas: function() {
    $('#mod-trangphuc-backdrop').addClass('hidden');
    $('#mod-trangphuc-offcanvas').addClass('translate-x-full');
  },

  // --- ZOOM CHART HANDLER ---
  toggleZoom: function(canvasId, btnElement) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const card = canvas.closest('.glass-card') || canvas.closest('.panel');
    if (!card) return;
    
    const $icon = $(btnElement).find('i');
    const isZoomed = card.classList.contains('panel-zoomed');
    
    if (isZoomed) {
      card.classList.remove('panel-zoomed');
      $icon.removeClass('fa-compress-arrows-alt').addClass('fa-expand-arrows-alt');
      this.renderCharts();
    } else {
      card.classList.add('panel-zoomed');
      $icon.removeClass('fa-expand-arrows-alt').addClass('fa-compress-arrows-alt');
      const chart = Chart.getChart(canvasId);
      if (chart) chart.resize();
    }
  },

  // --- EXPORT TO EXCEL ---
  exportExcel: function() {
    const self = this;
    const exportData = self.getTabFilteredData();
    if (exportData.length === 0) {
      alert("Không có dữ liệu để xuất!");
      return;
    }

    let csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,\uFEFF";
    
    // Headers
    csvContent += "Mã TP,Tên trang phục,Loại trang phục,Chi nhánh,Tình trạng mới cũ,Trạng thái,SL Tồn,SL Khởi tạo,Giá nhập,Doanh số thu về,Số lượt thuê,Max lượt thuê,Nhà cung cấp\n";
    
    exportData.forEach(r => {
      const row = [
        r.id_trang_phuc || '',
        `"${(r.ten_trang_phuc || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        r.loai_trang_phuc || '',
        r.chi_nhanh || '',
        r.tinh_trang || '',
        r.trang_thai || '',
        r.sl_hien_ton || 0,
        r.sl_khoi_tao || 0,
        r.gia_nhap || 0,
        r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0,
        r.so_lan_sd || 0,
        r.max_luot || 0,
        `"${(r.nha_cung_cap || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
      ];
      csvContent += row.join(",") + "\n";
    });

    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    const timeStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    link.setAttribute("download", `DS_TrangPhuc_${timeStr}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  },

  // --- EXPORT TO PDF ---
  exportPDF: function() {
    const self = this;
    const exportData = self.getTabFilteredData();
    if (exportData.length === 0) {
      alert("Không có dữ liệu để xuất!");
      return;
    }

    if (typeof pdfMake === 'undefined') {
      alert("Hệ thống chưa tải xong thư viện PDFMake. Vui lòng thử lại sau.");
      return;
    }

    const tableBody = [[
      { text: 'Mã TP', style: 'tableHeader' },
      { text: 'Tên trang phục', style: 'tableHeader' },
      { text: 'Loại', style: 'tableHeader' },
      { text: 'Chi nhánh', style: 'tableHeader' },
      { text: 'Lượt thuê', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'center' },
      { text: 'Tình trạng', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'center' },
      { text: 'Doanh thu', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'right' }
    ]];

    exportData.forEach(r => {
      tableBody.push([
        { text: r.id_trang_phuc || '', style: 'tableCell' },
        { text: r.ten_trang_phuc || '', style: 'tableCell' },
        { text: r.loai_trang_phuc || '', style: 'tableCell' },
        { text: r.chi_nhanh || '', style: 'tableCell' },
        { text: `${r.so_lan_sd || 0}/${r.max_luot || '∞'}`, style: 'tableCell', alignment: 'center' },
        { text: r.tinh_trang || '0%', style: 'tableCell', alignment: 'center' },
        { text: Math.round(r.doanh_so_thu_ve || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ', style: 'tableCell', alignment: 'right' }
      ]);
    });

    const docDefinition = {
      content: [
        { text: '2H STUDIO - BÁO CÁO DANH SÁCH TRANG PHỤC CHI TIẾT', style: 'header' },
        { text: `Thời gian xuất báo cáo: ${new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')}`, style: 'subheader' },
        { text: `Tổng số lượng: ${exportData.length} bộ trang phục`, style: 'infoText' },
        {
          style: 'tableExample',
          table: {
            headerRows: 1,
            widths: [50, '*', 60, 80, 50, 50, 70],
            body: tableBody
          },
          layout: 'lightHorizontalLines'
        }
      ],
      styles: {
        header: { fontSize: 13, bold: true, alignment: 'center', margin: [0, 0, 0, 10] },
        subheader: { fontSize: 9, alignment: 'center', italic: true, margin: [0, 0, 0, 15] },
        infoText: { fontSize: 10, bold: true, margin: [0, 0, 0, 8] },
        tableHeader: { fontSize: 9, bold: true, fillColor: '#f1f5f9', margin: [4, 4, 4, 4] },
        tableCell: { fontSize: 8.5, margin: [4, 4, 4, 4] },
        tableExample: { margin: [0, 5, 0, 15] }
      },
      defaultStyle: { font: 'Roboto' }
    };

    pdfMake.createPdf(docDefinition).download(`BaoCao_TrangPhuc_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.pdf`);
  }
};

// Đăng ký pointer module cho shell
window.MOD_ACTIVE = window.MOD_TRANGPHUC;
</script>

            <th class="px-4 py-3">Chi Phí</th>
            <th class="px-4 py-3">Trạng Thái</th>
            <th class="px-4 py-3">Người Giao/Nhận</th>
            <th class="px-4 py-3 text-right">Thao Tác</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800">
          
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
        <script>




window.MOD_GIATVAY = {
  
  rawGiatVay: [],
  filteredGiatVay: [],
  currentPage: 1,
  pageSize: 15,

  
  formatVND: function(val) {
    if (!val && val !== 0) return '-';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' }).format(val).replace('₫', 'đ');
  },

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
    this.ensureDependencies();
  },

  ensureDependencies: function() {
    if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE) return;
    if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["TrangPhuc"]) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
          if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && res) {
            const parsed = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
            window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["TrangPhuc"] = parsed;
          }
        })
        .MOD_TRANGPHUC_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
    }
    if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NCC"]) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
          if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && res) {
            const parsed = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
            window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NCC"] = parsed;
          }
        })
        .MOD_NCC_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
    }
    if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"]) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
          if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && res) {
            const parsed = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
            window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"] = parsed;
          }
        })
        .MOD_NhanVien_fetchData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
    }
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;

    
    $('#mod-giatvay-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#mod-giatvay-btn-add').off('click').on('click', function() {
      window.AppCRUD.openCreateForm('giat_vay');
    });

    
    $('#mod-giatvay-filter-branch, #mod-giatvay-filter-ncc, #mod-giatvay-filter-status').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.currentPage = 1;
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-giatvay-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.currentPage = 1;
      self.applyFilters();
    });
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu lịch sử giặt váy...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
          if (data.error) {
            showError("Lỗi: " + data.message);
            hideLoader();
            return;
          }
          
          self.rawGiatVay = data.giatVayData || [];
          self.filteredGiatVay = [...self.rawGiatVay];

          
          self.populateDropdownFilters(data.filters || {});

          
          self.currentPage = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderTable();

          hideLoader();
          if (forceSync) showSuccess("Đồng bộ dữ liệu giặt váy thành công!");
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu giặt váy: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ giặt váy: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_GIATVAY_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateDropdownFilters: function(filters) {
    
    const $branchSelect = $('#mod-giatvay-filter-branch');
    const currentBranch = $branchSelect.val();
    $branchSelect.html('<option value="">Tất cả Chi nhánh</option>');
    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branchSelect.append(`<option value="${b.id}">${b.name}</option>`);
      });
    }
    $branchSelect.val(currentBranch);

    // 2. Đối tác (NCC)
    const $nccSelect = $('#mod-giatvay-filter-ncc');
    const currentNcc = $nccSelect.val();
    $nccSelect.html('<option value="">Tất cả Đối tác</option>');
    if (filters.suppliers) {
      filters.suppliers.forEach(ncc => {
        $nccSelect.append(`<option value="${ncc.id}">${ncc.name}</option>`);
      });
    }
    $nccSelect.val(currentNcc);
  },

  // --- APPLY FILTERS & SEARCH ---
  applyFilters: function() {
    const branchFilter = $('#mod-giatvay-filter-branch').val();
    const nccFilter = $('#mod-giatvay-filter-ncc').val();
    const statusFilter = $('#mod-giatvay-filter-status').val();
    const searchVal = $('#mod-giatvay-search-input').val().toLowerCase().trim();

    this.filteredGiatVay = this.rawGiatVay.filter(item => {
      
      if (branchFilter && item.chi_nhanh !== branchFilter) return false;
      
      
      if (nccFilter && item.id_ncc !== nccFilter) return false;
      
      
      if (statusFilter && item.trang_thai !== statusFilter) return false;

      
      if (searchVal) {
        const text = `${item.id_giat_vay} ${item.ten_dich_vu} ${item.ghi_chu}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!text.includes(searchVal)) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    this.updateKPIs();
    this.renderTable();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    const totalCost = this.filteredGiatVay.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (parseFloat(item.so_tien) || 0), 0);
    $('#mod-giatvay-kpi-chiphi').text(self.formatVND(totalCost));

    
    const activeWashes = this.filteredGiatVay.filter(item => item.trang_thai === "GV02").length;
    $('#mod-giatvay-kpi-danggiat').text(activeWashes);

    
    const currentMonthStr = dayjs().format("YYYY-MM");
    const completedWashes = this.filteredGiatVay.filter(item => {
      if (item.trang_thai !== "GV03") return false;
      if (!item.ngay_nhan) return false;
      return dayjs(item.ngay_nhan).format("YYYY-MM") === currentMonthStr;
    }).length;
    $('#mod-giatvay-kpi-hoanthanh').text(completedWashes);
  },

  
  renderTable: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#mod-giatvay-main-table tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    
    $('#mod-giatvay-table-summary').text(`Tổng số: ${this.filteredGiatVay.length} lượt giặt`);

    if (this.filteredGiatVay.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`
        <tr>
          <td colspan="10" class="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-folder-open text-2xl mb-2 block"></i>
            <span>Không tìm thấy lịch sử giặt váy nào</span>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `);
      return;
    }

    
    const startIndex = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.pageSize;
    const paginatedItems = this.filteredGiatVay.slice(startIndex, startIndex + this.pageSize);

    
    let nccData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NCC"]) || {};
    if (typeof nccData === "string") {
      try { nccData = JSON.parse(nccData); } catch(e) { nccData = {}; }
    }
    const nccList = nccData.nccData || nccData || [];
    const nccArrayList = Array.isArray(nccList) ? nccList : (nccList.nccList || []);
    const nccMap = {};
    nccArrayList.forEach(item => {
      nccMap[item.id_ncc] = item.ten_ncc || item.id_ncc;
    });

    paginatedItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const stt = startIndex + index + 1;
      
      
      const sendDate = item.ngay ? dayjs(item.ngay).format('DD/MM/YYYY') : '-';
      const receiveDate = item.ngay_nhan ? dayjs(item.ngay_nhan).format('DD/MM/YYYY') : '<span class="text-amber-500 font-medium">Chưa nhận</span>';
      
      
      const nccName = nccMap[item.id_ncc] || item.id_ncc || '-';

      
      const moneyText = item.so_tien ? self.formatVND(item.so_tien) : '-';

      
      let statusBadge = '';
      if (item.trang_thai === 'GV01') {
        statusBadge = '<span class="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400">Giao váy</span>';
      } else if (item.trang_thai === 'GV02') {
        statusBadge = '<span class="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i>Đang giặt</span>';
      } else if (item.trang_thai === 'GV03') {
        statusBadge = '<span class="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400">Đã nhận</span>';
      } else {
        statusBadge = `<span class="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">${item.trang_thai || '-'}</span>`;
      }

      // Người giao & Người nhận
      const deliverPerson = item.nguoi_giao || '-';
      const receivePerson = item.nguoi_nhan || '-';
      const handlerText = `${deliverPerson} ➔ ${receivePerson}`;

      
      const editDataEscaped = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(item));

      const rowHtml = `
        <tr onclick="window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('giat_vay', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-150/40 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
          <td class="px-4 py-3 font-medium">${stt}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3">${sendDate}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">${nccName}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 max-w-[200px] truncate" title="${item.ten_dich_vu || ''}">${item.ten_dich_vu || '-'}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 font-bold">${item.so_luong || 0}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3">${receiveDate}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-rose-500">${moneyText}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3">${statusBadge}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-xs">${handlerText}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" onclick="event.stopPropagation();">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
              <button onclick="window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('giat_vay', JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent('${editDataEscaped}')))" class="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square"></i>
              </button>
              <button onclick="window.MOD_GIATVAY.deleteRecord('${item.id_giat_vay}')" class="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
      $tbody.append(rowHtml);
    });
  },

  // --- DELETE RECORD ---
  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa lịch sử giặt váy này không?")) return;
    
    showLoader("Đang xóa lịch sử giặt váy...");
    const self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa lịch sử giặt váy thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true); // Sync data
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('giat_vay', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  }
};
</script>
      </div>
      <div id="mod-container-DonHang" class="mod-container hidden">

      <div id="custom-date-wrapper" class="hidden items-center gap-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl py-1.5 px-3">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-days text-slate-400 text-xs"></i>

      </div>

        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>
        <span>Thêm Đơn Hàng</span>
      </button>

        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i>
        <span>Đồng bộ</span>

      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold flex-shrink-0">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
          <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider leading-none mb-1 truncate">Tổng Công Nợ</span>
          <span class="text-xs md:text-sm xl:text-base font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-white leading-tight whitespace-nowrap" id="kpi-cong-no">0 ₫</span>
          <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold mt-0.5 leading-none flex items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap truncate" id="trend-cong-no">-</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    
    <div class="glass-card bento-shadow rounded-2xl border-l-4 border-purple-500 p-3 flex items-center border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50" style="height: 82px;">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold flex-shrink-0">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-user-tie"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
          <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider leading-none mb-1 truncate">Chi Phí Sale</span>
