    recalculateFormFinancials();
  }

  function recalculateFormFinancials() {
    let sumTotalHDOngia = 0;
    let sumTotalHDKm = 0;
    let sumTotalHDThanhTien = 0;
    let sumPhatSinh = 0;
    
    $('#form-details-accordion-container .detail-row').each(function() {
      const category = $(this).find('.select-category').val();
      const qty = parseFloat($(this).find('.input-qty').val()) || 0;
      const price = parseFloat($(this).find('.input-price').val()) || 0;
      const discount = parseFloat($(this).find('.input-discount').val()) || 0;
      
      const lineTotal = qty * price;
      const lineSubtotal = lineTotal - discount;
      
      $(this).find('.input-line-thanhtien').val(lineTotal);
      $(this).find('.input-line-subtotal').val(lineSubtotal);
      
      if (category === "Hợp đồng") {
        sumTotalHDOngia += lineTotal;
        sumTotalHDKm += discount;
        sumTotalHDThanhTien += lineSubtotal;
      } else {
        sumPhatSinh += lineSubtotal;
      }
    });

    $('input[name="tong_tien_theo_HD"]').val(sumTotalHDOngia);
    $('input[name="so_tien_km"]').val(sumTotalHDKm);
    
    const thTien = sumTotalHDOngia - sumTotalHDKm;
    $('input[name="thanh_tien"]').val(thTien);
    $('input[name="tong_tien_phat_sinh"]').val(sumPhatSinh);
    
    const grandTotal = thTien + sumPhatSinh;
    $('input[name="tong_tien"]').val(grandTotal);

    // Tính Lợi Nhuận Thuần ở Tab 1
    const cost = parseFloat($('input[name="chi_phi_cost"]').val()) || 0;
    $('input[name="loi_nhuan_thuan"]').val(thTien - cost);

    // Thanh toán
    let totalPaid = 0;
    $('#form-payments-accordion-container .payment-row').each(function() {
      const type = $(this).find('select[name*="hang_muc"]').val() || "Thu";
      const amt = parseFloat($(this).find('.input-pay-amount').val()) || 0;
      if (type === "Thu") {
        totalPaid += amt;
      } else {
        totalPaid -= amt;
      }
    });
    
  }


  return {
    init: function() {
      setupEventHandlers();
      this.fetchData(false);
    },
    fetchData: fetchDataLake,
    renderCharts: updateCharts,
    toggleZoom: function(canvasId, btnElement) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
      if (!canvas) return;
      const card = canvas.closest('.glass-card') || canvas.closest('.panel');
      if (!card) return;
      
      const isZoomed = card.classList.contains('panel-zoomed');
      if (isZoomed) {
        card.classList.remove('panel-zoomed');
        btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-expand-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
        updateDashboard(); 
      } else {
        card.classList.add('panel-zoomed');
        btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-compress-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
        const chart = Chart.getChart(canvasId);
        if (chart) chart.resize();
      }
    },
    switchTab: function(tabName) {
      currentTab = tabName;
      const filtered = getFilteredData();
      renderTable(filtered.filteredForTable);
    },
    openDrilldown: openDrilldown,
    closeDrilldown: closeDrilldown,
    deleteRecord: deleteRecord,
    customRenderForm: customRenderForm,
    customRenderDetail: openDrilldown,
    cleanup: function() {
      if (chartDonChot) { chartDonChot.destroy(); chartDonChot = null; }
      if (chartDoanhThuThang) { chartDoanhThuThang.destroy(); chartDoanhThuThang = null; }
      if (chartLoaiDv) { chartLoaiDv.destroy(); chartLoaiDv = null; }
      if (chartNguonKhach) { chartNguonKhach.destroy(); chartNguonKhach = null; }
      if (chartTyTrongCp) { chartTyTrongCp.destroy(); chartTyTrongCp = null; }
      if (mainTable) { mainTable.destroy(); mainTable = null; }
    }
  };
})();

        <span id="kpi-dhct-km" class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white leading-tight">0₫</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="glass-card bento-shadow p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center border-l-4 border-blue-500">
      <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xl flex-shrink-0 mr-4 shadow-inner">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-calculator"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-col">
        <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-0.5">Tổng tiền (sau KM)</span>
        <span id="kpi-dhct-tongtien" class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white leading-tight">0₫</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  
  <div class="glass-card bento-shadow rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
      <table id="table-dhct-data" class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr class="bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">#</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Mã ĐH</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Khách hàng</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Hạng mục</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Tên dịch vụ</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Loại DV</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-semibold">SL</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-semibold">Đơn giá</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-semibold">Thành tiền</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-semibold">KM</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-semibold">Tổng tiền</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-left font-semibold">Trạng thái</th>
            <th class="py-3 px-4 text-center font-semibold w-24">Thao tác</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    
    
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
      <span id="table-info-dhct" class="text-xs text-slate-400">Tổng số: 0 bản ghi</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button id="btn-prev-dhct" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors">← Trước</button>
        <span id="page-num-dhct" class="text-xs text-slate-500">Trang 1 / 1</span>
        <button id="btn-next-dhct" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors">Sau →</button>
      </div>
      <span id="page-info-dhct" class="text-xs text-slate-400">Hiển thị 0 của 0</span>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
        <script>
window.MOD_DonHangCT = {
  
  rawData: [],
  filteredData: [],
  donHangMap: {}, 

  
  pageSize: 20,
  currentPage: 1,

  
  init: function() {
    var self = this;

    
    $('#mod-dhct-filter-dh').off('change').on('change', function() { self.handleFilterChange(); });
    $('#mod-dhct-filter-loai').off('change').on('change', function() { self.handleFilterChange(); });
    $('#mod-dhct-filter-hangmuc').off('change').on('change', function() { self.handleFilterChange(); });
    $('#mod-dhct-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() { self.handleFilterChange(); });

    
    $('#mod-dhct-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() { self.fetchData(true); });

    
    $('#btn-prev-dhct').off('click').on('click', function() {
      if (self.currentPage > 1) { self.currentPage--; self.renderTable(); }
    });
    $('#btn-next-dhct').off('click').on('click', function() {
      var totalPages = Math.ceil(self.filteredData.length / self.pageSize) || 1;
      if (self.currentPage < totalPages) { self.currentPage++; self.renderTable(); }
    });

    self.fetchData();
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync) {
    var self = this;

    if (!forceSync && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"]) {
      try {
        var data = window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"];
        self.rawData = data.don_hang_ct || [];
        
        var donHangList = data.don_hang || [];
        self.donHangMap = {};
        donHangList.forEach(function(dh) {
          self.donHangMap[String(dh.id_don_hang).trim()] = {
            nhan: dh.nhan_khach_hang || dh.ten_co_dau || dh.ten_chu_re || dh.id_don_hang,
            trang_thai: dh.trang_thai || '',
            ten_trang_thai: dh.ten_trang_thai || dh.trang_thai || ''
          };
        });

        self.populateFilters(donHangList);
        self.filteredData = self.rawData.slice();
        self.currentPage = 1;
        self.updateKPIs();
        self.renderTable();
        
        if (typeof hideLoader !== 'undefined') hideLoader();
        self.fetchDataSilent();
        return;
      } catch(e) {
        console.error("Lỗi đọc cache ĐHCT:", e);
      }
    }

    showLoader(forceSync ? "Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu chi tiết đơn hàng..." : "Đang tải dữ liệu chi tiết đơn hàng...");

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
        try {
          var data = (typeof res === 'string') ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
          self.rawData = data.don_hang_ct || [];
          
          var donHangList = data.don_hang || [];
          self.donHangMap = {};
          donHangList.forEach(function(dh) {
            self.donHangMap[String(dh.id_don_hang).trim()] = {
              nhan: dh.nhan_khach_hang || dh.ten_co_dau || dh.ten_chu_re || dh.id_don_hang,
              trang_thai: dh.trang_thai || '',
              ten_trang_thai: dh.ten_trang_thai || dh.trang_thai || ''
            };
          });

          
          if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE) window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE = {};
          window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"] = data;

          self.populateFilters(donHangList);
          self.filteredData = self.rawData.slice();
          self.currentPage = 1;
          self.updateKPIs();
          self.renderTable();

          hideLoader();
          if (forceSync) showSuccess("Đồng bộ dữ liệu chi tiết đơn hàng thành công!");
        } catch(err) {
          showError("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function(err) {
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_DonHang_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  fetchDataSilent: function() {
    var self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
        try {
          var data = (typeof res === 'string') ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
          self.rawData = data.don_hang_ct || [];
          
          var donHangList = data.don_hang || [];
          self.donHangMap = {};
          donHangList.forEach(function(dh) {
            self.donHangMap[String(dh.id_don_hang).trim()] = {
              nhan: dh.nhan_khach_hang || dh.ten_co_dau || dh.ten_chu_re || dh.id_don_hang,
              trang_thai: dh.trang_thai || '',
              ten_trang_thai: dh.ten_trang_thai || dh.trang_thai || ''
            };
          });

          if (!window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE) window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE = {};
          window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"] = data;

          self.populateFilters(donHangList);
          
          self.handleFilterChange();
        } catch(err) {
          console.error("Lỗi sync background ĐHCT:", err);
        }
      })
      .MOD_DonHang_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateFilters: function(donHangList) {
    var self = this;
    
    
    var $dh = $('#mod-dhct-filter-dh');
    var curDh = $dh.val();
    $dh.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    donHangList.forEach(function(dh) {
      var label = dh.nhan_khach_hang || dh.id_don_hang;
      $dh.append(new Option(label, dh.id_don_hang));
    });
    $dh.val(curDh);

    
    var $loai = $('#mod-dhct-filter-loai');
    var curLoai = $loai.val();
    $loai.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    var loaiSet = {};
    self.rawData.forEach(function(r) {
      var v = String(r.loai_dich_vu || '').trim();
      if (v && !loaiSet[v]) { loaiSet[v] = true; $loai.append(new Option(v, v)); }
    });
    $loai.val(curLoai);

    
    var $hm = $('#mod-dhct-filter-hangmuc');
    var curHm = $hm.val();
    $hm.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    var hmSet = {};
    self.rawData.forEach(function(r) {
      var v = String(r.hang_muc || '').trim();
      if (v && !hmSet[v]) { hmSet[v] = true; $hm.append(new Option(v, v)); }
    });
    $hm.val(curHm);
  },

  
  handleFilterChange: function() {
    var self = this;
    var dhId = $('#mod-dhct-filter-dh').val();
    var loai = $('#mod-dhct-filter-loai').val();
    var hm = $('#mod-dhct-filter-hangmuc').val();
    var query = $('#mod-dhct-search-input').val().toLowerCase().trim();

    self.filteredData = self.rawData.filter(function(r) {
      var matchDh = !dhId || String(r.id_don_hang).trim() === dhId;
      var matchLoai = !loai || String(r.loai_dich_vu || '').trim() === loai;
      var matchHm = !hm || String(r.hang_muc || '').trim() === hm;
      var matchQuery = !query ||
        String(r.ten_khach_hang || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(r.ten_dich_vu || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(r.id_don_hang || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(r.id_don_hang_ct || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
      return matchDh && matchLoai && matchHm && matchQuery;
    });

    self.currentPage = 1;
    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderTable();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    var self = this;
    var fmt = function(v) { return (v || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN'); };
    
    var totalThanhTien = 0, totalKM = 0, totalTongTien = 0;
    self.filteredData.forEach(function(r) {
      totalThanhTien += Number(r.thanh_tien) || 0;
      totalKM += Number(r.so_tien_km) || 0;
      totalTongTien += Number(r.tong_tien) || 0;
    });

    $('#kpi-dhct-tong').text(self.filteredData.length.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    $('#kpi-dhct-thanhtien').text(fmt(totalThanhTien) + '₫');
    $('#kpi-dhct-km').text(fmt(totalKM) + '₫');
    $('#kpi-dhct-tongtien').text(fmt(totalTongTien) + '₫');
  },

  
  renderTable: function() {
    var self = this;
    var $tbody = $('#table-dhct-data tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    var total = self.filteredData.length;
    var totalPages = Math.ceil(total / self.pageSize) || 1;
    if (self.currentPage > totalPages) self.currentPage = totalPages;
    if (self.currentPage < 1) self.currentPage = 1;

    var start = (self.currentPage - 1) * self.pageSize;
    var end = Math.min(start + self.pageSize, total);
    var pageData = self.filteredData.slice(start, end);

    $('#table-info-dhct').text('Tổng số: ' + total.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' bản ghi');
    $('#page-info-dhct').text(total === 0 ? 'Hiển thị 0 của 0' : 'Hiển thị ' + (start + 1) + '-' + end + ' của ' + total.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    $('#page-num-dhct').text('Trang ' + self.currentPage + ' / ' + totalPages);

    var btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn-prev-dhct');
    var btnNext = document.getElementById('btn-next-dhct');
    btnPrev.disabled = self.currentPage === 1;
    btnNext.disabled = self.currentPage === totalPages;
    $(btnPrev).css({ opacity: self.currentPage === 1 ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPage === 1 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });
    $(btnNext).css({ opacity: self.currentPage === totalPages ? '0.5' : '1', cursor: self.currentPage === totalPages ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' });

    if (pageData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append('<tr><td colspan="13" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy dữ liệu chi tiết đơn hàng</td></tr>');
      return;
    }

    var fmt = function(v) { return (Number(v) || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN'); };

    pageData.forEach(function(r, idx) {
      var globalIdx = start + idx + 1;
      
      
      var dhInfo = self.donHangMap[String(r.id_don_hang).trim()] || {};
      var tenKH = r.ten_khach_hang || dhInfo.nhan || r.id_don_hang;

      
      var trangThai = r.trang_thai || dhInfo.trang_thai || '';
      var tenTrangThai = dhInfo.ten_trang_thai || trangThai;
      var statusBadge = trangThai ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-800/30">' + tenTrangThai + '</span>' : '';

      
      var hmColor = (r.hang_muc || '').includes('Phát sinh') ? 'amber' : 'violet';
      var hmBadge = r.hang_muc ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-' + hmColor + '-100 dark:bg-' + hmColor + '-950/30 text-' + hmColor + '-600 dark:text-' + hmColor + '-400 border border-' + hmColor + '-200/40">' + r.hang_muc + '</span>' : '';

      var $rowEl = $('<tr class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors"></tr>');
      $rowEl.data('row-data', r);
      
      $rowEl.html(
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-slate-400 font-medium">' + globalIdx + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-350">' + (r.id_don_hang || '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4"><div class="font-semibold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 truncate max-w-[160px]" title="' + tenKH + '">' + tenKH + '</div></td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4">' + hmBadge + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4"><div class="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate max-w-[180px]" title="' + (r.ten_dich_vu || '') + '">' + (r.ten_dich_vu || '') + '</div></td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-500">' + (r.loai_dich_vu || '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">' + (r.so_luong || 1) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">' + fmt(r.don_gia) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">' + fmt(r.thanh_tien) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right text-amber-500 font-medium">' + (Number(r.so_tien_km) ? '-' + fmt(r.so_tien_km) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">' + fmt(r.tong_tien) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4">' + statusBadge + '</td>' +
        '<td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">' +
          '<div class="flex items-center justify-center">' +
            '<button class="btn-view-dhct p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xem chi tiết"><i class="fa-solid fa-eye text-sm"></i></button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</td>'
      );

      $rowEl.on('click', function() {
        window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('don_hang_ct', $(this).data('row-data'));
      });

      $rowEl.find('.btn-view-dhct').on('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        window.AppCRUD.openDetailView('don_hang_ct', $rowEl.data('row-data'));
      });

      $tbody.append($rowEl);
    });
  },

  
  deleteRecord: function(recordId) {
    if (!confirm("Anh/Chị có chắc chắn muốn xóa bản ghi chi tiết đơn hàng này không?")) return;

    showLoader("Đang xóa dữ liệu...");
    var self = this;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã xóa chi tiết đơn hàng thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function(err) {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_deleteRecord('don_hang_ct', recordId, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    this.rawData = [];
    this.filteredData = [];
    this.donHangMap = {};
  }
};
</script>

      <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Định khoản &amp; Số tiền</h4>
      
      <div class="glass-card dark:bg-slate-800/20 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 space-y-3.5">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-150/40 dark:border-slate-800/60">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-trend-down text-blue-500 text-[10px]"></i> Tài khoản Nợ
          </span>
          <div class="text-right">
            <div id="mod-thuchi-detail-no" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs">-</div>
            <div id="mod-thuchi-detail-no-id" class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-0.5">TK: -</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-150/40 dark:border-slate-800/60">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-trend-up text-rose-500 text-[10px]"></i> Tài khoản Có
          </span>
          <div class="text-right">
            <div id="mod-thuchi-detail-co" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs">-</div>
            <div id="mod-thuchi-detail-co-id" class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-0.5">TK: -</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs pt-1">
          <span class="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-350 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-money-bill-wave text-emerald-500 text-[10px]"></i> Tổng số tiền
          </span>
          <strong id="mod-thuchi-detail-amount" class="text-base font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-450">-</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    
  </div>
</div>
        <script>

if (typeof ChartDataLabels !== 'undefined') {
  Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);
}





window.MOD_THUCHI = {
  
  rawThuChi: [],
  filteredThuChi: [],
  activeTableTab: 'Thu', 
  
  
  chartFlowThu: null,
  chartFlowChi: null,
  chartExpenseCategory: null,
  chartIncomePayment: null,
  chartBalanceVariation: null,
  chartSupplier: null,
  mainTable: null,

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    if (this.chartFlowThu) { this.chartFlowThu.destroy(); this.chartFlowThu = null; }
    if (this.chartFlowChi) { this.chartFlowChi.destroy(); this.chartFlowChi = null; }
    if (this.chartExpenseCategory) { this.chartExpenseCategory.destroy(); this.chartExpenseCategory = null; }
    if (this.chartIncomePayment) { this.chartIncomePayment.destroy(); this.chartIncomePayment = null; }
    if (this.chartBalanceVariation) { this.chartBalanceVariation.destroy(); this.chartBalanceVariation = null; }
    if (this.chartSupplier) { this.chartSupplier.destroy(); this.chartSupplier = null; }
    if (this.mainTable) { this.mainTable.destroy(); this.mainTable = null; }
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-btn-add').off('click').on('click', function() {
      window.AppCRUD.openCreateForm('thu_chi');
    });

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-filter-time').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.toggleCustomDate();
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch, #mod-thuchi-filter-type, #mod-thuchi-filter-status, #mod-thuchi-date-from, #mod-thuchi-date-to').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      const val = $(this).val();
      if (self.mainTable) {
        self.mainTable.search(val).draw();
      }
    });

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-backdrop').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.closeOffcanvas();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-balance-excel').on('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-balance-excel', function() {
      self.exportBalanceExcel();
    });
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-balance-pdf').on('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-balance-pdf', function() {
      self.exportBalancePdf();
    });

    
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-excel').on('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-excel', function() {
      self.exportExcel();
    });
    $(document).off('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-pdf').on('click', '#mod-thuchi-btn-export-pdf', function() {
      self.exportPDF();
    });
  },

  
  toggleCustomDate: function() {
    const timeVal = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-time').val();
    const $customContainer = $('#mod-thuchi-custom-date');
    if (timeVal === "Tùy chọn") {
      $customContainer.removeClass('hidden').addClass('flex');
    } else {
      $customContainer.addClass('hidden').removeClass('flex');
    }
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu thu chi...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          if (data.error) {
            alert(data.message);
            hideLoader();
            return;
          }
          self.rawThuChi = data.thuChi || [];
          self.dinhKhoanList = data.dinhKhoanList || [];
          self.filteredThuChi = [...self.rawThuChi];

          
          self.populateDropdownFilters(data.filters || {});

          
          self.applyFilters();
          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          alert("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu Thu Chi: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        alert("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ Thu Chi: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_THUCHI_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateDropdownFilters: function(filters) {
    const $branch = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch');
    $branch.find('option:not(:first)').remove();

    if (filters.branches) {
      filters.branches.forEach(b => {
        $branch.append(new Option(b.name, b.id));
      });
    }
  },

  
  applyFilters: function() {
    const self = this;
    const fBranch = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch').val();
    const fTime = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-time').val();
    const dFrom = $('#mod-thuchi-date-from').val();
    const dTo = $('#mod-thuchi-date-to').val();
    const fType = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-type').val();
    const fStatus = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-status').val();

    const today = new Date();
    const curMonth = today.getMonth();
    const curYear = today.getFullYear();

    
    window.isWaitStatus = (status) => String(status||'').includes('KT01') || String(status||'').includes('Chờ duyệt');

    self.filteredThuChi = self.rawThuChi.filter(row => {
      
      if (fBranch && row.chi_nhanh_id !== fBranch) return false;
      
      
      if (row.ngay_lap_norm) {
        const rowDate = new Date(row.ngay_lap_norm);
        let passTime = true;
        
        if (fTime === "Tháng này") {
          passTime = (rowDate.getMonth() === curMonth && rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear);
        } else if (fTime === "Tháng trước") {
          let prevMonth = curMonth - 1; let prevYear = curYear;
          if (prevMonth < 0) { prevMonth = 11; prevYear--; }
          passTime = (rowDate.getMonth() === prevMonth && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevYear);
        } else if (fTime === "Quý này") {
          passTime = (Math.floor(rowDate.getMonth() / 3) === Math.floor(curMonth / 3) && rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear);
        } else if (fTime === "Quý trước") {
          let prevQuarter = Math.floor(curMonth / 3) - 1; let prevYear = curYear;
          if (prevQuarter < 0) { prevQuarter = 3; prevYear--; }
          passTime = (Math.floor(rowDate.getMonth() / 3) === prevQuarter && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevYear);
        } else if (fTime === "Năm này") {
          passTime = (rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear);
        } else if (fTime === "Năm trước") {
          passTime = (rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear - 1);
        } else if (fTime === "Tùy chọn") {
          if (dFrom && rowDate < new Date(dFrom)) passTime = false;
          if (dTo && rowDate > new Date(dTo)) passTime = false;
        }
        if (!passTime) return false;
      }

      
      if (fType && row.nhan_thu_chi !== fType) return false;

      
      if (fStatus && row.trang_thai !== fStatus) return false;

      return true;
    });

    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderCharts();
    self.renderTable();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    const fTime = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-time').val();
    const fBranch = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch').val();
    const fType = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-type').val();
    const fStatus = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-status').val();

    let tongThu = 0;
    let tongChi = 0;
    let thuNgay = 0;
    let chiNgay = 0;
    let choDuyet = 0;

    let prevTongThu = 0;
    let prevTongChi = 0;
    let prevThuNgay = 0;
    let prevChiNgay = 0;

    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(today.getHours() + 7); 
    const todayStr = today.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    
    const yesterday = new Date(today);
    yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
    const yesterdayStr = yesterday.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    
    const curMonth = today.getMonth();
    const curYear = today.getFullYear();

    
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      const amt = parseFloat(r.so_tien) || 0;
      const isPending = window.isWaitStatus(r.trang_thai);
      const isThu = r.nhan_thu_chi === "Thu";
      const isChi = r.nhan_thu_chi === "Chi";
      
      if (isThu) tongThu += amt;
      if (isChi) tongChi += amt;
      
      if (r.ngay_lap_norm && r.ngay_lap_norm.startsWith(todayStr)) {
        if (isThu) thuNgay += amt;
        if (isChi) chiNgay += amt;
      }

      if (isPending) choDuyet++;
    });

    
    self.rawThuChi.forEach(row => {
      if (fBranch && row.chi_nhanh_id !== fBranch) return;
      if (fType && row.nhan_thu_chi !== fType) return;
      if (fStatus && row.trang_thai !== fStatus) return;
      
      const amt = parseFloat(row.so_tien) || 0;
      const isThu = row.nhan_thu_chi === "Thu";
      const isChi = row.nhan_thu_chi === "Chi";
      
      
      if (row.ngay_lap_norm && row.ngay_lap_norm.startsWith(yesterdayStr)) {
        if (isThu) prevThuNgay += amt;
        if (isChi) prevChiNgay += amt;
      }
      
      
      let rowDate = null;
      if (row.ngay_lap_norm) {
        rowDate = new Date(row.ngay_lap_norm);
        if (isNaN(rowDate.getTime())) rowDate = null;
      }
      
      let isPrevPeriod = false;
      if (rowDate) {
        if (fTime === "Tháng này") {
          let prevMonth = curMonth - 1; let prevY = curYear;
          if (prevMonth < 0) { prevMonth = 11; prevY--; }
          isPrevPeriod = (rowDate.getMonth() === prevMonth && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevY);
        } else if (fTime === "Tháng trước") {
          let prevMonth = curMonth - 2; let prevY = curYear;
          if (prevMonth < 0) { prevMonth += 12; prevY--; }
          isPrevPeriod = (rowDate.getMonth() === prevMonth && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevY);
        } else if (fTime === "Quý này") {
          let prevQuarter = Math.floor(curMonth / 3) - 1; let prevY = curYear;
          if (prevQuarter < 0) { prevQuarter = 3; prevY--; }
          isPrevPeriod = (Math.floor(rowDate.getMonth() / 3) === prevQuarter && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevY);
        } else if (fTime === "Quý trước") {
          let prevQuarter = Math.floor(curMonth / 3) - 2; let prevY = curYear;
          if (prevQuarter < 0) { prevQuarter += 4; prevY--; }
          isPrevPeriod = (Math.floor(rowDate.getMonth() / 3) === prevQuarter && rowDate.getFullYear() === prevY);
        } else if (fTime === "Năm này") {
          isPrevPeriod = (rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear - 1);
        } else if (fTime === "Năm trước") {
          isPrevPeriod = (rowDate.getFullYear() === curYear - 2);
        }
      }
      
      if (isPrevPeriod) {
        if (isThu) prevTongThu += amt;
        if (isChi) prevTongChi += amt;
      }
    });

    const tonQuy = tongThu - tongChi;

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
    };
    const formatNumber = (val) => {
      return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    };

    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-income').text(formatCurrency(tongThu));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-expense').text(formatCurrency(tongChi));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-balance').text(formatCurrency(tonQuy));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-income-today').text(formatCurrency(thuNgay));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-expense-today').text(formatCurrency(chiNgay));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-pending').text(formatNumber(choDuyet));

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-income-title').text(`Tổng Thu (${fTime})`);
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-expense-title').text(`Tổng Chi (${fTime})`);

    
    const calculateTrendHtml = (current, previous, isReverseGood = false, labelSuffix = 'kỳ') => {
      if (fTime === "Tùy chọn") {
        return `<span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5">Không so sánh</span>`;
      }
      if (!previous || previous === 0) {
        return `<span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-trend-up text-[8px]"></i> Ổn định</span>`;
      }
      const pct = ((current - previous) / previous * 100).toFixed(1);
      const isUp = pct > 0;
      const isZero = pct == 0;
      
      if (isZero) {
        return `<span class="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-trend-up text-[8px]"></i> Không đổi</span>`;
      }
      
      const pctFormatted = isUp ? `+${pct}%` : `${pct}%`;
      const isUpGood = isReverseGood ? !isUp : isUp;
      const colorClass = isUpGood ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-rose-500';
      const icon = isUp ? 'fa-arrow-trend-up' : 'fa-arrow-trend-down';
      const label = isUp ? 'Tăng' : 'Giảm';
      
      return `<span class="${colorClass} font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5"><i class="fa-solid ${icon} text-[8px]"></i> ${label} (${pctFormatted})</span>`;
    };

    
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-income-trend').html(calculateTrendHtml(tongThu, prevTongThu, false));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-expense-trend').html(calculateTrendHtml(tongChi, prevTongChi, true)); 
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-balance-trend').html(`<span class="text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold">Tồn quỹ tài chính</span>`);

    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-income-today-trend').html(calculateTrendHtml(thuNgay, prevThuNgay, false));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-expense-today-trend').html(calculateTrendHtml(chiNgay, prevChiNgay, true));
    $('#mod-thuchi-kpi-pending-trend').html(`<span class="text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold">Cần phê duyệt</span>`);
  },

  
  renderCharts: function() {
    const self = this;
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    const textColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';
    const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(148,163,184,0.08)' : 'rgba(100,116,139,0.08)';
    const chartBorder = isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';

    const formatShortAmount = (val) => {
      if (!val) return '0₫';
      const abs = Math.abs(val);
      if (abs >= 1000000000) return (val / 1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tỷ';
      if (abs >= 1000000) return (val / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tr';
      if (abs >= 1000) return (val / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' K';
      return val + '₫';
    };

    
    const pieCalloutPlugin = {
      id: 'pieCallout',
      afterDraw(chart) {
        if (chart.config.type !== 'pie' && chart.config.type !== 'doughnut') return;
        const ctx = chart.ctx;
        const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
        const localTextColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';
        
        const localFormatShort = (v) => {
          if (!v) return '0';
          const abs = Math.abs(v);
          if (abs >= 1000000000) return (v / 1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tỷ';
          if (abs >= 1000000) return (v / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Tr';
          if (abs >= 1000) return (v / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' K';
          return v + '₫';
        };

        chart.data.datasets.forEach((dataset, i) => {
          const total = dataset.data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          if (!total || total === 0) return;

          chart.getDatasetMeta(i).data.forEach((model, index) => {
            const val = dataset.data[index];
            if (!model || model.startAngle === undefined) return;
            if (val / total >= 0.05 || val / total < 0.03) return; 

            const midAngle = model.startAngle + (model.endAngle - model.startAngle) / 2;
            const outerRadius = model.outerRadius;
            const x = Math.cos(midAngle);
            const y = Math.sin(midAngle);
            const startX = model.x + x * outerRadius;
            const startY = model.y + y * outerRadius;
            const endX = model.x + x * (outerRadius + 12);
            const endY = model.y + y * (outerRadius + 12);
            const lineEndX = endX + (x >= 0 ? 8 : -8);

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
            ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
            ctx.lineTo(lineEndX, endY);
            ctx.strokeStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.fillStyle = localTextColor;
            ctx.font = 'bold 8.5px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = x >= 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(localFormatShort(val), lineEndX + (x >= 0 ? 3 : -3), endY);
          });
        });
      }
    };

    const commOpt = {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { labels: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 10, weight: 'bold' } } },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)',
          titleFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 11, weight: 'bold' },
          bodyFont: { family: 'Inter', size: 11 },
          padding: 8,
          cornerRadius: 6,
          callbacks: {
            label: function(context) {
              let label = context.dataset.label || '';
              if (label) label += ': ';
              if (context.parsed.y !== undefined) label += Math.round(context.parsed.y).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
              else if (context.parsed !== undefined) label += Math.round(context.parsed).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
              return label;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };

    
    const barDatalabels = {
      anchor: context => {
        const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
        return val >= 0 ? 'end' : 'start';
      },
      align: context => {
        const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
        return val >= 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom';
      },
      color: textColor,
      font: { size: 9, family: 'Inter', weight: 'bold' },
      clip: false,
      formatter: v => v !== 0 ? formatShortAmount(v) : ''
    };

    const pieDatalabels = {
      color: '#ffffff',
      font: { weight: 'bold', size: 9, family: 'Inter' },
      display: ctx => {
        const val = ctx.dataset.data[ctx.dataIndex];
        const total = ctx.dataset.data.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0) || 1;
        return (val/total >= 0.05); 
      },
      formatter: v => formatShortAmount(v)
    };

    const scaleOptions = {
      x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } },
      y: { 
        grid: { color: gridColor }, 
        ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => formatShortAmount(v) },
        grace: '15%' 
      }
    };

    
    const dateMap = {};
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.ngay_lap_norm) return;
      const d = r.ngay_lap_norm;
      if (!dateMap[d]) dateMap[d] = { thu: 0, chi: 0 };
      if (r.nhan_thu_chi === "Thu") dateMap[d].thu += r.so_tien;
      if (r.nhan_thu_chi === "Chi") dateMap[d].chi += r.so_tien;
    });
    const sortedDates = Object.keys(dateMap).sort();
    const formattedDates = sortedDates.map(d => d.substring(5));

    
    if (self.chartFlowThu) self.chartFlowThu.destroy();
    self.chartFlowThu = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-flow-thu').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: formattedDates,
        datasets: [{ label: 'Thu', data: sortedDates.map(d => dateMap[d].thu), backgroundColor: '#3b82f6', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: { 
        ...commOpt, 
        scales: scaleOptions,
        plugins: { ...commOpt.plugins, legend: { display: false }, datalabels: barDatalabels }
      }
    });

    
    if (self.chartFlowChi) self.chartFlowChi.destroy();
    self.chartFlowChi = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-flow-chi').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: formattedDates,
        datasets: [{ label: 'Chi', data: sortedDates.map(d => dateMap[d].chi), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: { 
        ...commOpt, 
        scales: scaleOptions,
        plugins: { ...commOpt.plugins, legend: { display: false }, datalabels: barDatalabels }
      }
    });

    
    const expenseMap = {};
    const fBranchVal = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch').val();
    const isAllBranch = !fBranchVal;

    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      if (r.nhan_thu_chi === "Chi" || String(r.hang_muc).trim().toLowerCase() === "chi") {
        const tkId = String(r.tai_khoan_no_id || "").trim();
        
        if (tkId.startsWith('6') || tkId.startsWith('8') || tkId.startsWith('242')) {
          const h = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_no_cha || "Chưa phân loại") : (r.tai_khoan_no || "Chưa phân loại");
          expenseMap[h] = (expenseMap[h] || 0) + r.so_tien;
        }
      }
    });
    const sortedExpense = Object.entries(expenseMap).sort((a,b) => b[1] - a[1]);

    if (self.chartExpenseCategory) self.chartExpenseCategory.destroy();
    self.chartExpenseCategory = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-expense-category').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: sortedExpense.map(x => x[0]),
        datasets: [{ label: 'Cơ cấu chi', data: sortedExpense.map(x => x[1]), backgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: { 
        ...commOpt, 
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: { 
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => formatShortAmount(v) } }, 
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } } 
        },
        plugins: { ...commOpt.plugins, legend: { display: false }, datalabels: {
          ...barDatalabels,
          anchor: 'end',
          align: context => {
            const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
            const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
            return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'right' : 'left';
          }
        }}
      }
    });

    
    const paymentMap = {};
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      if (r.nhan_thu_chi === "Thu") {
        const p = r.loai_thanh_toan || "Chưa phân loại";
        paymentMap[p] = (paymentMap[p] || 0) + r.so_tien;
      }
    });
    const payLabels = Object.keys(paymentMap);
    const payData = Object.values(paymentMap);
    const pieColors = ['#10b981', '#3b82f6', '#8b5cf6', '#f59e0b', '#64748b', '#ec4899', '#06b6d4'];

    if (self.chartIncomePayment) self.chartIncomePayment.destroy();
    self.chartIncomePayment = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-income-payment').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: payLabels,
        datasets: [{
          data: payData,
          backgroundColor: pieColors,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderColor: chartBorder
        }]
      },
      plugins: [pieCalloutPlugin],
      options: { 
        ...commOpt,
        layout: { padding: { top: 20, bottom: 20, left: 30, right: 30 } },
        plugins: {
          ...commOpt.plugins,
          legend: { ...commOpt.plugins.legend, position: 'left' },
          datalabels: pieDatalabels
        }
      }
    });

    
    const balanceMap = {};
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      const tkNoId = String(r.tai_khoan_no_id || '').trim();
      const tkCoId = String(r.tai_khoan_co_id || '').trim();
      const amt = Math.abs(r.so_tien || 0);
      
      
      if (tkNoId.startsWith('111') || tkNoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkNoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_no_cha || r.tai_khoan_no) : r.tai_khoan_no;
        if (!balanceMap[tkNoName]) balanceMap[tkNoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkNoName].no += amt;
      }
      
      if (tkCoId.startsWith('111') || tkCoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkCoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_co_cha || r.tai_khoan_co) : r.tai_khoan_co;
        if (!balanceMap[tkCoName]) balanceMap[tkCoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkCoName].co += amt;
      }
    });
    const balLabels = Object.keys(balanceMap).sort();

    if (self.chartBalanceVariation) self.chartBalanceVariation.destroy();
    self.chartBalanceVariation = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-balance-variation').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: balLabels,
        datasets: [
          { label: 'Nợ (Tiền vào)', data: balLabels.map(k => balanceMap[k].no), backgroundColor: '#3b82f6', borderRadius: 4 },
          { label: 'Có (Tiền ra)', data: balLabels.map(k => balanceMap[k].co), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4 }
        ]
      },
      options: {
        ...commOpt,
        indexAxis: 'y',
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: { 
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => formatShortAmount(v) } }, 
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } } 
        },
        plugins: { ...commOpt.plugins, datalabels: {
          ...barDatalabels,
          anchor: 'end',
          align: context => {
            const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
            const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
            return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'right' : 'left';
          }
        }}
      }
    });

    
    const nccMapObj = {};
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      if (r.nhan_thu_chi === "Chi" && r.nha_cung_cap) {
        const ncc = r.nha_cung_cap;
        nccMapObj[ncc] = (nccMapObj[ncc] || 0) + r.so_tien;
      }
    });
    const sortedNcc = Object.entries(nccMapObj).sort((a,b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10);

    if (self.chartSupplier) self.chartSupplier.destroy();
    self.chartSupplier = new Chart(document.getElementById('mod-thuchi-chart-supplier').getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: sortedNcc.map(x => x[0]),
        datasets: [{ label: 'Chi phí', data: sortedNcc.map(x => x[1]), backgroundColor: '#06b6d4', borderRadius: 4 }]
      },
      options: { 
        ...commOpt, 
        indexAxis: 'y', 
        layout: { padding: { right: 40 } },
        scales: { 
          x: { grid: { color: gridColor }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 }, callback: v => formatShortAmount(v) } }, 
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: textColor, font: { family: 'Inter', size: 9 } } } 
        },
        plugins: { ...commOpt.plugins, legend: { display: false }, datalabels: {
          ...barDatalabels,
          anchor: 'end',
          align: context => {
            const val = context.dataset.data[context.dataIndex] || 0;
            const max = Math.max(...context.dataset.data) || 1;
            return (val < max * 0.15) ? 'right' : 'left';
          }
        }}
      }
    });

    
    self.renderBalanceTable(balanceMap);
  },

  
  renderBalanceTable: function(balanceMap) {
    const $tbody = $('#mod-thuchi-table-balance tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    const entries = Object.entries(balanceMap).sort((a,b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append('<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-6 text-slate-400">Không có dữ liệu tài khoản tiền (111, 112)</td></tr>');
      return;
    }

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    let totalNo = 0, totalCo = 0;
    entries.forEach(([tk, val]) => {
      const soDu = val.no - val.co;
      totalNo += val.no;
      totalCo += val.co;
      const soDuClass = soDu >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-extrabold' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-extrabold';
      
      $tbody.append(`
        <tr class="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">
          <td class="py-2.5 px-4 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs">${tk}</td>
          <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono text-xs">${formatCurrency(val.no)}</td>
          <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-450 font-mono text-xs">${formatCurrency(val.co)}</td>
          <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-xs ${soDuClass}">${formatCurrency(soDu)}</td>
        </tr>
      `);
    });

    const totalDu = totalNo - totalCo;
    const totalClass = totalDu >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400';
    $tbody.append(`
      <tr class="bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/40 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850">
        <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs font-extrabold">TỔNG CỘNG KHU VỰC</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono text-xs font-extrabold">${formatCurrency(totalNo)}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-450 font-mono text-xs font-extrabold">${formatCurrency(totalCo)}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-xs font-black ${totalClass}">${formatCurrency(totalDu)}</td>
      </tr>
    `);
  },

  // Helper lấy mảng phiếu tương ứng với Tab hoạt động
  getTabFilteredData: function() {
    const self = this;
    let thuData = self.filteredThuChi.filter(r => r.nhan_thu_chi === 'Thu' && !window.isWaitStatus(r.trang_thai));
    let chiData = self.filteredThuChi.filter(r => r.nhan_thu_chi === 'Chi' && !window.isWaitStatus(r.trang_thai));
    let pendingData = self.filteredThuChi.filter(r => window.isWaitStatus(r.trang_thai));

    // Cập nhật số lượng trên các Tabs header
    $('#mod-thuchi-tab-btn-thu').html(`<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-down text-blue-500"></i> Giao Dịch Thu (${thuData.length})`);
    $('#mod-thuchi-tab-btn-chi').html(`<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-up text-rose-500"></i> Giao Dịch Chi (${chiData.length})`);
    $('#mod-thuchi-tab-btn-pending').html(`<i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-amber-500"></i> Giao Dịch Chưa Duyệt (${pendingData.length})`);

    if (self.activeTableTab === 'Thu') return thuData;
    if (self.activeTableTab === 'Chi') return chiData;
    return pendingData;
  },

  // --- RENDER TRANSACTION DATATABLES ---
  renderTable: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $table = $('#mod-thuchi-table-data');
    const $tbody = $table.find('tbody');

    // Hủy DataTables cũ nếu đã có
    if (self.mainTable) {
      self.mainTable.destroy();
      self.mainTable = null;
    }
    $tbody.empty();

    const displayData = self.getTabFilteredData();
    $('#mod-thuchi-table-info').text(`Tổng cộng: ${displayData.length.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} giao dịch`);

    if (displayData.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="8" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy dữ liệu giao dịch phiếu</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    displayData.forEach(r => {
      // 1. Mã Phiếu
      const isThu = r.nhan_thu_chi === "Thu";
      const codeClass = isThu ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400';
      const tdCode = `<td class="py-3 px-4 font-bold ${codeClass} text-xs">${r.id_thu_chi || ''}</td>`;

      // 2. Ngày Lập
      const tdDate = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">${r.ngay_lap_norm || ''}</td>`;

      // 3. Chi nhánh
      const tdBranch = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-650 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold max-w-[120px] truncate">${r.chi_nhanh || ''}</td>`;

      // 4. Hạng mục
      const tdCat = `<td class="py-3 px-4"><span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200/50 dark:border-blue-800/30">${r.hang_muc || 'Khác'}</span></td>`;

      // 5. Nội Dung
      const tdContent = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-650 dark:text-slate-350 max-w-[200px] truncate" title="${r.noi_dung || ''}">${r.noi_dung || 'Trống'}</td>`;

      // 6. Số tiền
      const moneyClass = isThu ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-450';
      const tdAmount = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-right font-extrabold text-xs ${moneyClass}">${formatCurrency(r.so_tien)}</td>`;

      // 7. Trạng thái
      const stTxt = (r.trang_thai || '').toLowerCase();
      let badgeClass = 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border border-blue-500/20';
      if (stTxt.includes('hoàn thành') || stTxt.includes('thành công')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20';
      } else if (window.isWaitStatus(r.trang_thai)) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20';
      } else if (stTxt.includes('hủy')) {
        badgeClass = 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border border-rose-500/20';
      }
      const tdStatus = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-center"><span class="badge-status ${badgeClass} block w-max mx-auto text-[10px] py-0.5 px-2 font-extrabold">${r.trang_thai || 'Khác'}</span></td>`;

      // 8. Hành động
      const btnEdit = `<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_THUCHI.editRow('${r.id_thu_chi}')" class="w-[20px] h-[20px] rounded-[4px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:border-blue-600 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:border-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center mr-1 inline-flex" title="Sửa"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-[9.5px]"></i></button>`;
      const btnDelete = `<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_THUCHI.deleteRow('${r.id_thu_chi}')" class="w-[20px] h-[20px] rounded-[4px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:border-rose-600 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:border-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-500 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center inline-flex" title="Xóa"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-[9.5px]"></i></button>`;
      const tdAction = `<td class="py-3 px-4 text-center whitespace-nowrap">${btnEdit + btnDelete}</td>`;

      $tbody.append(`
        <tr onclick="window.MOD_THUCHI.openOffcanvas('${r.id_thu_chi}')" class="hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
          ${tdCode + tdDate + tdBranch + tdCat + tdContent + tdAmount + tdStatus + tdAction}
        </tr>
      `);
    });

    // Khởi tạo DataTables
    self.mainTable = $table.DataTable({
      responsive: true,
      fixedHeader: true,
      pageLength: 15,
      dom: '<"min-h-[300px]"rt><"flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center mt-4 text-xs text-gray-500"ip>',
      order: [[1, 'desc']], // Mặc định sắp xếp theo cột Ngày lập giảm dần
      language: {
        search: "Tìm kiếm:",
        lengthMenu: "Hiện _MENU_ dòng",
        info: "Hiển thị _START_ đến _END_ của _TOTAL_ phiếu",
        infoEmpty: "Không có dữ liệu",
        paginate: { first: "Đầu", last: "Cuối", next: "Sau", previous: "Trước" },
        zeroRecords: "Không tìm thấy kết quả"
      }
    });

    // Đồng bộ lại live search
    const searchVal = $('#mod-thuchi-search-input').val();
    if (searchVal) {
      self.mainTable.search(searchVal).draw();
    }
  },

  // --- SWITCH TABS IN DATA TABLES ---
  switchTableTab: function(tabId, el) {
    this.activeTableTab = tabId;
    $('.mod-thuchi-tab-btn').removeClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').addClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200');
    $(el).addClass('border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400');
    
    // Cập nhật title bảng
    let title = "Danh Sách Phiếu Chi Tiết";
    if (tabId === 'Thu') title = "Chi Tiết Giao Dịch Thu Tiền";
    else if (tabId === 'Chi') title = "Chi Tiết Giao Dịch Chi Tiền";
    else title = "Danh Sách Phiếu Chờ Duyệt";
    $('#mod-thuchi-table-title').text(title);

    this.renderTable();
  },

  // --- DRILLDOWN OFFCANVAS OPEN/CLOSE ---
  openOffcanvas: function(id) {
    const self = this;
    const item = self.rawThuChi.find(r => String(r.id_thu_chi).trim() === String(id).trim());
    if (!item) return;

    // Reset và đổ dữ liệu vào offcanvas
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-title').text(item.nhan_thu_chi === 'Thu' ? 'Chi tiết Phiếu Thu' : 'Chi tiết Phiếu Chi');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-subtitle').text(item.id_thu_chi || 'GD-N/A');
    
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-type').text(item.nhan_thu_chi || '-');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-branch').text(item.chi_nhanh || '-');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-date').text(item.ngay_lap_norm || '-');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-category').text(item.hang_muc || '-');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-partner').text(item.nha_cung_cap || 'Trống / Không có');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-creator').text(item.nguoi_tao || '-');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-content').text(item.noi_dung || 'Trống');

    // Số dư và Định khoản
    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-no').text(item.tai_khoan_no || 'Trống');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-no-id').text(`TK: ${item.tai_khoan_no_id || '-'}`);
    
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-co').text(item.tai_khoan_co || 'Trống');
    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-co-id').text(`TK: ${item.tai_khoan_co_id || '-'}`);

    $('#mod-thuchi-detail-amount').text(formatCurrency(item.so_tien));

    // Badge trạng thái
    const $statusBadge = $('#mod-thuchi-detail-status');
    const stTxt = (item.trang_thai || '').toLowerCase();
    $statusBadge.text(item.trang_thai || 'Khác');
    
    // Reset màu
    $statusBadge.removeClass('bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400 bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400 bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-350');
    
    if (stTxt.includes('hoàn thành') || stTxt.includes('thành công')) {
      $statusBadge.addClass('bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400 font-extrabold border border-emerald-200/50 dark:border-emerald-800/30');
    } else if (window.isWaitStatus(item.trang_thai)) {
      $statusBadge.addClass('bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400 font-extrabold border border-amber-200/50 dark:border-amber-800/30');
    } else if (stTxt.includes('hủy')) {
      $statusBadge.addClass('bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400 font-extrabold border border-rose-200/50 dark:border-rose-800/30');
    } else {
      $statusBadge.addClass('bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-850 dark:text-slate-300 font-extrabold border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/30');
    }

    // Hiển thị Offcanvas trượt ra mượt mà và an toàn
    $('#mod-thuchi-offcanvas').removeClass('translate-x-full');
    $('#mod-thuchi-backdrop').removeClass('hidden');
  },

  closeOffcanvas: function() {
    $('#mod-thuchi-offcanvas').addClass('translate-x-full');
    $('#mod-thuchi-backdrop').addClass('hidden');
  },

  // --- ZOOM CHART PANEL LOGIC ---
  toggleZoom: function(canvasId, btnElement) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const card = canvas.closest('.glass-card');
    if (!card) return;
    
    const isZoomed = card.classList.contains('panel-zoomed');
    if (isZoomed) {
      card.classList.remove('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-expand-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      this.renderCharts();
    } else {
      card.classList.add('panel-zoomed');
      btnElement.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-compress-arrows-alt text-xs"></i>';
      const chart = Chart.getChart(canvasId);
      if (chart) chart.resize();
    }
  },

  // --- EXPORT BALANCE TABLES TO EXCEL ---
  exportBalanceExcel: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $btn = $('#mod-thuchi-btn-export-balance-excel');
    const originalText = $btn.html();
    $btn.html('<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin mr-1.5"></i> Đang xuất...').prop('disabled', true);

    let dataToExport = [];
    dataToExport.push(['Tài Khoản Kế Toán', 'Tổng Thu (Nợ) (VNĐ)', 'Tổng Chi (Có) (VNĐ)', 'Số Dư Hiện Tại (VNĐ)']);

    // Tự động gom lại balanceMap cục bộ để xuất
    const balanceMap = {};
    const fBranchVal = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch').val();
    const isAllBranch = !fBranchVal;
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      const tkNoId = String(r.tai_khoan_no_id || '').trim();
      const tkCoId = String(r.tai_khoan_co_id || '').trim();
      const amt = Math.abs(r.so_tien || 0);
      
      if (tkNoId.startsWith('111') || tkNoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkNoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_no_cha || r.tai_khoan_no) : r.tai_khoan_no;
        if (!balanceMap[tkNoName]) balanceMap[tkNoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkNoName].no += amt;
      }
      if (tkCoId.startsWith('111') || tkCoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkCoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_co_cha || r.tai_khoan_co) : r.tai_khoan_co;
        if (!balanceMap[tkCoName]) balanceMap[tkCoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkCoName].co += amt;
      }
    });

    const entries = Object.entries(balanceMap).sort((a,b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    let totalNo = 0, totalCo = 0;
    entries.forEach(([tk, val]) => {
      const soDu = val.no - val.co;
      totalNo += val.no;
      totalCo += val.co;
      dataToExport.push([tk, val.no, val.co, soDu]);
    });
    dataToExport.push(['TỔNG CỘNG KHU VỰC', totalNo, totalCo, totalNo - totalCo]);

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        if (res.success) {
          window.open(res.url, '_blank');
        } else {
          alert("Lỗi xuất Excel: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        alert("Lỗi máy chủ kết nối xuất file: " + err.message);
      })
      .exportReport(dataToExport, "CanDoi_SoDuTaiKhoan_Master_Portal");
  },

  // --- EXPORT BALANCE TABLES TO PDF ---
  exportBalancePdf: function() {
    const self = this;
    const balanceMap = {};
    const fBranchVal = $('#mod-thuchi-filter-branch').val();
    const isAllBranch = !fBranchVal;
    self.filteredThuChi.forEach(r => {
      const tkNoId = String(r.tai_khoan_no_id || '').trim();
      const tkCoId = String(r.tai_khoan_co_id || '').trim();
      const amt = Math.abs(r.so_tien || 0);
      
      if (tkNoId.startsWith('111') || tkNoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkNoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_no_cha || r.tai_khoan_no) : r.tai_khoan_no;
        if (!balanceMap[tkNoName]) balanceMap[tkNoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkNoName].no += amt;
      }
      if (tkCoId.startsWith('111') || tkCoId.startsWith('112')) {
        const tkCoName = isAllBranch ? (r.tai_khoan_co_cha || r.tai_khoan_co) : r.tai_khoan_co;
        if (!balanceMap[tkCoName]) balanceMap[tkCoName] = { no: 0, co: 0 };
        balanceMap[tkCoName].co += amt;
      }
    });

    const entries = Object.entries(balanceMap).sort((a,b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    if (entries.length === 0) return alert("Không có dữ liệu số dư tài khoản!");

    let html = `
      <html>
      <head>
        <title>Báo cáo cân đối số dư tài khoản tiền</title>
        <link href="https:
        <style>
          body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 20px; color: #1e293b; }
          .header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 2px solid #10b981; padding-bottom: 15px; }
          .header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; color: #064e3b; }
          .header p { margin: 5px 0 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 15px; font-size: 11px; }
          th { background-color: #10b981; color: white; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; }
          td { border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 10px; }
          tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #f8fafc; }
          .text-right { text-align: right; }
          .font-bold { font-weight: bold; }
          .text-success { color: #10b981; }
          .text-danger { color: #ef4444; }
          .total-row { background-color: #f1f5f9 !important; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-top: 2px solid #cbd5e1; }
          .footer { margin-top: 30px; text-align: right; font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="header">
          <h1>BÁO CÁO CÂN ĐỐI SỐ DƯ TÀI KHOẢN TIỀN</h1>
          <p>ERP Master Portal • In lúc: ${new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')}</p>
        </div>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Tài Khoản Kế Toán</th>
              <th class="text-right">Tổng Thu (Nợ)</th>
              <th class="text-right">Tổng Chi (Có)</th>
              <th class="text-right">Số Dư Hiện Tại</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
    `;

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    let totalNo = 0, totalCo = 0;
    entries.forEach(([tk, val]) => {
      const soDu = val.no - val.co;
      totalNo += val.no;
      totalCo += val.co;
      const soDuClass = soDu >= 0 ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger';
      html += `
        <tr>
          <td class="font-bold">${tk}</td>
          <td class="text-right">${formatCurrency(val.no)}</td>
          <td class="text-right">${formatCurrency(val.co)}</td>
          <td class="text-right font-bold ${soDuClass}">${formatCurrency(soDu)}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    });

    const totalDu = totalNo - totalCo;
    const totalClass = totalDu >= 0 ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger';
    html += `
      <tr class="total-row">
        <td>TỔNG CỘNG KHU VỰC</td>
        <td class="text-right">${formatCurrency(totalNo)}</td>
        <td class="text-right">${formatCurrency(totalCo)}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold ${totalClass}">${formatCurrency(totalDu)}</td>
      </tr>
    `;

    html += `
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="footer">
          ERP 2H Studio • Tài liệu kế toán nội bộ
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;

    const win = window.open('', '_blank');
    win.document.write(html);
    win.document.close();
    win.focus();
    setTimeout(() => { win.print(); }, 250);
  },

  
  exportExcel: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $btn = $('#mod-thuchi-btn-export-excel');
    const originalText = $btn.html();
    $btn.html('<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin mr-1.5"></i> Đang xuất...').prop('disabled', true);

    let dataToExport = [];
    dataToExport.push(['Mã Phiếu', 'Ngày Lập', 'Chi Nhánh', 'Loại', 'Hạng Mục', 'Tài Khoản Nợ', 'Tài Khoản Có', 'Số Tiền (VNĐ)', 'Trạng Thái', 'Nội Dung', 'Người Tạo']);

    const displayData = self.getTabFilteredData();
    displayData.forEach(r => {
      dataToExport.push([
        r.id_thu_chi || '',
        r.ngay_lap_norm || '',
        r.chi_nhanh || '',
        r.nhan_thu_chi || '',
        r.hang_muc || '',
        r.tai_khoan_no || '',
        r.tai_khoan_co || '',
        r.so_tien || 0,
        r.trang_thai || '',
        r.noi_dung || '',
        r.nguoi_tao || ''
      ]);
    });

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        if (res.success) {
          window.open(res.url, '_blank');
        } else {
          alert("Lỗi xuất Excel: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        $btn.html(originalText).prop('disabled', false);
        alert("Lỗi máy chủ kết nối xuất file: " + err.message);
      })
      .exportReport(dataToExport, "DS_PhieuThuChi_Master_Portal");
  },

  editRow: function(id) {
    const item = this.rawThuChi.find(r => String(r.id_thu_chi).trim() === String(id).trim());
    if (item) {
      window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('thu_chi', item);
    }
  },

  deleteRow: function(id) {
    const self = this;
    if (confirm(`Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa phiếu ${id} không?`)) {
      window.showLoader("Đang xóa phiếu...");
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(resStr) {
        window.hideLoader();
        const res = JSON.parse(resStr);
        if (res.error) {
          alert("Lỗi: " + res.message);
        } else {
          alert("Xóa phiếu thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        }
      }).withFailureHandler(function(err) {
        window.hideLoader();
        alert("Lỗi kết nối server: " + err.toString());
      }).MOD_CRUD_deleteRow('thu_chi', id);
    }
  }
};
