    <div class="space-y-2 mt-0 !mt-0">
      <h4 class="text-[12px] font-bold text-blue-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Thông tin tài khoản</h4>
      
      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] py-[2.5px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 !mt-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Mã Số Tài Khoản</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-code" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] py-[2.5px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 !mt-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Tên Tài Khoản</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-name" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] py-[2.5px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 !mt-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Phân Loại Nhóm</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-cat" class="font-bold text-slate-850 dark:text-white">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] py-[2.5px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 !mt-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Chi Nhánh</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-branch" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] py-[2.5px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 !mt-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Ghi chú</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-note" class="font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-right max-w-[250px] break-words">-</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    
    <div class="space-y-2 mt-0">
      <h4 class="text-[12px] font-bold text-emerald-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Báo cáo Lũy Kế Tài Chính</h4>
      
      <div class="glass-card dark:bg-slate-800/20 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 space-y-2">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] pb-1 border-b border-slate-150/40 dark:border-slate-800/60">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-400">Số Dư Đầu Kỳ (Nợ / Có)</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-opening" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] pb-1 border-b border-slate-150/40 dark:border-slate-800/60">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-400">Phát Sinh Trong Kỳ (Nợ - Thu / Có - Chi)</span>
          <span id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-period" class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">-</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] pt-1">
          <span class="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-350">Số Dư Cuối Kỳ (Nợ / Có)</span>
          <strong id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-closing" class="text-sm font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-450">-</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    
    <div class="space-y-2 mt-0">
      <h4 class="text-[12px] font-bold text-purple-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Nhật ký giao dịch liên quan</h4>
      <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[250px] border border-slate-150 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
        <table id="mod-dinhkhoan-detail-table-tc" class="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr class="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-[8.5px] uppercase text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-150 dark:border-slate-700">
              <th class="p-2">Ngày</th>
              <th class="p-2">Mã Phiếu</th>
              <th class="p-2">Hạng Mục</th>
              <th class="p-2">Nội Dung</th>
              <th class="p-2 text-right">Số Tiền</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 text-[10px] text-slate-650 dark:text-slate-300">
            
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
        <script>




window.MOD_DINHKHOAN = {
  
  rawDinhKhoan: [],
  filteredDinhKhoan: [],
  rawThuChi: [], 

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  
  cleanup: function() {
    
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;

    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-btn-add').off('click').on('click', function() {
      window.AppCRUD.openCreateForm('dinh_khoan');
    });

    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-filter-branch, #mod-dinhkhoan-filter-category').off('change').on('change', function() {
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-search-input').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.applyFilters();
    });

    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-backdrop').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.closeOffcanvas();
    });
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ danh mục định khoản...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          if (data.error) {
            alert(data.message);
            hideLoader();
            return;
          }
          self.rawDinhKhoan = data.dinhKhoan || [];
          self.filteredDinhKhoan = [...self.rawDinhKhoan];

          
          if (!forceSync && window.MOD_THUCHI && window.MOD_THUCHI.rawThuChi && window.MOD_THUCHI.rawThuChi.length > 0) {
            self.rawThuChi = window.MOD_THUCHI.rawThuChi;
          } else {
            
            google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(tcRes => {
              try {
                const tcData = JSON.parse(tcRes);
                self.rawThuChi = tcData.thuChi || [];
                
                if (window.MOD_THUCHI) {
                  window.MOD_THUCHI.rawThuChi = self.rawThuChi;
                }
                
                const currentOpenId = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-code').text();
                if (currentOpenId && currentOpenId !== '-') {
                  self.openOffcanvas(currentOpenId);
                }
              } catch(e) {}
            }).MOD_THUCHI_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
          }

          
          self.populateBranchFilter(data.dinhKhoan || []);

          self.applyFilters();
          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          alert("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu Định Khoản: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        alert("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ Định Khoản: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_DINHKHOAN_getData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  populateBranchFilter: function(list) {
    const $select = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-filter-branch');
    const currentVal = $select.val();
    $select.empty().append('<option value="">Tất cả Chi nhánh</option>');
    
    const uniqueBranches = {};
    list.forEach(item => {
      if (item.chi_nhanh && item.chi_nhanh_id) {
        uniqueBranches[item.chi_nhanh_id] = item.chi_nhanh;
      }
    });

    Object.keys(uniqueBranches).sort().forEach(id => {
      $select.append(`<option value="${id}">${uniqueBranches[id]}</option>`);
    });

    if (currentVal) $select.val(currentVal);
  },

  // --- APPLY FILTERS ---
  applyFilters: function() {
    const self = this;
    const fBranch = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-filter-branch').val();
    const fCat = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-filter-category').val();
    const query = ($('#mod-dinhkhoan-search-input').val() || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    self.filteredDinhKhoan = self.rawDinhKhoan.filter(row => {
      
      if (fBranch && row.chi_nhanh_id !== fBranch) return false;
      
      
      if (fCat && row.phan_loai !== fCat) return false;

      
      if (query) {
        const matchCode = String(row.id_dinh_khoan || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchName = String(row.ten_tai_khoan || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchCat = String(row.phan_loai || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        if (!matchCode && !matchName && !matchCat) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    self.updateKPIs();
    self.renderTable();
  },

  
  updateKPIs: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    let tongTK = self.filteredDinhKhoan.length;
    let totalDebit = 0; 
    let totalCredit = 0; 
    
    self.filteredDinhKhoan.forEach(row => {
      totalDebit += parseFloat(row.no_trong_ky || 0);
      totalCredit += parseFloat(row.co_trong_ky || 0);
    });

    const balance = totalDebit - totalCredit;

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-kpi-count').text(tongTK.toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-kpi-debit').text(formatCurrency(totalDebit));
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-kpi-credit').text(formatCurrency(totalCredit));
    
    const $balanceEl = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-kpi-balance');
    $balanceEl.text(formatCurrency(balance));
    if (balance >= 0) {
      $balanceEl.removeClass('text-rose-650').addClass('text-emerald-500');
    } else {
      $balanceEl.removeClass('text-emerald-500').addClass('text-rose-600');
    }
  },

  
  renderTable: function() {
    const self = this;
    const $tbody = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-table-data tbody');
    $tbody.empty();

    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-table-info').text(`Hiển thị ${self.filteredDinhKhoan.length} tài khoản kế toán`);

    if (self.filteredDinhKhoan.length === 0) {
      $tbody.append(`<tr><td colspan="10" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">Không tìm thấy tài khoản định khoản phù hợp</td></tr>`);
      return;
    }

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      if (!val) return '0đ';
      return Math.round(Number(val)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    
    const sortedList = [...self.filteredDinhKhoan].sort((a, b) => {
      return String(a.id_dinh_khoan).localeCompare(String(b.id_dinh_khoan));
    });

    sortedList.forEach(r => {
      const code = String(r.id_dinh_khoan || '').trim();
      
      
      let indentClass = '';
      let isHeader = false;
      
      if (code.length <= 2) {
        indentClass = 'font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white';
        isHeader = true;
      } else if (code.length === 3) {
        indentClass = 'pl-6 font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200';
      } else if (code.length >= 4) {
        indentClass = 'pl-12 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400';
      }

      const tdCode = `<td class="py-1 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] ${isHeader ? 'font-bold text-blue-600' : ''}">${code}</td>`;
      const tdName = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-[11px] ${indentClass}">${r.ten_tai_khoan || ''}</td>`;
      const tdCat = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-semibold">${r.phan_loai || ''}</td>`;
      
      const tdNoDau = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">${formatCurrency(r.no_dau_ky)}</td>`;
      const tdCoDau = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">${formatCurrency(r.co_dau_ky)}</td>`;
      
      const tdNoTrong = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">${r.no_trong_ky > 0 ? '+' + formatCurrency(r.no_trong_ky) : '0đ'}</td>`;
      const tdCoTrong = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">${r.co_trong_ky > 0 ? '+' + formatCurrency(r.co_trong_ky) : '0đ'}</td>`;
      
      const tdNoCuoi = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">${formatCurrency(r.no_cuoi_ky)}</td>`;
      const tdCoCuoi = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-extrabold text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-450">${formatCurrency(r.co_cuoi_ky)}</td>`;

      // Nút sửa và xóa dòng (Inline Action Buttons chuẩn 20px)
      const btnEdit = `<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_DINHKHOAN.editRow('${code}')" class="w-[20px] h-[20px] rounded-[4px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:border-blue-600 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:border-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center mr-1 inline-flex" title="Sửa"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-[9.5px]"></i></button>`;
      const btnDelete = `<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.MOD_DINHKHOAN.deleteRow('${code}')" class="w-[20px] h-[20px] rounded-[4px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:border-rose-600 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:border-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-500 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center inline-flex" title="Xóa"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-[9.5px]"></i></button>`;
      const tdAction = `<td class="py-1 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">${btnEdit + btnDelete}</td>`;

      $tbody.append(`
        <tr onclick="window.MOD_DINHKHOAN.openOffcanvas('${code}')" class="hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
          ${tdCode + tdName + tdCat + tdNoDau + tdCoDau + tdNoTrong + tdCoTrong + tdNoCuoi + tdCoCuoi + tdAction}
        </tr>
      `);
    });
  },

  // --- OPEN OFFCANVAS DRAWER ---
  openOffcanvas: function(id) {
    const self = this;
    const item = self.rawDinhKhoan.find(r => String(r.id_dinh_khoan).trim() === String(id).trim());
    if (!item) return;

    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-title').text(item.ten_tai_khoan || 'Chi tiết Định Khoản');
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-subtitle').text("Mã TK: " + item.id_dinh_khoan);
    
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-code').text(item.id_dinh_khoan || '-');
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-name').text(item.ten_tai_khoan || '-');
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-cat').text(item.phan_loai || '-');
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-branch').text(item.chi_nhanh || 'Toàn hệ thống');
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-note').text(item.ghi_chu || 'Trống');

    const formatCurrency = (val) => {
      return Math.round(Number(val || 0)).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
    };

    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-opening').text(`Nợ: ${formatCurrency(item.no_dau_ky)} / Có: ${formatCurrency(item.co_dau_ky)}`);
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-period').text(`Nợ: +${formatCurrency(item.no_trong_ky)} / Có: +${formatCurrency(item.co_trong_ky)}`);
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-closing').text(`Nợ: ${formatCurrency(item.no_cuoi_ky)} / Có: ${formatCurrency(item.co_cuoi_ky)}`);

    // Render Nhật ký giao dịch liên quan
    const $tbodyTc = $('#mod-dinhkhoan-detail-table-tc tbody');
    $tbodyTc.empty();

    // Lọc giao dịch liên quan từ cache thu_chi
    const getAccCode = (val) => String(val || '').split('_')[0].split('-')[0].split(' ')[0].trim();
    const relTc = self.rawThuChi.filter(tc => {
      const codeNo = getAccCode(tc.tai_khoan_no);
      const codeCo = getAccCode(tc.tai_khoan_co);
      const targetId = String(id).trim();
      return codeNo === targetId || codeCo === targetId;
    }).sort((a, b) => String(b.ngay_lap_norm || b.ngay_lap || '').localeCompare(String(a.ngay_lap_norm || a.ngay_lap || ''))); // Mới nhất lên đầu

    if (relTc.length === 0) {
      $tbodyTc.append(`<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Không có giao dịch phát sinh liên quan</td></tr>`);
    } else {
      relTc.forEach(tc => {
        const isDebit = getAccCode(tc.tai_khoan_no) === String(id).trim();
        const typeBadge = isDebit ? 
          '<span class="text-emerald-600 font-bold">Nợ (Thu)</span>' : 
          '<span class="text-rose-600 font-bold">Có (Chi)</span>';
        
        $tbodyTc.append(`
          <tr class="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <td class="p-2">${tc.ngay_lap_norm || ''}</td>
            <td class="p-2 font-mono font-bold">${tc.id_thu_chi || ''}</td>
            <td class="p-2">${typeBadge}</td>
            <td class="p-2 truncate max-w-[120px]" title="${tc.noi_dung || ''}">${tc.noi_dung || ''}</td>
            <td class="p-2 text-right font-bold ${isDebit ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-rose-500'}">${formatCurrency(tc.so_tien)}</td>
          </tr>
        `);
      });
    }

    // Mở Offcanvas
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-backdrop').removeClass('hidden').addClass('block');
    setTimeout(() => {
      $('#mod-dinhkhoan-offcanvas').removeClass('translate-x-full');
    }, 10);
  },

  closeOffcanvas: function() {
    $('#mod-dinhkhoan-offcanvas').addClass('translate-x-full');
    setTimeout(() => {
      $('#mod-dinhkhoan-backdrop').removeClass('block').addClass('hidden');
    }, 300);
  },

  // --- CRUD ACTIONS ---
  editRow: function(id) {
    const item = this.rawDinhKhoan.find(r => String(r.id_dinh_khoan).trim() === String(id).trim());
    if (item) {
      window.AppCRUD.openEditForm('dinh_khoan', item);
    }
  },

  deleteRow: function(id) {
    const self = this;
    if (confirm(`Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa tài khoản ${id} không?`)) {
      window.showLoader("Đang xóa tài khoản...");
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(resStr) {
        window.hideLoader();
        const res = JSON.parse(resStr);
        if (res.error) {
          alert("Lỗi: " + res.message);
        } else {
          alert("Xóa tài khoản thành công!");
          self.fetchData(true);
        }
      }).withFailureHandler(function(err) {
        window.hideLoader();
        alert("Lỗi kết nối server: " + err.toString());
      }).MOD_CRUD_deleteRow('dinh_khoan', id);
    }
  }
};

// Đăng ký module với Shell
window.MOD_ACTIVE = window.MOD_DINHKHOAN;
</script>
      </div>
      <div id="mod-container-PhanQuyen" class="mod-container hidden">
        
                  

<div class="space-y-6">
  
  <div class="glass-card p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50 bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md relative overflow-hidden">
    <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-blue-600/5 rounded-full filter blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>
    <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 relative z-10">
      <div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved animate-pulse"></i>
          <span>Bảo mật hệ thống</span>

      </div>
      
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button id="mod-pq-btn-sync" class="h-10 px-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-500 hover:text-white transition-all shadow-sm text-xs font-semibold" title="Làm mới ma trận">
          <i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i>
          <span>Làm mới dữ liệu</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  
  <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
    
    <div class="xl:col-span-2 glass-card p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50 bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-600 to-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-sm shadow-md">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-table-list"></i>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 class="font-bold text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-white">Ma trận Phân quyền theo Module</h4>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Quy tắc lọc dữ liệu theo 3 nhóm quyền chính</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      
      <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60">
        <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr class="bg-slate-100/60 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">

window.MOD_PhanQuyen = {
  
  rawEmployees: [],
  rawAssignments: [],
  branchNameMap: {},
  statusNameMap: {},

  
  
  matrixData: [
    { module: "Nhân Viên", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Cùng Chi nhánh & Phòng ban", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Thiết Bị", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Lịch Công Việc", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Chỉ công việc cá nhân" },
    { module: "Quản lý Đơn hàng", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Quản lý Thu Chi", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Chỉ phiếu tự lập", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Quản lý Trang Phục", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Quản lý Lương", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Cùng Chi nhánh & Phòng ban", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Chỉ phiếu lương cá nhân" },
    { module: "Nhà Cung Cấp", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Hóa Đơn Công Nợ", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Báo Cáo Marketing", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Báo Cáo Tổng Hợp", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Không được xem" },
    { module: "Mục Tiêu Tháng", admin: "Toàn quyền", manager: "Chỉ chi nhánh được phân bổ", accountant: "Toàn quyền", user: "Chỉ mục tiêu cá nhân" }
  ],

  
  init: function() {
    this.setupEventHandlers();
    this.renderMatrix();
    this.fetchData(false);
  },

  cleanup: function() {
    
  },

  
  setupEventHandlers: function() {
    const self = this;
    
    
    $('#mod-pq-btn-sync').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.fetchData(true);
    });

    
    $('#mod-pq-search').off('input').on('input', function() {
      self.performSearch(this.value.trim());
    });
  },

  
  fetchData: function(forceSync = false) {
    const self = this;
    if (forceSync) {
      showLoader("Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu bảo mật...");
    }

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(res);
          self.rawEmployees = data.employees || [];
          self.rawAssignments = data.assignments || [];
          self.branchNameMap = data.branchNameMap || {};
          self.statusNameMap = data.statusNameMap || {};

          
          self.performSearch($('#mod-pq-search').val());
          hideLoader();
        } catch(err) {
          console.error("Lỗi xử lý dữ liệu bảo mật: " + err.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        showError("Lỗi tải thông tin phân bổ nhân sự: " + err.message);
        hideLoader();
      })
      .MOD_NhanVien_fetchData(JSON.stringify(USER_PROFILE));
  },

  
  renderMatrix: function() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('mod-pq-matrix-body');
    if (!tbody) return;
    tbody.innerHTML = '';

    this.matrixData.forEach(r => {
      
      const getBadgeClass = (text) => {
        if (text === "Toàn quyền") return "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/20";
        if (text.includes("Chi nhánh được phân bổ")) return "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/20";
        if (text.includes("Cùng Chi nhánh")) return "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/20";
        if (text.includes("cá nhân")) return "bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-500 border-indigo-500/20";
        if (text === "Không được xem") return "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 border-rose-500/20";
        return "bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 border-slate-500/20";
      };

      
      const getIconClass = (text) => {
        if (text === "Toàn quyền") return "fa-circle-check";
        if (text === "Không được xem") return "fa-circle-xmark";
        if (text.includes("cá nhân")) return "fa-user-shield";
        return "fa-circle-notch fa-spin-slow";
      };

      const rowHtml = `
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50/40 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/20 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/40">
          <td class="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">${r.module}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${getBadgeClass(r.admin)}">
              <i class="fa-solid ${getIconClass(r.admin)} mr-1.5 text-2xs"></i>${r.admin}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${getBadgeClass(r.manager)}">
              <i class="fa-solid ${getIconClass(r.manager)} mr-1.5 text-2xs"></i>${r.manager}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${getBadgeClass(r.accountant)}">
              <i class="fa-solid ${getIconClass(r.accountant)} mr-1.5 text-2xs"></i>${r.accountant}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-4 text-center">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${getBadgeClass(r.user)}">
              <i class="fa-solid ${getIconClass(r.user)} mr-1.5 text-2xs"></i>${r.user}
            </span>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
      tbody.innerHTML += rowHtml;
    });
  },

  
  performSearch: function(query) {
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('mod-pq-search-results');
    if (!resultsContainer) return;

    if (!query) {
      resultsContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div class="text-center py-10 text-slate-400">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-search text-3xl mb-3 opacity-40"></i>
          <p class="text-sm">Hãy nhập họ và tên hoặc bộ phận của nhân sự để bắt đầu tra cứu</p>
        </div>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    // Lọc nhân sự
    const matchedEmployees = this.rawEmployees.filter(e => {
      const name = String(e.ho_va_ten || '').toLowerCase();
      const id = String(e.id_nhan_vien || '').toLowerCase();
      const email = String(e.email || '').toLowerCase();
      return name.includes(q) || id.includes(q) || email.includes(q);
    });

    if (matchedEmployees.length === 0) {
      resultsContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div class="text-center py-10 text-slate-400">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-user-slash text-3xl mb-3 opacity-40"></i>
          <p class="text-sm">Không tìm thấy nhân sự nào trùng khớp</p>
        </div>
      `;
      return;
    }

    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '';

    matchedEmployees.forEach(e => {
      const empId = String(e.id_nhan_vien).trim();
      
      // Lọc các bản ghi phân bổ chi nhánh & chức vụ của nhân viên này
      const empAssigns = this.rawAssignments.filter(a => String(a.id_nhan_vien).trim() === empId);

      const branches = [];
      const depts = [];
      const roles = [];
      const perms = [];

      empAssigns.forEach(a => {
        if (a.chi_nhanh) {
          String(a.chi_nhanh).split(',').forEach(b => {
            const bId = b.trim();
            const bName = this.branchNameMap[bId] || bId;
            branches.push(`${bName} (${bId})`);
          });
        }
        if (a.phong_ban) depts.push(String(a.phong_ban).trim());
        if (a.chuc_vu) roles.push(String(a.chuc_vu).trim());
        if (a.phan_quyen) perms.push(String(a.phan_quyen).trim());
      });

      const uniqueArr = (arr) => arr.filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i);
      const uBranches = uniqueArr(branches);
      const uDepts = uniqueArr(depts);
      const uRoles = uniqueArr(roles);
      const uPerms = uniqueArr(perms);

      const isUserAdmin = uPerms.includes('Admin');
      const isUserManager = uRoles.some(r => r.toLowerCase().includes('quản lý') || r.toLowerCase().includes('quản lí'));
      const isUserAccountant = uDepts.some(d => d.toLowerCase().includes('kế toán'));

      
      let portalRole = 'Không có quyền truy cập Portal';
      let roleColor = 'bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 border-slate-500/20';
      if (isUserAdmin) {
        portalRole = '👑 Admin Hệ Thống';
        roleColor = 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/20';
      } else if (isUserManager) {
        portalRole = '💼 Quản Lý Chi Nhánh';
        roleColor = 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/20';
      } else if (isUserAccountant) {
        portalRole = '🧮 Kế Toán Viên';
        roleColor = 'bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-500 border-indigo-500/20';
      }

      const cardHtml = `
        <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/40 bg-white/30 dark:bg-slate-900/30 hover:bg-white/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-900/50 transition-all space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h5 class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-sm">${e.ho_va_ten}</h5>
              <p class="text-2xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${e.id_nhan_vien} &bull; ${e.email || 'Chưa cấu hình Email'}</p>
            </div>
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-2xs font-semibold border ${roleColor}">
              ${portalRole}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-2xs">
            <div>
              <span class="text-slate-400 block font-medium">Chi nhánh:</span>
              <span class="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">${uBranches.join(', ') || 'Chưa phân bổ'}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span class="text-slate-400 block font-medium">Bộ phận / Phòng ban:</span>
              <span class="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">${uDepts.join(', ') || 'Chưa phân bổ'}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="col-span-2">
              <span class="text-slate-400 block font-medium">Chức vụ trong doanh nghiệp:</span>
              <span class="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">${uRoles.join(', ') || 'Chưa phân bổ'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      resultsContainer.innerHTML += cardHtml;
    });
  }
};
window.MOD_ACTIVE = window.MOD_PhanQuyen;

<script>
function toSnakeCase(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  str = String(str).toLowerCase().trim();
  str = str.normalize('NFD');
  str = str.replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "") 
           .replace(/đ/g, "d").replace(/Đ/g, "D")
           .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_").replace(/_+/g, "_")
           .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
  return str;
}

window.AppCRUD = {
  activeTable: null,
  isEdit: false,
  originalRecord: null,

  requiredColumns: {
    "khach_hang": ["ten_khach_hang", "so_dien_thoai", "chi_nhanh", "trang_thai"],
    "nhan_vien": ["ho_va_ten", "so_dien_thoai", "gioi_tinh", "so_cccd", "trang_thai", "ngay_vao_lam", "loai_hinh_lam_viec"],
    "dich_vu": ["ten_dich_vu", "don_gia", "loai_dich_vu", "trang_thai"],
    "thiet_bi": ["ten_thiet_bi", "loai_thiet_bi", "trang_thai_tb", "chi_nhanh", "gia_tri"],
    "don_hang": ["id_khach_hang", "ngay", "chi_nhanh", "trang_thai"],
    "don_hang_ct": ["hang_muc", "so_luong", "don_gia", "chi_nhanh"],
    "thu_chi": ["ngay_lap", "hang_muc", "hinh_thuc_tt", "so_tien", "noi_dung"],
    "giat_vay": ["id_trang_phuc", "ngay", "so_luong", "so_tien", "trang_thai"],
    "dinh_khoan": ["ma_dinh_khoan", "ten_dinh_khoan", "loai_dinh_khoan"],
    "nha_cung_cap": ["ten_ncc", "phan_loai", "trang_thai"],
    "trang_phuc": ["ten_trang_phuc", "loai_trang_phuc", "trang_thai", "sl_khoi_tao"],
    "marketing": ["ngay", "sl_tin_nhan_mkt", "chi_phi_thuc_te"],
    "chien_dich": ["ten_chien_dich", "ngan_sach"],
    "media": ["ten_an_pham", "so_luong", "trang_thai"],
    "cham_cong": ["id_nhan_vien", "ngay", "ca_lam_viec", "trang_thai"],
    "muc_tieu_thang": ["id_phan_bo", "thang", "nam", "mt_doanh_so"],
    "co_che_luong": ["id_nhan_vien", "luong_thoa_thuan"],
    "don_de_xuat": ["loai_de_xuat", "id_nhan_vien", "ngay_tao", "trang_thai"]
  },

  getEnumOptions: function(colName, optTable) {
    const activeTable = optTable || this.activeTable;
    if (activeTable === "thu_chi") {
      if (colName === "hang_muc") {
        return ["Thu tiền khách hàng", "Chi lương nhân viên", "Thanh toán nhà cung cấp", "Chi phí Marketing", "Chi phí vận hành khác"];
      }
      if (colName === "trang_thai") {
        return ["Hoàn thành", "Chờ duyệt", "Hủy"];
      }
    }

    const schema = TABLE_SCHEMAS[activeTable];
    const col = schema ? schema.columns[colName] : null;
    if (col && col.values && col.values.length > 0) {
      return col.values;
    }
    
    if (colName === "gioi_tinh") {
      return ["Nam", "Nữ"];
    }
    if (colName === "tinh_trang_hd") {
      return ["Thử việc", "Chính thức"];
    }
    if (colName === "phan_quyen") {
      return ["Admin", "Manager", "Accountant", "User"];
    }
    
    
    if (colName === "loai_ngay" && activeTable === "khach_hang") {
      return ["Ngày cưới", "Ngày ăn hỏi", "Ngày sinh nhật", "Ngày kỷ niệm", "Khác"];
    }
    
    if (activeTable === "dich_vu") {
      if (colName === "dvt") {
        return ["Gói", "Lượt", "Buổi", "Ngày", "Bộ", "Cái", "Người", "Khác"];
      }
      if (colName === "hang_muc") {
        let crmData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["CRM"]) || {};
        if (typeof crmData === "string") {
          try {
            crmData = JSON.parse(crmData);
          } catch(e) {
            crmData = {};
          }
        }
        const services = crmData.services || [];
        const uniqueHangMuc = Array.from(new Set(services.map(s => s.hang_muc).filter(v => v)));
        if (uniqueHangMuc.length > 0) return uniqueHangMuc;
        return ["Hợp đồng", "Phát sinh"];
      }
    }
    
    if (colName === "nguoi_dang_giu" || colName === "nguoi_giao" || colName === "nguoi_nhan") {
      let nvData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"]) || {};
      if (typeof nvData === "string") {
        try { nvData = JSON.parse(nvData); } catch(e) { nvData = {}; }
      }
      const employees = nvData.employees || [];
      return employees.map(emp => ({ value: emp.id_nhan_vien, label: emp.ho_va_ten || emp.id_nhan_vien }));
    }
    
    
    if (activeTable === "thiet_bi" && colName === "trang_thai") {
      return ["Sẵn sàng", "Đang sử dụng", "Bảo dưỡng", "Hỏng/Mất"];
    }

    
    if (colName === "loai_trang_phuc" && activeTable === "trang_phuc") {
      return ["Áo dài", "Ghi lê", "Sơ mi nam", "Váy chụp", "Váy cưới", "Váy limitted", "Váy Luxury", "Váy thiết kế", "Váy tiệc", "Vest", "Việt phục"];
    }
    if (colName === "hang_muc" && activeTable === "trang_phuc") {
      return ["Trang phục", "Phụ kiện"];
    }
    if (colName === "dvt" && activeTable === "trang_phuc") {
      return ["Cái", "Bộ", "Đôi", "Chiếc"];
    }

    
    if (colName === "nha_cung_cap" || colName === "id_ncc" || colName === "id_nha_cung_cap") {
      let nccData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NCC"]) || {};
      if (typeof nccData === "string") {
        try { nccData = JSON.parse(nccData); } catch(e) { nccData = {}; }
      }
      const list = nccData.nccData || nccData || [];
      const arrayList = Array.isArray(list) ? list : (list.nccList || []);
      if (arrayList.length > 0) {
        return arrayList.map(item => ({ value: item.id_ncc, label: item.ten_ncc || item.id_ncc }));
      }
      return [];
    }

    
    if (colName === "id_khach_hang") {
      let crmData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["CRM"]) || {};
      if (typeof crmData === "string") {
        try { crmData = JSON.parse(crmData); } catch(e) { crmData = {}; }
      }
      const customers = crmData.customers || [];
      if (customers.length > 0) {
        return customers.map(c => ({ value: c.id_khach_hang, label: c.ten_khach_hang || c.id_khach_hang }));
      }
      return [];
    }

    
    if (colName === "id_dich_vu") {
      let crmData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["CRM"]) || {};
      if (typeof crmData === "string") {
        try { crmData = JSON.parse(crmData); } catch(e) { crmData = {}; }
      }
      const services = crmData.services || [];
      if (services.length > 0) {
        return services.map(s => ({ value: s.id_dich_vu, label: s.ten_dich_vu || s.id_dich_vu }));
      }
      return [];
    }

    
    if (colName === "id_don_hang") {
      let dhData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["DonHang"]) || {};
      if (typeof dhData === "string") {
        try { dhData = JSON.parse(dhData); } catch(e) { dhData = {}; }
      }
      const orders = dhData.don_hang || [];
      if (orders.length > 0) {
        return orders.map(dh => ({
          value: dh.id_don_hang,
          label: (dh.nhan_khach_hang || dh.ten_co_dau || dh.ten_chu_re || dh.id_don_hang)
        }));
      }
      return [];
    }

    
    if (colName === "id_trang_phuc") {
      let tpData = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["TrangPhuc"]) || {};
      if (typeof tpData === "string") {
        try { tpData = JSON.parse(tpData); } catch(e) { tpData = {}; }
      }
      const costumes = tpData.trangPhucData || tpData || [];
      const arrayList = Array.isArray(costumes) ? costumes : [];
      if (arrayList.length > 0) {
        return arrayList.map(item => {
          
          let displayName = item.ten_trang_phuc || item.nhan_trang_phuc || item.id_trang_phuc;
          const rawLabel = item.nhan_trang_phuc || '';
          
          const nameParts = rawLabel.split(' ');
          if (nameParts.length > 1 && /^TP-\d+$/i.test(nameParts[0])) {
            displayName = nameParts.slice(1).join(' ');
          }
          return {
            value: item.id_trang_phuc,
            label: displayName,
            image: item.hinh_anh || ''
          };
        });
      }
      return [];
    }
    
    
    if (colName === "trang_thai" && activeTable === "nhan_vien") {
      return ["Đang làm việc", "Đã nghỉ việc"];
    }
    
    if (colName === "chi_nhanh" || colName === "chi_nhanh_list") {
      const chiNhanh = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["chi_nhanh"]) || [];
      return chiNhanh.map(cn => ({ value: cn.id_chi_nhanh, label: cn.ten_studio || cn.id_chi_nhanh }));
    }

    if (colName === "trang_thai") {
      if (activeTable === "khach_hang") {
        return [{ value: "TRUE", label: "Hoạt động" }, { value: "FALSE", label: "Ngừng hoạt động" }];
      }
      const quyTrinh = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["quy_trinh"]) || [];
      
      
      if (activeTable === "giat_vay") {
        const results = quyTrinh
          .filter(item => item.quy_trinh === "Quản lý dịch vụ" && item.nhom_dich_vu.includes("Giặt váy"))
          .map(item => ({ value: item.id_quy_trinh, label: item.ten_trang_thai }));
        if (results.length > 0) return results;
        return [
          { value: "GV01", label: "Giao váy" },
          { value: "GV02", label: "Đang giặt" },
          { value: "GV03", label: "Đã nhận" }
        ];
      }

      let processName = "";
      if (activeTable === "don_hang" || activeTable === "don_hang_ct") processName = "Quản lý đơn hàng";
      else if (activeTable === "dich_vu") processName = "Quản lý trạng thái";
      else if (activeTable === "nhan_vien" || activeTable === "cham_cong" || activeTable === "don_de_xuat") processName = "Quản lý nhân sự";
      else if (activeTable === "thiet_bi") processName = "Quản lý thiết bị";
      else if (activeTable === "trang_phuc") processName = "Quản lý trang phục";
      else if (activeTable === "noi_quy") processName = "Quản lý nội quy";
      else if (activeTable === "tai_lieu") processName = "Quản lý tài liệu";
      else if (activeTable === "dinh_khoan") processName = "Quản lý tài chính";
      
      if (processName) {
        const results = quyTrinh
          .filter(item => item.quy_trinh === processName)
          .map(item => ({ value: item.id_quy_trinh, label: item.ten_trang_thai }));
        if (results.length > 0) return results;
        
        
        if (activeTable === "trang_phuc") {
          return [
            { value: "Sẵn sàng", label: "Sẵn sàng" },
            { value: "Đang giặt", label: "Đang giặt" },
            { value: "Hỏng/Mất", label: "Hỏng/Mất" },
            { value: "Thanh lý", label: "Thanh lý" }
          ];
        }
      }
    }
    
    const caiDat = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["cai_dat"]) || [];
    const fieldToGroupMap = {
      "phong_ban": "Phòng ban",
      "chuc_vu": "Chức vụ",
      "phan_quyen": "Phân quyền",
      "nguon_khach": "Nguồn khách hàng",
      "nhom_khach": "Nhóm khách hàng",
      "loai_thiet_bi": "Loại thiết bị",
      "trang_thai_tb": "Trạng thái thiết bị",
      "loai_dich_vu": "Nhóm dịch vụ",
      "hang_muc": "Hạng mục",
      "phan_loai": "Phân loại",
      "nhom_tai_khoan": "Nhóm tài khoản",
      "hinh_thuc_tt": "Hình thức thanh toán",
      "loai_thanh_toan": "Loại thanh toán",
      "phan_bo_nv": "Nhân sự"
    };
    
    let groupName = fieldToGroupMap[colName];
    if (groupName) {
      const results = caiDat
        .filter(item => item.nhom === groupName)
        .map(item => item.hang_muc);
      if (results.length > 0) return results;
    }
    
    const uniqueGroups = Array.from(new Set(caiDat.map(item => item.nhom)));
    const normalizedCol = toSnakeCase(colName).replace(/_/g, "");
    for (let g of uniqueGroups) {
      const normalizedGroup = toSnakeCase(g).replace(/_/g, "");
      if (normalizedGroup.includes(normalizedCol) || normalizedCol.includes(normalizedGroup)) {
        return caiDat.filter(item => item.nhom === g).map(item => item.hang_muc);
      }
    }
    
    if (colName === "tai_khoan_no" || colName === "tai_khoan_co") {
      const dkList = (window.MOD_THUCHI && window.MOD_THUCHI.dinhKhoanList) || [];
      if (dkList.length > 0) {
        return dkList.map(dk => ({ value: dk.id, label: dk.name }));
      }
      return [];
    }

    return [];
  },

  openCreateForm: function(tableName) {
    this.activeTable = tableName;
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.originalRecord = {};
    
    const friendlyName = this.getFriendlyTableName(tableName);
    $('#crud-modal-title').text("Thêm " + friendlyName + " mới");
    
    if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderForm === 'function') {
      window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderForm({});
    } else {
      this.renderFormFields({});
    }
    this.openModal();
  },

  openEditForm: function(tableName, recordObj) {
    this.activeTable = tableName;
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.originalRecord = recordObj || {};
    
    const friendlyName = this.getFriendlyTableName(tableName);
    $('#crud-modal-title').text("Chỉnh sửa " + friendlyName);
    
    if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderForm === 'function') {
      window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderForm(this.originalRecord);
    } else {
      this.renderFormFields(this.originalRecord);
    }
    this.openModal();
  },

  openDetailView: function(tableName, recordObj) {
    this.activeTable = tableName;
    this.originalRecord = recordObj || {};
    
    const friendlyName = this.getFriendlyTableName(tableName);
    $('#crud-drawer-title').text("Chi tiết " + friendlyName);
    
    if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderDetail === 'function') {
      window.MOD_ACTIVE.customRenderDetail(this.originalRecord);
    } else {
      this.renderDetailFields(this.originalRecord);
    }
    this.openDrawer();
  },

  openDrawer: function() {
    $('#crud-drawer-backdrop').removeClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').addClass('opacity-100');
    $('#crud-drawer').removeClass('translate-x-full');
  },

  closeDrawer: function() {
    $('#crud-drawer-backdrop').addClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').removeClass('opacity-100');
    $('#crud-drawer').addClass('translate-x-full');
  },

  openModal: function() {
    $('#crud-modal-backdrop').removeClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').addClass('opacity-100');
    $('#crud-modal').removeClass('scale-95 opacity-0').addClass('scale-100 opacity-100');
  },

  closeModal: function() {
    $('#crud-modal-backdrop').addClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').removeClass('opacity-100');
    $('#crud-modal').addClass('scale-95 opacity-0').removeClass('scale-100 opacity-100');
  },

  getFriendlyTableName: function(tableName) {
    const map = {
      "don_hang": "Đơn hàng", "don_hang_ct": "Chi tiết Đơn hàng", "khach_hang": "Khách hàng",
      "nhan_vien": "Nhân viên", "phan_bo_nv": "Phân bộ Nhân sự", "lich_cong_viec": "Lịch công việc",
      "thiet_bi": "Thiết bị", "thu_chi": "Khoản Thu Chi", "trang_phuc": "Trang phục",
      "nha_cung_cap": "Nhà cung cấp", "dich_vu": "Dịch vụ", "muc_tieu_thang": "Mục tiêu tháng"
    };
    return map[tableName] || tableName;
  },

    if (dict[colName] !== undefined) return dict[colName];

    return colName.split(/[_\/]/).map(w => {

  renderFormFields: function(data) {
    const fieldsContainer = $('#crud-modal-fields');
    fieldsContainer.empty();
    
    const schema = TABLE_SCHEMAS[this.activeTable];
    if (!schema) return;

    let tab1, tab2, tab3;
    const isDonHang = this.activeTable === "don_hang";
    if (isDonHang) {
      const tabHeader = `<div class="col-span-full flex border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 mb-4 gap-2">
        <button type="button" class="tab-form-btn px-4 py-2 border-b-2 font-bold text-xs transition-all active border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" data-form-tab="form-tab-donhang">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines mr-1"></i> 1. Thông tin Đơn hàng
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="tab-form-btn px-4 py-2 border-b-2 font-bold text-xs transition-all border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-650 dark:hover:text-slate-200" data-form-tab="form-tab-dichvu">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-gem mr-1"></i> 2. Dịch vụ & Chi phí
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="tab-form-btn px-4 py-2 border-b-2 font-bold text-xs transition-all border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-650 dark:hover:text-slate-200" data-form-tab="form-tab-thuchi">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-credit-card mr-1"></i> 3. Thanh toán & Lịch trình
        </button>
      </div>`;
      fieldsContainer.append(tabHeader);
      
      tab1 = $('<div id="form-tab-donhang" class="form-tab-content grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 col-span-full"></div>');
      tab2 = $('<div id="form-tab-dichvu" class="form-tab-content grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 col-span-full hidden"></div>');
      tab3 = $('<div id="form-tab-thuchi" class="form-tab-content grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 col-span-full hidden"></div>');
      
      $(document).off('click', '.tab-form-btn').on('click', '.tab-form-btn', function() {
        $('.tab-form-btn').removeClass('active border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400').addClass('border-transparent text-slate-400');
        $(this).removeClass('border-transparent text-slate-400').addClass('active border-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400');
        
        const targetTab = $(this).data('form-tab');
        $('.form-tab-content').addClass('hidden');
        $('#' + targetTab).removeClass('hidden');
      });
    }
    
    // Sắp xếp các trường theo đúng thứ tự trên Google Sheets
    const sheetOrder = (typeof ACTUAL_SHEET_COLUMNS !== 'undefined' && ACTUAL_SHEET_COLUMNS[this.activeTable]) || [];
    const allCols = Object.keys(schema.columns);
    const sortedCols = [
      ...sheetOrder.filter(c => allCols.includes(c)),
      ...allCols.filter(c => !sheetOrder.includes(c))
    ];
    sortedCols.forEach(colName => {
      const col = schema.columns[colName];
      if (col.virtual || colName === "_RowNumber") return;
      
      // Skip auto-filled audit fields in the modal form inputs
      const colNameLower = colName.toLowerCase();
      if (colNameLower === "nguoi_tao" || colNameLower === "thoi_gian_tao" || 
          colNameLower === "nguoi_cap_nhat" || colNameLower === "ngay_cap_nhat" ||
          colNameLower === "nguoi tao" || colNameLower === "thoi gian tao" ||
          colNameLower === "nguoi cap nhat" || colNameLower === "ngay cap nhat") {
        return;
      }
      
      const snakeName = toSnakeCase(colName);
      const isKey = colName === schema.key;
      const displayVal = data[colName] !== undefined ? data[colName] : (data[snakeName] !== undefined ? data[snakeName] : "");
      const labelText = this.getFriendlyColumnName(colName);
      
      // Check if field is required
      const requiredList = window.AppCRUD.requiredColumns[this.activeTable] || [];
      const isRequired = requiredList.includes(colName) || requiredList.includes(snakeName);
      const requiredAttr = isRequired ? "required" : "";
      const asterisk = isRequired ? ` <span class="text-rose-500 font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>` : "";
      
      // Grid Form Layout - determine if field spans full width
      let spanClass = "";
      const colType = col.type || "";
      if (colType === "LongText" || colType === "EnumList" || 
          colNameLower.includes("mo_ta") || colNameLower.includes("mô tả") || 
          colNameLower.includes("ghi_chu") || colNameLower.includes("ghi chú") ||
          colNameLower.includes("hinh_anh") || colNameLower.includes("hình ảnh") || 
          colNameLower.includes("link") || colNameLower.includes("url") ||
          colNameLower.includes("dia_chi") || colNameLower.includes("địa chỉ") ||
          colNameLower.includes("noi_dung") || colNameLower.includes("nội dung")) {
        spanClass = "md:col-span-2";
      }
      
      let fieldHtml = `<div class="flex flex-col space-y-1.5 ${spanClass}">
        <label class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">${labelText}${asterisk}</label>`;
        
      if (isKey) {
        fieldHtml += `<input type="text" name="${colName}" value="${displayVal}" placeholder="[Tự động sinh]" readonly 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono select-none outline-none">`;
      } 
      else if (col.read_only || col.app_formula) {
        fieldHtml += `<input type="text" name="${colName}" value="${displayVal}" placeholder="[Tự động tính]" readonly 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm text-slate-400 outline-none">`;
      }
      else if (col.type === "Enum" || col.type === "Ref") {
        const options = this.getEnumOptions(colName);
        fieldHtml += `<select name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-55 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">`;
        fieldHtml += `<option value="">-- Chọn ${labelText} --</option>`;
        options.forEach(opt => {
          let val, lbl;
          if (opt && typeof opt === 'object') {
            val = opt.value;
            lbl = opt.label;
          } else {
            val = opt;
            lbl = opt;
          }
          const selected = (String(displayVal) === String(val) || String(displayVal) === String(lbl)) ? "selected" : "";
          fieldHtml += `<option value="${val}" ${selected}>${lbl}</option>`;
        });
        fieldHtml += `</select>`;
      }
      else if (col.type === "EnumList") {
        const options = this.getEnumOptions(colName);
        fieldHtml += `<div class="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">`;
        
        const selectedVals = String(displayVal).split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v);
        options.forEach((opt, idx) => {
          let val, lbl, img;
          if (opt && typeof opt === 'object') {
            val = opt.value;
            lbl = opt.label;
            img = opt.image || '';
          } else {
            val = opt;
            lbl = opt;
            img = '';
          }
          // So khớp thông minh: theo value HOẶC label HOẶC selectedVal bắt đầu bằng value (VD: "TP-001 Tên váy" khớp với value "TP-001")
          const isChecked = selectedVals.some(sv => 
            String(sv) === String(val) || 
            String(sv) === String(lbl) ||
            String(sv).startsWith(String(val) + ' ') ||
            String(val).startsWith(String(sv) + ' ')
          ) ? "checked" : "";
          const imgTag = img ? `<img src="${img}" class="w-8 h-8 rounded object-cover flex-shrink-0" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : '';
          fieldHtml += `<label class="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm dark:text-white cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/50 rounded-lg px-2 py-1">
            <input type="checkbox" name="${colName}_checkbox" value="${val}" ${isChecked}
              class="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 flex-shrink-0">
            ${imgTag}
            <span class="truncate">${lbl}</span>
          </label>`;
        });
        
        fieldHtml += `<input type="hidden" id="enumlist-hidden-${colName}" name="${colName}" value="${displayVal}">`;
        fieldHtml += `</div>`;
        
        $(document).off('change', `input[name="${colName}_checkbox"]`).on('change', `input[name="${colName}_checkbox"]`, function() {
          const vals = [];
          $(`input[name="${colName}_checkbox"]:checked`).each(function() {
            vals.push($(this).val());
          });
          $(`#enumlist-hidden-${colName}`).val(vals.join(', '));
        });
      }
      else if (col.type === "LongText") {
        fieldHtml += `<textarea name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} rows="3" 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-55 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">${displayVal}</textarea>`;
      }
      else if (col.type === "Date") {
        let formattedDate = "";
        if (displayVal) {
          // If it is already yyyy-mm-dd
          if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(displayVal)) {
            formattedDate = displayVal;
          } else {
            // Try to parse DD/MM/YYYY
            const parts = String(displayVal).split('/');
            if (parts.length === 3) {
              const d = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
              const m = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
              const y = parts[2];
              formattedDate = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
            } else {
              // Try standard Date parsing
              const dObj = new Date(displayVal);
              if (!isNaN(dObj.getTime())) {
                const y = dObj.getFullYear();
                const m = String(dObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                const d = String(dObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                formattedDate = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (col.initial_value === "TODAY()") {
          const today = new Date();
          const y = today.getFullYear();
          const m = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
          const d = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
          formattedDate = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
        }
        fieldHtml += `<input type="date" name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} value="${formattedDate}" 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">`;
      }
      else if (col.type === "DateTime") {
        fieldHtml += `<input type="datetime-local" name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} value="${displayVal}" 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">`;
      }
      else if (col.type === "Number" || col.type === "Price" || col.type === "Percent") {
        fieldHtml += `<input type="number" step="any" name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} value="${displayVal}" 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">`;
      }
      else {
        fieldHtml += `<input type="text" name="${colName}" ${requiredAttr} value="${displayVal}" 
          class="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-xl text-sm dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition-all">`;
      }
      
      fieldHtml += `</div>`;
      
      if (isDonHang) {
        const g2 = ['id_dich_vu', 'loai_dich_vu', 'tong_tien_theo_hd', 'tong_tien_theo_HD', 'so_tien_km', 'thanh_tien', 'tong_tien_phat_sinh', 'tong_tien', 'chi_phi_cost', 'loi_nhuan_thuan', 'file_hd_dich_vu', 'file_hd_trang_phuc', 'link_nhom_zalo', 'link_anh_goc'];
        const g3 = ['da_thanh_toan', 'con_lai', 'so_tien_coc', 'ngay_chup', 'thoi_gian_bat_dau', 'dia_diem', 'ngay_cuoi', 'ngay_hoan_thanh', 'doanh_so_on', 'doanh_so_off', 'luong_ki_on', 'luong_ki_off'];
        
        if (g2.includes(snakeName) || g2.includes(colName)) {
          tab2.append(fieldHtml);
        } else if (g3.includes(snakeName) || g3.includes(colName)) {
          tab3.append(fieldHtml);
        } else {
          tab1.append(fieldHtml);
        }
      } else {
        fieldsContainer.append(fieldHtml);
      }
    });

    if (isDonHang) {
      fieldsContainer.append(tab1).append(tab2).append(tab3);
    }

    if (this.activeTable === "nhan_vien") {
      this.renderNhanVienAssignments(data.id_nhan_vien || data.idNhanVien);
    }
  },

  renderDetailFields: function(data) {
    const fieldsContainer = $('#crud-drawer-fields');
    fieldsContainer.empty();
    
    const schema = TABLE_SCHEMAS[this.activeTable];
    if (!schema) return;
    
    // Sắp xếp các trường theo đúng thứ tự Google Sheets
    const sheetOrderD = (typeof ACTUAL_SHEET_COLUMNS !== 'undefined' && ACTUAL_SHEET_COLUMNS[this.activeTable]) || [];
    const allColsD = Object.keys(schema.columns);
    const sortedColsD = [
      ...sheetOrderD.filter(c => allColsD.includes(c)),
      ...allColsD.filter(c => !sheetOrderD.includes(c))
    ];

    sortedColsD.forEach(colName => {
      const col = schema.columns[colName];
      if (col.virtual || colName === "_RowNumber") return;
      
      const snakeName = toSnakeCase(colName);
      const rawVal = data[colName] !== undefined ? data[colName] : (data[snakeName] !== undefined ? data[snakeName] : "");
      
      // Ánh xạ mã ID → Tên hiển thị cho các trường quan hệ
      let resolvedText = rawVal;
      let imageHtml = '';
      if (col.type === "Enum" || col.type === "EnumList") {
        const options = this.getEnumOptions(colName);
        if (options && options.length > 0 && typeof options[0] === 'object') {
          const selectedVals = String(rawVal).split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v);
          const results = selectedVals.map(val => {
            // So khớp thông minh theo value VÀ label
            const opt = options.find(o => String(o.value) === String(val) || String(o.label) === String(val));
            return opt ? opt : null;
          }).filter(Boolean);
          resolvedText = results.map(o => o.label).join(', ');
          // Hiển thị ảnh cho trang phục
          if (colName === 'id_trang_phuc' && results.some(o => o.image)) {
            imageHtml = '<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1">' + results.map(o => o.image ? `<img src="${o.image}" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-200" onerror="this.style.display='none'" title="${o.label}">` : '').join('') + '</div>';
          }
        }
      }
      if (resolvedText === '' || resolvedText === undefined || resolvedText === null) resolvedText = '-';
      
      const labelText = this.getFriendlyColumnName(colName);
      let fieldHtml = `<div class="flex flex-col space-y-1 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/65">
        <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">${labelText}</span>
        <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 break-words">${resolvedText}</span>
        ${imageHtml}
      </div>`;
      
      fieldsContainer.append(fieldHtml);
    });

    if (this.activeTable === "nhan_vien") {
      this.renderDetailNhanVienAssignments(data.id_nhan_vien || data.idNhanVien);
    }
  },

  renderDetailNhanVienAssignments: function(idNhanVien) {
    const fieldsContainer = $('#crud-drawer-fields');
    const allAssigns = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"] && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"].assignments) || [];
    const empAssigns = idNhanVien ? allAssigns.filter(a => String(a.id_nhan_vien || a.idNhanVien || '').trim() === String(idNhanVien).trim()) : [];

    let subHtml = `
      <div class="mt-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pt-5 space-y-4">
        <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-sitemap text-blue-500"></i> Phân bổ công việc (Đa chi nhánh)
        </h4>
        <div id="assignment-detail-container" class="space-y-3">
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    fieldsContainer.append(subHtml);

    const container = $('#assignment-detail-container');
    if (empAssigns.length === 0) {
      container.append(`<div class="text-xs text-slate-400">Không có phân bổ chi nhánh</div>`);
    } else {
      empAssigns.forEach(a => {
        let cardHtml = `
          <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/30 flex flex-col space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Chi nhánh:</span> ${a.chi_nhanh || ''}</div>
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Phòng ban:</span> ${a.phong_ban || ''}</div>
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Chức vụ:</span> ${a.chuc_vu || ''}</div>
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Quyền Portal:</span> ${a.phan_quyen || ''}</div>
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Ca làm việc:</span> ${a.ca_lam_viec || ''}</div>
            <div><span class="font-semibold text-slate-400">Lương/Hệ số:</span> ${a.he_so_luong || ''}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        container.append(cardHtml);
      });
    }
  },

  renderNhanVienAssignments: function(idNhanVien) {
    const fieldsContainer = $('#crud-modal-fields');
    const allAssigns = (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"] && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE["NhanVien"].assignments) || [];
    const empAssigns = idNhanVien ? allAssigns.filter(a => String(a.id_nhan_vien || a.idNhanVien || '').trim() === String(idNhanVien).trim()) : [];

    let subHtml = `
      <div class="mt-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pt-5 space-y-4 md:col-span-2">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-sitemap text-blue-500"></i> Phân bổ công việc (Đa chi nhánh)
          </h4>
          <button type="button" id="mod-nv-btn-add-assign"
            class="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[8px]"></i> Thêm chi nhánh
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div id="assignment-rows-container" class="space-y-3">
          <!-- Phân bổ rows will render here -->
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    
    fieldsContainer.append(subHtml);
    
    const self = this;
    const container = $('#assignment-rows-container');
    container.empty();
    
    if (empAssigns.length === 0) {
      self.addAssignmentRow({}, container);
    } else {

      });

    $('#mod-nv-btn-add-assign').off('click').on('click', function() {
      self.addAssignmentRow({}, container);
    });

  addAssignmentRow: function(data = {}, container = null) {
    const $container = container || $('#assignment-rows-container');
    const rowIdx = $container.children('.assignment-row').length;
    
    const branches = this.getEnumOptions("chi_nhanh");
    const depts = this.getEnumOptions("phong_ban");
    const roles = this.getEnumOptions("chuc_vu");
    const perms = this.getEnumOptions("phan_quyen");
    
    let branchOptions = branches.map(b => {
      let val = b && typeof b === 'object' ? b.value : b;
      let lbl = b && typeof b === 'object' ? b.label : b;
      return `<option value="${val}" ${String(data.chi_nhanh || '') === String(val) ? 'selected' : ''}>${lbl}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    let deptOptions = depts.map(d => {
      let val = d && typeof d === 'object' ? d.value : d;
      let lbl = d && typeof d === 'object' ? d.label : d;
      return `<option value="${val}" ${String(data.phong_ban || '') === String(val) ? 'selected' : ''}>${lbl}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    let roleOptions = roles.map(r => {
      let val = r && typeof r === 'object' ? r.value : r;
      let lbl = r && typeof r === 'object' ? r.label : r;
      return `<option value="${val}" ${String(data.chuc_vu || '') === String(val) ? 'selected' : ''}>${lbl}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    let permOptions = perms.map(p => {
      let val = p && typeof p === 'object' ? p.value : p;
      let lbl = p && typeof p === 'object' ? p.label : p;
      return `<option value="${val}" ${String(data.phan_quyen || '') === String(val) ? 'selected' : ''}>${lbl}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    const rowHtml = `
      <div class="assignment-row p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/30 relative flex flex-col space-y-2.5">
        <button type="button" onclick="$(this).closest('.assignment-row').remove()" 
          class="absolute top-2 right-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer" title="Xóa phân bổ này">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
        </button>
        
        <input type="hidden" name="assignment[${rowIdx}][id_phan_bo]" value="${data.id_phan_bo || ''}">
        
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Chi nhánh</label>
            <select name="assignment[${rowIdx}][chi_nhanh]" required
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
              <option value="">-- Chọn CN --</option>
              ${branchOptions}
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Phòng ban</label>
            <select name="assignment[${rowIdx}][phong_ban]" required
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
              <option value="">-- Chọn PB --</option>
              ${deptOptions}
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Chức vụ</label>
            <select name="assignment[${rowIdx}][chuc_vu]" required
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
              <option value="">-- Chọn chức vụ --</option>
              ${roleOptions}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Quyền Portal</label>
            <select name="assignment[${rowIdx}][phan_quyen]" required
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
              <option value="">-- Quyền Portal --</option>
              ${permOptions}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Ca làm việc</label>
            <input type="text" name="assignment[${rowIdx}][ca_lam_viec]" value="${data.ca_lam_viec || ''}" placeholder="Ca sáng, Ca chiều..."
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
          </div>
          
          <div class="flex flex-col space-y-1">
            <label class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Hệ số lương / Lương cứng</label>
            <input type="number" step="any" name="assignment[${rowIdx}][he_so_luong]" value="${data.he_so_luong || ''}" placeholder="Lương cứng hoặc Hệ số..."
              class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs dark:text-white outline-none">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    
    $container.append(rowHtml);
  },

  handleSubmit: function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const self = this;
    
    const formData = {};
    const inputs = $('#crud-modal-form').serializeArray();
    const arrayData = {};
    
    inputs.forEach(input => {
      // Hỗ trợ tổng quát: mang_con[index][ten_truong]
      const match = input.name.match(/^([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\[(\d+)\]\[([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\]$/);
      if (match) {
        const arrName = match[1];
        const idx = parseInt(match[2], 10);
        const fieldName = match[3];
        if (!arrayData[arrName]) arrayData[arrName] = [];
        if (!arrayData[arrName][idx]) arrayData[arrName][idx] = {};
        arrayData[arrName][idx][fieldName] = input.value;
      } else {
        formData[input.name] = input.value;
      }
    });

    // Gom các mảng con vào formData, loại bỏ các phần tử trống
    Object.keys(arrayData).forEach(arrName => {
      formData[arrName] = arrayData[arrName].filter(item => item && Object.keys(item).length > 0);
    });

    // Tương thích ngược: map "assignment" (số ít) thành "assignments" (số nhiều) cho module nhân viên
    if (this.activeTable === "nhan_vien" && formData.assignment) {
      formData["assignments"] = formData.assignment.filter(a => a && a.chi_nhanh && a.phong_ban);
      delete formData.assignment;
    }
    
    if (this.isEdit) {
      Object.keys(this.originalRecord).forEach(k => {
        if (formData[k] === undefined) {
          formData[k] = this.originalRecord[k];
        }
      });
    }
    
    showLoader("Đang lưu trữ dữ liệu...");
    
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(res => {
        hideLoader();
        if (res.success) {
          showSuccess("Đã lưu bản ghi thành công!");
          self.closeModal();
          
          if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.fetchData === 'function') {
            window.MOD_ACTIVE.fetchData(true);
          }
        } else {
          showError("Lỗi từ server: " + res.message);
        }
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => {
        hideLoader();
        showError("Lỗi kết nối: " + err.message);
      })
      .MOD_CRUD_saveRecord(this.activeTable, formData, localStorage.getItem('erp_master_profile'));
  },

  submitForm: function() {
    $('#crud-modal-form').submit();
  }
};

function showSuccess(msg) {
  alert("✨ THÀNH CÔNG: " + msg);
}

function showError(msg) {
  alert("❌ LỖI: " + msg);
}
</script>
  
<script>
  
  
  
  (function() {
    const originalRun = google.script.run;
    if (!originalRun) return;

    const cacheMap = {
      "MOD_NhanVien_fetchData": "NhanVien",
      "MOD_ThietBi_fetchData": "ThietBi",
      "MOD_LichCongViec_fetchData": "LichCongViec",
      "MOD_DonHang_getData": "DonHang",
      "MOD_THUCHI_getData": "ThuChi",
      "MOD_DINHKHOAN_getData": "DinhKhoan",
      "MOD_TRANGPHUC_getData": "TrangPhuc",
      "MOD_GIATVAY_getData": "GiatVay",
      "MOD_LUONG_getData": "Luong",
      "MOD_NCC_getData": "NCC",
      "MOD_HDCN_getData": "HDCN",
      "MOD_Marketing_getData": "Marketing",
      "getBranchSummaryInitialData": "TongHopChiNhanh",
      "getMucTieuInitialData": "MucTieuThang",
      "MOD_CRM_getData": "CRM"
    };

    const hijackedRun = {};

    Object.keys(originalRun).forEach(key => {
      if (typeof originalRun[key] === 'function') {
        hijackedRun[key] = originalRun[key];
      }
    });

    hijackedRun.withSuccessHandler = function(successCallback) {
      return createBuilder(originalRun.withSuccessHandler(successCallback), successCallback, null);
    };

    hijackedRun.withFailureHandler = function(failureCallback) {
      return createBuilder(originalRun.withFailureHandler(failureCallback), null, failureCallback);
    };

    function createBuilder(originalBuilder, successCallback, failureCallback) {
      return new Proxy(originalBuilder, {
        get: function(target, propKey) {
          if (propKey === 'withSuccessHandler') {
            return function(sc) {
              return createBuilder(target.withSuccessHandler(sc), sc, failureCallback);
            };
          }
          if (propKey === 'withFailureHandler') {
            return function(fc) {
              return createBuilder(target.withFailureHandler(fc), successCallback, fc);
            };
          }

          if (cacheMap[propKey] !== undefined) {
            return function(...args) {
              const cacheKey = cacheMap[propKey];
              
              const loaderEl = document.getElementById('loader-overlay-text');
              const loaderText = loaderEl ? loaderEl.innerText : "";
              const isSyncing = loaderText.includes("đồng bộ") || loaderText.includes("làm mới") || loaderText.includes("xóa") || loaderText.includes("Sync");
              const isHDCNForceSync = propKey === 'MOD_HDCN_getData' && args[1] === true;

              const isForceSync = isSyncing || isHDCNForceSync;

              console.log("[CacheProxy] Call:", propKey, "| CacheKey:", cacheKey, "| isForceSync:", isForceSync, "| LoaderText:", loaderText);

              if (isForceSync) {
                console.log("[CacheProxy] Force sync detected. Cleared cache for:", cacheKey);
                if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE) {
                  window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE[cacheKey] = null;
                }
                try {
                  originalRun.clearAllCache();
                } catch(e) {
                  console.error("Lỗi khi xóa RAM cache Google:", e);
                }
              } else if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE[cacheKey]) {
                console.log("[CacheProxy] HIT! Serving from client-side cache for:", cacheKey);
                const cachedData = window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE[cacheKey];
                setTimeout(() => {
                  if (successCallback) {
                    try {
                      successCallback(cachedData);
                    } catch (e) {
                      console.error("Lỗi chạy callback local cache cho " + propKey + ":", e);
                    }
                  }
                }, 10);
                return;
              } else {
                console.log("[CacheProxy] MISS! Cache empty for:", cacheKey, ". Fetching from server...");
              }
              
              
              const customSuccessHandler = function(response) {
                console.log("[CacheProxy] Server response received for:", propKey, ". Saving to cache...");
                if (window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE && response) {
                  window.GLOBAL_DATA_CACHE[cacheKey] = response; 
                }
                if (successCallback) {
                  try {
                    successCallback(response);
                  } catch (e) {
                    console.error("Lỗi chạy successCallback cho " + propKey + ":", e);
                  }
                }
              };

              let runner = originalRun;
              if (failureCallback) {
                runner = runner.withFailureHandler(failureCallback);
              }
              runner = runner.withSuccessHandler(customSuccessHandler);
              
              return runner[propKey](...args);
            };
          }

          return target[propKey];
        }
      });
    }

    google.script.run = hijackedRun;
    console.log("=== GOOGLE SCRIPT RUN HIJACKED SUCCESSFULLY FOR PRELOAD CACHE ===");
  })();
