  function hasAccessToModule(userProfile, moduleId) {
    if (!userProfile) return false;
    
    if (userProfile.isSuperAdmin) return true;
    
    const isAdmin = !!userProfile.isAdmin;
    const isManager = !!userProfile.isManager;
    const isAccountant = !!userProfile.isAccountant;
    const isEmployee = !!userProfile.isEmployee;

    switch (moduleId) {
      case "PhanQuyen":
        return !!userProfile.isSuperAdmin; 
        
      case "CRM":
      case "DichVu":
      case "TongHopChiNhanh":
      case "MucTieuThang":
      case "Marketing":
      case "NhanVien":
      case "DonHang":
      case "DonHangCT":
      case "ThuChi":
      case "HDCN":
      case "Luong":
      case "LichCongViec":
      case "TrangPhuc":
      case "GiatVay":
      case "NCC":
      case "DinhKhoan":
        
        if (isAdmin || isManager || isAccountant) {
          return true;
        }
        
        
        if (isEmployee) {
          return moduleId === "LichCongViec" || moduleId === "MucTieuThang" || moduleId === "Luong";
        }
        
        return false;
        
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  
  let currentActiveModule = null;
  let isSidebarCollapsed = false;

  
  const Router = {
    activeModuleId: null,

    
    navigateTo: function(moduleId) {
      if (this.activeModuleId === moduleId) return;
      
      const item = MENU_ITEMS.find(m => m.id === moduleId);
      if (!item) return;

      
      if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.cleanup === 'function') {
        try {
          window.MOD_ACTIVE.cleanup();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Lỗi khi cleanup module cũ:", e);
        }
      }
      window.MOD_ACTIVE = null; 

      
      this.activeModuleId = moduleId;
      $('.sidebar-nav-item').removeClass('bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border-l-4 border-blue-600 font-semibold').addClass('text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60');
      $(`#nav-item-${moduleId}`).addClass('bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border-l-4 border-blue-600 font-semibold').removeClass('text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60');
      
      
      $('#module-title').text(item.name);

      
      $('.mod-container').addClass('hidden');
      const targetContainer = document.getElementById(`mod-container-${moduleId}`);
      if (targetContainer) {
        targetContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      
      const moduleMap = {
        "CRM": window.MOD_CRM,
        "DonHang": window.MOD_DonHang,
        "DonHangCT": window.MOD_DonHangCT,
        "DichVu": window.MOD_DichVu,
        "TrangPhuc": window.MOD_TRANGPHUC,
        "GiatVay": window.MOD_GIATVAY,
        "ThietBi": window.MOD_ThietBi,
        "NhanVien": window.MOD_NhanVien,
        "PhanQuyen": window.MOD_PhanQuyen,
        "ThuChi": window.MOD_THUCHI,
        "DinhKhoan": window.MOD_DINHKHOAN
      };
      
      window.MOD_ACTIVE = moduleMap[moduleId] || null;

      
      if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.init === 'function') {
        showLoader("Đang tải dữ liệu module " + item.name + "...");
        try {
          window.MOD_ACTIVE.init();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Lỗi khi chạy init module:", e);
          showError("Lỗi khởi tạo giao diện module: " + e.message);
          hideLoader();
        }
      } else {
        hideLoader();
      }
    }
  };

  
  function toggleSidebar() {
    isSidebarCollapsed = !isSidebarCollapsed;
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const brand = document.getElementById('sidebar-brand');
    const toggleIcon = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-icon');

    if (isSidebarCollapsed) {
      
      sidebar.classList.replace('w-[220px]', 'w-[60px]');
      brand.classList.add('hidden');
      toggleIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-angles-right';
      $('.nav-item-text').addClass('hidden');
      $('.nav-group-header').addClass('hidden');
      $('.sidebar-nav-item').addClass('justify-center px-0').removeClass('px-4 space-x-3');
      localStorage.setItem('erp_sidebar_collapsed', 'true');
    } else {
      
      sidebar.classList.replace('w-[60px]', 'w-[220px]');
      setTimeout(() => brand.classList.remove('hidden'), 100);
      toggleIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-angles-left';
      $('.nav-item-text').removeClass('hidden');
      $('.nav-group-header').removeClass('hidden');
      $('.sidebar-nav-item').removeClass('justify-center px-0').addClass('px-4 space-x-3');
      localStorage.setItem('erp_sidebar_collapsed', 'false');
    }
  }

  function applySavedSidebarState() {
    const collapsed = localStorage.getItem('erp_sidebar_collapsed');
    if (collapsed === 'true') {
      isSidebarCollapsed = false; 
      toggleSidebar();
    }
  }

  
  $(document).ready(function() {
    
    initTheme();
    applySavedSidebarState();

    
    
    if (window.dayjs_plugin_customParseFormat) dayjs.extend(window.dayjs_plugin_customParseFormat);
    if (window.dayjs_plugin_isSameOrAfter) dayjs.extend(window.dayjs_plugin_isSameOrAfter);
    if (window.dayjs_plugin_isSameOrBefore) dayjs.extend(window.dayjs_plugin_isSameOrBefore);
    if (window.dayjs_plugin_quarterOfYear) dayjs.extend(window.dayjs_plugin_quarterOfYear);
    if (typeof ChartDataLabels !== 'undefined') Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);

    
    if (typeof USER_PROFILE !== 'undefined' && USER_PROFILE) {
      $('#header-user-name').text(USER_PROFILE.name);
      
      const roleText = USER_PROFILE.isAdmin ? "Admin" : 
                       (USER_PROFILE.isManager ? "Quản lý" : 
                       (USER_PROFILE.isAccountant ? "Kế toán" : "Nhân viên"));
      $('#header-user-role').text(roleText);
    }

    
    const nav = document.getElementById('sidebar-nav');
    nav.innerHTML = '';
    const visibleModulesList = [];
    
    MENU_GROUPS.forEach(g => {
      const accessibleItems = g.items.filter(item => {
        return typeof USER_PROFILE !== 'undefined' && USER_PROFILE && hasAccessToModule(USER_PROFILE, item.id);
      });
      
      if (accessibleItems.length > 0) {
        
        const groupTitleHtml = `
          <div class="nav-group-header text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider mb-1 px-4 mt-4 block truncate select-none">
            ${g.title}
          </div>
        `;
        nav.innerHTML += groupTitleHtml;
        
        accessibleItems.forEach(m => {
          visibleModulesList.push(m.id);
          const activeClass = "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60";
          const itemHtml = `
            <a id="nav-item-${m.id}" onclick="Router.navigateTo('${m.id}')" 
               class="sidebar-nav-item sidebar-item-transition flex items-center px-4 py-3 rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium space-x-3 ${activeClass}">
              <i class="fa-solid ${m.icon} w-5 text-center text-base flex-shrink-0"></i>
              <span class="nav-item-text truncate">${m.name}</span>
            </a>
          `;
          nav.innerHTML += itemHtml;
        });
      }
    });

    // Bật lại text hiển thị nếu sidebar đang mở rộng
    if (isSidebarCollapsed) {
      $('.nav-item-text').addClass('hidden');
      $('.nav-group-header').addClass('hidden');
    }

    // 4. Bắt đầu tải Module mặc định được phép đầu tiên (tránh bị báo lỗi từ chối truy cập)
    const defaultModule = visibleModulesList.length > 0 ? visibleModulesList[0] : null;
    if (defaultModule) {
      Router.navigateTo(defaultModule);
    }
  });

  // ================= THEME TOGGLE (DARK/LIGHT) =================
  function initTheme() {
    const theme = localStorage.getItem('erp_theme') || 'dark';
    const icon = document.getElementById('theme-toggle-icon');
    
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
      icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-sun text-amber-400';
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
      icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-moon text-slate-500';
    }
  }

  $('#themeToggle').on('click', function() {
    const icon = document.getElementById('theme-toggle-icon');
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
      localStorage.setItem('erp_theme', 'light');
      icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-moon text-slate-500';
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
      localStorage.setItem('erp_theme', 'dark');
      icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-sun text-amber-400';
    }
    
    // Phát sự kiện cập nhật màu sắc biểu đồ nếu có module đang active
    if (window.MOD_ACTIVE && typeof window.MOD_ACTIVE.updateCharts === 'function') {
      window.MOD_ACTIVE.updateCharts();
    }
  });

  // ================= DIALOG LOADER & LOGOUT =================
  function showLoader(msg) {
    $('#loader-overlay-text').text(msg || "Đang xử lý...");
    $('#loader-overlay').removeClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').addClass('opacity-100');
  }

  function hideLoader() {
    $('#loader-overlay').addClass('pointer-events-none opacity-0').removeClass('opacity-100');
    $('#loader-overlay-text').text(""); // Dọn sạch text tránh bị kẹt
  }

  function showError(msg) {
    alert(msg);
  }

  function handleLogout() {
    if (confirm("Anh có chắc muốn đăng xuất khỏi hệ thống Master Portal không?")) {
      localStorage.removeItem('erp_master_profile');
      showLoader("Đang đăng xuất...");
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(html => {
          document.open();
          document.write(html);
          document.close();
        })
        .getLoginHtml();
    }
  }
</script>


</body></html>
